qe: The ramparts of the fort of Behar were very strong and built of very large rough stones; the fort being very irregular in shape, what strengthened all its angles?
qh: बिहार के किले की प्राचीरें बहुत मज़बूत थीं तथा बहुत बड़े कच्चे पत्थरों से बनी थीं; किला आकार में बहुत अनियमित था, तो उसके सभी कोनों को किसने मज़बूत किया हुआ था?
e: Behar ke kila ke baare me bataya gaya ki uski prachirein bahut mazboot thin tatha ve bahut bade kacche pattharon se bani thin. Kila aakar me bahut aniyamit tha, lekin uske sabhi konon ko bade gol burajon yaani round bastions se mazboot kiya gaya tha. Buraj kila-nirman ka woh hissa hota hai jo kila ki deewar se bahar ki or nikla hua hota hai; isse rakshak dono or dekhte hue dushman par var kar sakte the. Kaha jaata tha ki jab topon ka istemal badha tatha kila topon se asurakshit ho gaya, to Muhammadan shasakon ne is par kaam karna chhod diya. Aage ke samay me yahan ke Amil log kila ke andar apni Kacheri surakshit banate rahe. Exam point: Behar ke kila ki prachirein bahut bade kacche pattharon se bani thin tatha uske sabhi kone bade gol burajon se mazboot kiye gaye the; kila bahut aniyamit tha tatha topon ke aane par ise chhod diya gaya.

qe: A stone built into one of the gates of the fort of Behar carried the figures of Buddha and Ganesa, showing that the work had been built of ruins taken from what kind of earlier structure?
qh: बिहार के किले के एक दरवाज़े में लगा पत्थर बुद्ध तथा गणेश की आकृतियाँ दिखाता है, जिससे सिद्ध होता है कि यह काम किस तरह की पुरानी इमारत के खंडहरों से लिए पत्थरों से किया गया था?
oh: किसी किले के दरवाज़े के खंडहर
e: Kila ka ek darwaza aisi imarat ke khandaaron se banaya gaya tha jo pehle kisi Hindu kaam ki thi. Us darwaze me lage ek patthar par Buddha tatha Ganesa ki aakritiyan bani hui thin. Buddha Bauddh parampara se tatha Ganesa Hindu parampara se jude hain, isliye is patthar se saaf pata chalta hai ki kila banane walon ne aas-paas ki purani imaraton ke patthar nikaal kar unhe is kaam me lagaya tha. Anuman lagaya gaya ki mool darwaze par aise bahut se chihn the tatha use tod diya gaya hoga; jo darwaza bacha, woh naye pattharon se bana tha. Purane khandaaron ke patthar dobara istemal karne ki yah prakriya us daur me aam thi. Exam point: Behar ke kila ke ek darwaze me lage patthar par Buddha tatha Ganesa ki aakritiyan thi, jisse pata chalta hai ki kila banane me purani Hindu imaraton ke khandaaron ke patthar istemal hue the.

qe: Behar was never the station of a Subah or of a person of very high rank; which city always had the preference in this matter?
qh: बिहार कभी किसी सूबे का मुख्यालय या किसी बहुत ऊँचे पद वाले व्यक्ति का निवास-स्थान नहीं रहा; इस मामले में सदैव किस शहर को वरीयता मिली?
e: Us samay ke jaan-kar logon ne bataya ki Behar shahar kabhi ujaad ya veeran nahi hua, kyunki wahan sada ek Amil yaani mahal ki aay ka prabandhak rahta tha. Lekin yah sthal kabhi kisi Subah yaani praant ke pramukh adhikari ka mukhyalaya nahi bana tatha kisi bahut oonche pad wale vyakti ka nivas-sthal bhi nahi raha. Is maamle me Patna ko hamesha varishta milti rahi, kyunki woh bade vyaparik tatha prabandhan ka kendra tha. Purane kila ke andar rahne wale Amil log apni Kacheri yaani daftar ko surakshit bana lete the tatha kuch logon ki yaad tak woh kaafi sahi halat me bachi rahi. Exam point: Behar kabhi kisi Subah ka mukhyalaya nahi bana; wahan sirf Amil yaani aay-prabandhak rahte the tatha unchi satta ke liye Patna ko hamesha varishta mili; Amil log kila ke andar apni Kacheri surakshit banate the.

qe: The statistical survey of Patna and Gaya districts in 1811-12, famous in the early records of Bihar, was conducted by which officer of the East India Company?
qh: 1811-12 में पटना तथा गया जिलों का सांख्यिकीय सर्वेक्षण, जो बिहार के आरंभिक अभिलेखों में प्रसिद्ध है, ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के किस अफसर ने किया?
e: Francis Buchanan ek doctor tatha vaigyanik soch wale afsar the, jinhone East India Company ke liye Bangal ke jilon ka bada statistical yaani aankdon wala survey kiya. Patna tatha Gaya jilon ka unka daurra 1811-12 me hua. Woh apne saath roz-namcha (journal) rakhte the tatha mitti, khanijein, fasalein, vyapar, aabadi tatha imaraton ki jaankari likhte jaate the. Baad me unhone apna naam badal kar Hamilton rakh liya, isliye woh Buchanan-Hamilton naam se bhi jaane jaate hain. Unke survey ke aankde aaj bhi itihaskar tatha bhoogol-shastri istemal karte hain, kyunki unse 19vein sadi ki shuruaat me Bihar ki krishi, khanij tatha vyapar ki sthiti samajh aati hai. William Tayler 1857 ke samay Patna ke Commissioner the, John Shore lagan-vyavastha se tatha Reginald Heber ek Bishop tatha yatri the. Exam point: Patna tatha Gaya jilon ka survey 1811-12 = Francis Buchanan (baad me Hamilton), East India Company ke liye; woh mitti, khanij, fasal, vyapar tatha aabadi ke aankde darj karte the.

qe: What was the main purpose of the district survey for which the East India Company issued detailed instructions to its survey officer in September 1807?
qh: सितंबर 1807 में ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी ने अपने सर्वेक्षण अफसर को जिस जिला-सर्वेक्षण के लिए विस्तृत निर्देश दिए, उसका मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
oe: To recruit soldiers for the Company's army
To count the number of temples and mosques
To prepare maps for railway lines
To collect reliable statistical information on land, produce and people
oh: कंपनी की सेना के लिए सैनिक भर्ती करना
मंदिरों तथा मस्जिदों की गिनती करना
रेलवे लाइनों के लिए नक्शे बनाना
भूमि, उत्पादन तथा जनसंख्या की भरोसेमंद सांख्यिकीय जानकारी जुटाना
e: East India Company ko apne rajya ke baare me sahi aankde chahiye the, taaki lagan (revenue), vyapar tatha prashasan ke faisle bharose se liye ja sakein; isi liye September 1807 me Calcutta se survey ke liye vistrit nirdesh jaari kiye gaye. Un nirdeshon me likha tha ki afsar mitti, jalvayu, nadi, fasal, utpadan, vyapar, bazaar, jaati-ganan, imarat tatha logon ke jeevan ki poori jaankari ekatra karein. Isi survey ke tahat Bihar ke kai jile ek-ek karke chune gaye, jaise Purnea (1809-10), Bhagalpur (1810-11), Patna tatha Gaya (1811-12) tatha Shahabad (1812-13). Survey ka kaam 1807 se 1815 tak chala tatha company ke kaamon ke liye yah ek bharosemand aankda-sangrah bana. Railway lines, murti-ganan tatha sena-bharti is survey ka uddeshya nahi thi. Exam point: September 1807 ke nirdesh = zameen, utpadan, vyapar tatha aabadi ke bharosemand aankde jutana; Bihar me survey ka kram - Purnea (1809-10), Bhagalpur (1810-11), Patna-Gaya (1811-12), Shahabad (1812-13); poora survey 1807 se 1815 tak chala.

qe: Among the Bihar districts surveyed in the early nineteenth century, which one was taken up first, in the season of 1809-10?
qh: 19वीं सदी के आरंभ में सर्वेक्षण किए गए बिहार के जिलों में सबसे पहले 1809-10 के मौसम में किस जिले का काम हुआ?
e: Bihar ke jilon ka vaigyanik-statistical survey ek kram me hua: sabse pehle Purnea jile ka kaam 1809-10 ke mausam me hua, uske baad Bhagalpur (1810-11), phir Patna tatha Gaya (1811-12) tatha ant me Shahabad (1812-13). Har jile ke liye tareeka yah tha ki sardiyon me afsar ghoom-phir kar jaankari jutate the, phir garami tatha barsaat ke mausam me kisi shahar me baith kar apni report taiyar karte the; isliye ek jile par lagbhag poora saal lag jata tha. Survey ke aise kram se pata chalta hai ki Purnea jaisa seemant tatha Kosi kshetra bhi company ke liye utna hi mahatvapurn tha jitna Patna ya Gaya, kyunki wahan bhi vyapar tatha Ganga-kinare ke bandargah the. Patna, Gaya tatha Shahabad is kram me baad me aate hain. Exam point: Bihar ka survey kram = Purnea (1809-10) sabse pehle, phir Bhagalpur (1810-11), Patna-Gaya (1811-12) tatha Shahabad (1812-13); har jile me sardiyon me daurra tatha baad me report taiyar hoti thi.

qe: In the hilly tracts visited during the early nineteenth-century survey of the Patna-Gaya area, mica mines were worked mainly by which method?
qh: पटना-गया क्षेत्र के 19वीं सदी के आरंभिक सर्वेक्षण में देखी गई पहाड़ी खानों में अभ्रक (mica) मुख्यतः किस विधि से निकाला जाता था?
oe: Vertical shafts, with ladders made of single bamboos
oh: खड़ी खदानें (shaft), जिनमें एक-एक बाँस की सीढ़ियाँ
e: Patna-Gaya kshetra ki pahadi patti me abhrak (mica) ki khanein kaafi purani thi tatha survey me yahan ki khanon ka varnan milta hai. Kaam karne ka tareeka bahut saral magar khatarnak tha: zameen me khadi khudai yaani shaft banai jaati thi tatha usme baans ki seedhiyan lagai jaati thi. Yah seedhiyan ek-ek baans (bamboo) ko kaat kar banai jaati thi, jisme uski daaliyan seedhiyan banane ka kaam karti thi; aisi seedhi banane me kharcha kam lagta tha. Mica ki khan ke aas-paas ka gaon kaafi garib tha tatha naye afsar ko dekh kar gaon ke log darr ke bhaag gaye the. Sabse badi samasya yah thi ki mica ke bade tukde yaani tables nikaalte waqt toot jaate the, isliye keemti mal ka nuksan hota tha tatha kaamgaron ki haalat kamzor hi rahi. Steam crane, dredging tatha gunpowder blasting us samay is kshetra me istemal nahi hote the. Exam point: Patna-Gaya kshetra ke survey me mica nikalne ka tarika = khadi khudai (shaft) tatha ek-ek baans ki seedhiyan; mica ke bade tukde yaani tables nikaalte waqt toot jaate the; naye afsar ko dekh kar gaon ke log bhaag gaye the.

qe: During the survey of the Patna-Gaya area, a trader of Akbarpur led the survey officer to the mine from which the people of the region used to procure rock crystal (phatik). That mine was near which village?
qh: पटना-गया क्षेत्र के सर्वेक्षण के दौरान अकबरपुर के एक व्यापारी ने सर्वेक्षण अफसर को उस खान तक पहुँचाया, जहाँ से क्षेत्र के लोग स्फटिक (phatik / rock crystal) लेते थे। वह खान किस गाँव के निकट थी?
e: Patna-Gaya kshetra me patthar tatha khanijon ki talaash purani rahi hai. Survey afsar Akbarpur pahunche, jo Kuri nadi ke baayen kinare par basa ek vyaparik gaon tha, jahan kai dukanein tatha vyapari the. Wahan ke ek vyapari ne bataya ki kshetra ke log rock crystal yaani phatik Buduya naam ke gaon ke nikat ek chhoti pahadi ki khan se lete hain tatha woh khud wahan ja chuka hai; usi vyapari ke saath chal kar afsar ne yah khan dekhi. Phatik ek saaf tatha chamakdar patthar hota hai, jise log ratna jaisa keemti maan kar puja tatha saja me istemal karte the. Aise vivaran se pata chalta hai ki us daur me pahadi kshetra ke log khanij nikaal kar aas-paas ke shahron ke vyapariyon ko bechte the tatha bahari logon ko yah jankari sirf sthanik vyapariyon ke zariye hi milti thi. Silao apne khaja ke liye, Sherghati apne sthan ke liye tatha Wazirganj mica ke liye jaane jaate hain, isliye yah vikalp is khan se mel nahi khate. Exam point: phatik (rock crystal) ka sthal = Buduya gaon, Akbarpur ke nikat; jankari Akbarpur ke ek vyapari ne di; Akbarpur Kuri nadi ke kinare basa vyaparik gaon tha tatha wahan ke log khanij vyapariyon ko bechte the.

qe: The black stone quarried from the Paterkati hill near Gaya in the early nineteenth century was chiefly used for making which items?
qh: 19वीं सदी के आरंभ में गया के निकट पत्थरकट्टी (Paterkati) पहाड़ी से निकाले गए काले पत्थर का मुख्य उपयोग किन वस्तुओं को बनाने में होता था?
e: Gaya ke nikat Paterkati, jise aaj Pattharkatti kaha jaata hai, us pahadi par kale potstone yaani kathor kale patthar ki khan thi. Is patthar ki khaas baat yah thi ki woh bahut kathor tatha bareek-dane wala tha, isliye usse mukhya roop se musal (pestle) tatha okhli (mortar) yaani kutne-pisne ke auzaar banaye jaate the. Usi kshetra me ek aur khan thi, jahan se nikalne wala patthar Gaya ke Vishnupad mandir ke nirman me kaam aaya; yah bataya jaata hai ki us kaam ke liye kaarigaron ko Jaynagar se bulaya gaya tha. Aise sthal dikhate hain ki 19vein sadi me bhi patthar ki khan tatha patthar tarashne ka kaam Gaya kshetra ka bada rozgaar tha, jiski parampara aaj Pattharkatti shilp ke roop me chalti hai. Sikke, kaanch ki chudiyan tatha loha banane ke liye anya dhatu tatha saamagri kaam aati thi. Is khan ki ek parampara bhi prachalit thi: kaha jaata tha ki sabse pehle yahan kaam Harchand Rajah ne shuru kiya, jinhone Rohtas ka kila tatha Barabar ki gufayen banwai thi; patthar bahut kathor milne par unhone yahan kaam chhod kar apne kaamgar dakshin bharat me Ellora bhej diye. Exam point: Paterkati yaani Pattharkatti pahadi (Gaya) ka kala potstone musal tatha okhli banane ke liye istemal hota tha; usi kshetra ka patthar Vishnupad mandir ke nirman me bhi kaam aaya tatha kaarigar Jaynagar se bulaye gaye; yah parampara aaj Pattharkatti shilp ke roop me chalti hai.

qe: Lime for the famous bridge at Fatuha was got from a hill near Gaya, as recorded in the survey of 1811-12. Which lime-bearing material was burnt for this purpose?
qh: प्रसिद्ध फतुहा पुल के लिए चूना गया के निकट की एक पहाड़ी से लिया गया था, जैसा 1811-12 के सर्वेक्षण में दर्ज हुआ। इसके लिए किस चूना-युक्त सामग्री को जलाया जाता था?
e: Survey ke aankdon me Gaya kshetra ki pahadiyon me chune wala safed padarth milta tha, jise calcareous marl kaha jaata hai. Ise jalane par achha chuna (lime) banta tha tatha yah chuna imaraton me jodne tatha plastar (plaster) banane ke kaam aata tha; yahan ke log is safed marl ko 'Chunapatar' kehte the. Isi chune ka ek bada upyog Fatuha ke pul ya bridge ke nirman me hua. Usi kshetra ki khanon me granite, marl, jasper tatha abhrak (mica) jaise kai khanij ek saath milte the, isliye Gaya ka yah ilaaka khanijon tatha patthar ke liye jaana jaata tha. Kale basalt, lal balua patthar tatha hornblende alag saamagri hain tatha inka is chune se seedha sambandh nahi hai. Exam point: Fatuha ke pul ke liye chuna Gaya ke nikat ki pahadi se liye gaye calcareous marl se banaya gaya; us kshetra me granite, marl, jasper tatha mica jaise khanij bhi milte the, isliye yah ilaaka khanijon ke liye jaana jaata tha.

qe: Islamabad, the residence of Sunder Khan, the elder brother of Kamgar, had a mud fort of what extent with a ditch and a wall strengthened with circular bastions?
qh: कमगर के बड़े भाई सुंदर खान का निवास इस्लामाबाद कितने विस्तार की मिट्टी की गढ़ी था, जिसमें खाई तथा गोल बुर्जों से मजबूत दीवार थी?
e: Patna kshetra ke sarvekshan me gaonon tatha gadhiyon ka bahut vistrit vivran milta hai, jisse us daur ke samajik tatha aarthik jeevan ka pata chalta hai. Islamabad naam ka gaon Sunder Khan ka nivas maana jaata tha, jo Kamgar ke bade bhai the. Pargane ka kaam Kamgar apni marzi se dekhte the. Islamabad ki mitti ki gadhi lagbhag teen sau gaj lambi tatha do sau gaj chaudi thi, jiske charon or khai thi tatha deewar par gol-gol burj yaani bastions lage the. Gadhi ke andar eenton ka ek bada ghar bhi tha, jiske aas-paas auraton ke liye alag mahal tatha chhote vargakar aangan ke charon or nahane ke khand bane the. Us gaon me kai Mussalman parivar rahte the tatha gaon khud ek theek-thak bada gaon maana jaata tha. Exam point: Islamabad gaon Sunder Khan ka nivas tha, jo Kamgar ke bade bhai the; uski mitti ki gadhi lagbhag 300 gaj lambi tatha 200 gaj chaudi thi, jisme khai tatha gol burjon wali deewar thi; gadhi ke andar eenton ka ghar, alag auraton ka mahal tatha chhote aangan ke charon or nahane ke khand bane the.

qe: What was built in the gateway of the mud fort at Islamabad, which stood finely on rising ground commanding a fine prospect?
qh: इस्लामाबाद की मिट्टी की गढ़ी के दरवाज़े में क्या बना हुआ था, जो ऊँची भूमि पर सुंदर दृश्य के साथ स्थित थी?
e: Patna kshetra ke gaonon me dharmik bhawanon ka sthan khaas hota tha tatha yah baat gadhiyon ke maamle me bhi dikhti hai. Islamabad ki gadhi Uchi zameen par bani thi, jahan se aas-paas ka poora drishya achhi tarah dikhta tha. Uske darwaze ke andar ek chhoti magar sundar masjid banwayi gayi thi, jo unke daurki puja ka kendra thi. Isi tarah kshetra me kai anya sthalon par bhi aise dharmik bhawan milte hain - jo us daur ke dharmik jeevan ke mahatvapurn kendra the. Gaon ke bahar kai tarah ke patthar milte the tatha gaon me kai Mussalman parivar rahte the. Aise vivran dikhate hain ki gadhi, masjid tatha gaon ek saath milkar ek aise samuday ka kendra banaate the jahan suraksha tatha puja dono ka prabandh hota tha. Exam point: Islamabad ki gadhi ke darwaze ke andar ek chhoti sundar masjid banwayi gayi thi; us gadhi se aas-paas ka poora drishya dikhta tha, kyunki woh uchi zameen par bani thi; gadhi tatha dharmik bhawan aksar saath-saath banaye jaate the, isliye woh ek aise samuday ke kendra the jahan suraksha tatha puja dono ka prabandh hota tha.

qe: What commission on the revenue did the Gidhaur family still receive, being all that zemindars under the Mughal Government could claim?
qh: गिधौर परिवार अब भी राजस्व पर कितना प्रतिशत कमीशन प्राप्त करता था, जो मुगल सरकार के अधीन ज़मींदारों का पूरा हक़ माना जाता था?
e: Is kshetra ke gaonon ke sarvekshan me rajasv vyavastha ke kuch mahatvapurn niyam bhi likhe mile the. Bishazari pargane ke asli swami maane jaane wale Gidhaur parivar ki mitti ki gadhi Lechuyar me thi tatha unka mukhya nivas Sekunderpur me tha. Us parivar ko ab bhi rajasv par das pratishat ka commission milta tha; itna hi hissa us samay ke zamindar Mughal sarkar ke antargat apna haq maan kar vasool kar sakte the. Yahi das pratishat ki daar us daur ki rajasv vyavastha ka mukhya aadhaar mani jaati thi - zamindar gaon ka rajasv vasool karta tha tatha usme se lagbhag dasva hissa apne paas rakhta tha. Sarvekshan afsar ne yah bhi darj kiya ki jab Bishazari pargana ek Mussalman ko altamgah ke roop me mila, to usne parivar ke nivas par bhi kabza kar liya; isse pata chalta hai ki altamgah ka adhikar kitna vyapak hota tha. Exam point: Gidhaur parivar ko rajasv par das pratishat ka commission milta tha, jo Mughal sarkar ke antargat zamindaron ka pura haq maana jaata tha; us parivar ki gadhi Lechuyar me thi tatha mukhya nivas Sekunderpur me; jab Bishazari pargana kisi Mussalman ko altamgah me mila, to usne parivar ke nivas par bhi kabza kar liya.

qe: When a Muhammadan obtained the pargana of Bishazari as an altamgha, what did he take possession of besides the lands?
qh: जब किसी मुसलमान को बिशाज़री परगना अल्तमग़ा के रूप में मिला, तो उसने ज़मीनों के अतिरिक्त किस पर भी कब्ज़ा कर लिया?
oe: Even the family residence of the Gidhaur family
oh: गिधौर परिवार का पारिवारिक निवास तक
e: Bishazari pargane ka itihas is baat ka achha udaharan hai ki us daur me zameen ka adhikar kaise haath badalta tha. Gidhaur parivar is pargane ke asli swami maane jaate the tatha unka nivas Lechuyar tatha Sekunderpur me tha. Jab yah pargana ek Mussalman ko altamgah ke roop me mila, to usne keval zameen par hi adhikar nahi kiya, balki parivar ke nivas par bhi kabza kar liya; itna hi nahi, usne Lechuyar ke purane makaan tatha gadhi ko jarda halat me chhod diya tatha Sekunderpur ke eenton ke kile me apna agent bitha diya. Isi parivar ko baad me bhi rajasv par das pratishat ka commission milta raha, jo us daur me zamindaron ka pura haq maana jaata tha. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki zameen ke saath-saath uspar bane makan tatha kilon ka adhikar bhi badal jaata tha. Exam point: Bishazari pargana altamgah me milne par us Mussalman ne zameen ke saath Gidhaur parivar ke nivas par bhi kabza kar liya; Lechuyar ke purane makaan tatha gadhi jarda halat me chhod di gayi tatha Sekunderpur ke eenton ke kile par agent bitha diya gaya; is parivar ko baad me bhi rajasv par das pratishat ka commission milta raha.

qe: Where was the principal residence of the Gidhaur family, in sight of Lechuyar towards the east, with a brick fort still in repair and occupied by the agent of the Muhammadan holder of Bishazari?
qh: लेछुयार से पूरब की ओर दिखाई देने वाला गिधौर परिवार का मुख्य निवास कहाँ था, जहाँ ईंटों का किला अब भी ठीक हालत में था तथा बिशाज़री के मुस्लिम धारक के एजेंट के कब्जे में था?
e: Lechuyar gaon ke aas-paas ke sthalon ka vivran us daur ke zameendari jeevan ka saaf chitra deta hai. Lechuyar me Gidhaur parivar ka purana makaan tatha mitti ki gadhi thi, lekin us parivar ka asli nivas Lechuyar se purab ki or dikhai dene wale Sekunderpur me tha. Wahan eenton ka ek kila tha, jo us daur me bhi theek-thak halat me tha tatha us par us Mussalman ke agent ka adhikar tha jise Bishazari pargana altamgah ke roop me mila tha. Aas-paas ke pahadi ilake me kai tarah ke patthar - jaise safed tatha bhoora quartz, anokha granite tatha jasper - milte the. Aise vivran dikhate hain ki ek chhote se ilake me bhi satta, zameen tatha bhu-banawat ki kai parat ek saath dikhti hain. Exam point: Gidhaur parivar ka mukhya nivas Lechuyar se purab Sekunderpur me tha; wahan eenton ka kila theek-thak halat me tha tatha uspar Bishazari ke Mussalman dharak ke agent ka adhikar tha; Lechuyar me parivar ka purana makaan tatha mitti ki gadhi thi tatha aas-paas kai tarah ke patthar milte the.

qe: Eyre Coote camped with his small force at the Company Bagh at Patna in July of which year?
qh: ईयर कूट अपनी छोटी सेना के साथ पटना के कंपनी बाग में जुलाई किस वर्ष डेरा डाला था?
e: Bankipore ka Company Bagh East India Company ne 1757 se bahut pehle hasil kar liya tha. July 1757 me Eyre Coote apni chhoti sena ke saath isi bagh me dere daale, tatha agle February (1758) me Clive apni sena ko yahin aaram karane ke liye laaye, isse pehle ki woh bagh ke saamne wale retile tapu par chale gaye. Us daur me bagh ke pashchim wali zameen 1757 se Company ki sena ke camping ground ke roop me istemal hoti thi tatha factory ke karmchari bagh ke bahar purab tatha dakshin me apne ghar banane lage. Aise vivaran se pata chalta hai ki Plassey ke aas-paas ke saalon me Patna tatha Bankipore angreji sena ki gatividhiyon ka mahatvapurn kendra ban gaye the. Exam point: Eyre Coote ne July 1757 me Company Bagh (Patna) me dere daale; agle February 1758 me Clive apni sena ke saath yahin ruke; Company ne yah bagh 1757 se bahut pehle hasil kiya tha.

qe: In the February following Eyre Coote's camp, which officer brought his army to rest at the Company Bagh before moving out to the sandy island opposite the garden?
qh: ईयर कूट के डेरे के बाद आने वाले फरवरी में कौन-सा अफसर अपनी सेना को कंपनी बाग में आराम कराने लाया तथा फिर बाग के सामने वाले रेतीले टापू की ओर बढ़ा?
e: Company Bagh ke pashchim wali zameen 1757 se Company ki sena ke camping ground ke roop me kaam aati thi. July 1757 me Eyre Coote apni chhoti sena ke saath yahan the tatha agle February (1758) me Robert Clive apni sena ko yahin aaram karane laaye, uske baad woh bagh ke saamne sthit retile tapu par chale gaye. Clive ne isi daur me Bengal me angreji prabhav ko mazboot kiya tha; Plassey (1757) ki vijay ke baad Buxar (1764) tatha 1765 ki diwani tak ka samay Patna kshetra ke liye nirnayak raha. Hector Munro ne Buxar ki ladai ladi thi tatha Major Adams ne 1763 me Patna ka kila liya tha, isliye woh is camping se nahi jude. Exam point: July 1757 me Eyre Coote tatha February 1758 me Robert Clive apni senaon ke saath Company Bagh (Patna) me ruke; isi bagh ke saamne wale retile tapu par Clive aage badhe; yah bagh angreji sena ka pramukh camping ground tha.

qe: The land west of the temple of Jagannath in the Company Bagh was appropriated in 1765 for which purpose?
qh: कंपनी बाग में जगन्नाथ मंदिर के पश्चिम की ज़मीन 1765 में किस काम के लिए ली गई थी?
oe: For a garden of the Nawab
For the Headquarters Staff of the army
oh: सेना के मुख्यालय स्टाफ के लिए
e: Company Bagh ke pashchim wali zameen pehle se Company ki sena ke camping ground ke roop me kaam aati thi. 1765 me jagannath mandir ke pashchim ki yah zameen sena ke Headquarters Staff tatha Commander-in-Chief ke liye li gayi, tatha Captain Thomas Watson ne wahin Commander-in-Chief ke liye ghar banana shuru kiya. Usi varsh 1765 me Monghyr angreji sena ke Commander-in-Chief ka headquarters station bana diya gaya tatha do saal baad Thomas Rambold ne Company Bagh ki military imaraton par Factory ki taraf se kabza kar liya. Iske baad yah staff house Patna me Company ki vyaparik gatividhiyon ka kendra ban gaya. Exam point: 1765 me jagannath mandir ke pashchim wali zameen Headquarters Staff ke liye li gayi tatha Captain Thomas Watson ne Commander-in-Chief ka ghar banana shuru kiya; usi varsh Monghyr Commander-in-Chief ka headquarters bana tatha do saal baad Thomas Rambold ne military imaraton par kabza kiya.

qe: In 1765 which station was made the headquarters of the Commander-in-Chief, after which the Patna staff house became the centre of the Company's commercial activities?
qh: 1765 में किस स्टेशन को कमांडर-इन-चीफ का मुख्यालय बनाया गया, जिसके बाद पटना का स्टाफ हाउस कंपनी की व्यापारिक गतिविधियों का केंद्र बन गया?
e: 1765 me Monghyr ko angreji sena ke Commander-in-Chief ka headquarters station bana diya gaya. Is badlav ke baad Patna ke Company Bagh me bana bada staff house us daur me Company ki vyaparik gatividhiyon ka kendra ban gaya, kyunki Company ka mukhya vyapar tatha uske karmchari wahin se kaam dekhte the. Jab Company ne baad me apna vyapar chhod diya, to yahi imarat shora (saltpetre) ka godown yaani shora kothi ban gayi tatha 1829 me Commercial Residency khatm hone par yah District Judge ki adalat ban gayi. Is tarah ek hi imarat ne sena, vyapar, godown tatha nyayalay - chaar alag roop dekhe. Exam point: 1765 me Monghyr Commander-in-Chief ka headquarters bana; uske baad Patna ka staff house Company ki vyaparik gatividhiyon ka kendra raha; baad me yahi imarat shora kothi tatha 1829 me District Judge ki adalat bani.

qe: After the Company's trade at Patna was abandoned, its old staff house in Company Bagh was used as a godown for which article?
qh: पटना में कंपनी का व्यापार बंद होने के बाद कंपनी बाग के उसके पुराने स्टाफ हाउस का गोदाम किस वस्तु के लिए इस्तेमाल होता था?
e: Patna tatha Fatuha kshetra shora yaani saltpetre ka bada kendra tha, jisse barood banaya jaata tha tatha Europe ke yuddhon ke samay iski maang bahut badhti thi. Company ne jab apna vyapar chhod diya, to Bankipore ke Company Bagh me bana bada staff house shora ka godown yaani shora kothi ke roop me istemal hone laga. 1829 me jab Commercial Residency khatm kar di gayi, to isi imarat ko District Judge ki adalat bana diya gaya tatha baad me yahan Munsifon ki adalatein bhi chalin. Aise tathy dikhate hain ki Patna kshetra ka vyaparik mahatva shora, afim tatha suti kapde par tika tha tatha ek hi imarat samay ke saath alag-alag kaam karti rahi. Exam point: Company ka vyapar chhoote hi uske staff house ko shora kothi yaani saltpetre ka godown banaya gaya; Patna-Fatuha kshetra shora ka bada kendra tha; 1829 me Commercial Residency khatm hone par imarat District Judge ki adalat bani.

qe: When the Commercial Residency was abolished in 1829, the old staff house in Company Bagh was made over to the court of which officer?
qh: 1829 में कामर्शियल रेसिडेंसी समाप्त होने पर कंपनी बाग के पुराने स्टाफ हाउस को किस अफसर की अदालत बना दिया गया?
e: Bankipore ke Company Bagh ka bada staff house kai roop badalta raha: pehle yah Company ki vyaparik gatividhiyon ka kendra tha, vyapar band hone par shora ka godown yaani shora kothi bana tatha 1829 me Commercial Residency samapt kar diye jaane par ise District Judge kee adalat bana diya gaya. Aage jab Dakshin ki taraf District Judge ki nayi adalat ban gayi, to purani imarat Munsifon ki adalaton ke kaam me aane lagi. Isi kshetra me Commercial Resident ke assistant ka 18vein sadi ka ghar bhi tha, jisme neeche godown tatha pehli manzil par rahne ki jagah banti thi. Exam point: 1829 me Commercial Residency khatm hone par purana staff house District Judge ki adalat bana; baad me nayi adalat banne par purani imarat Munsifon ki adalaton ke liye istemal hui; yah imarat pehle shora kothi ke roop me bhi kaam kar chuki thi.

qe: Sir Charles D'Oyly, who entertained Bishop Heber at Patna in 1824, held which post there at that time?
qh: 1824 में पटना में बिशप हेबर की मेजबानी करने वाले सर चार्ल्स डी'ओयली उस समय वहाँ किस पद पर थे?
e: 19vein sadi ke shuru me Bankipore ke Company Bagh ke purab wale ghar me afim ke agents Campbell tatha D'Oyly rehte the. Jab Sir Charles D'Oyly Bihar ke Opium Agent the, unhone 1824 me isi ghar me Bishop Heber ki mehmangiri ki thi. Bishop Heber ne 1824 me Patna kshetra ka daurra kiya tha tatha unhone Bankipore ki usi Court of Appeal me prachar bhi kiya thi, jise William Augustus Brooke ne 1787 me banwaya tha. Aise vivaran dikhate hain ki 19vein sadi ke pehle hisse me Bankipore angreji prashasan, vyapar tatha dharmik gatividhiyon ka bada kendra tha. Exam point: 1824 me Bankipore me Bishop Heber ki mehmangiri Sir Charles D'Oyly ne ki, jo us samay Bihar ke Opium Agent the; yah ghar Company Bagh ke purab me tha tatha wahan afim ke agents Campbell tatha D'Oyly rehte the.

qe: The old Court of Appeal at Bankipore, in which Bishop Heber preached in 1824, was built in 1787 by which officer?
qh: बांकीपुर की पुरानी कोर्ट ऑफ अपील, जिसमें बिशप हेबर ने 1824 में प्रचार किया था, 1787 में किस अफसर ने बनवाई थी?
e: Bankipore ki purani Court of Appeal ki imarat 1787 me William Augustus Brooke ne banwai thi; yah wahi Brooke the jo Patna ke Revenue Chief ke roop me kaam karte the. Isi imarat me 1824 me Bishop Heber ne prachar kiya tha. Aage chalti sadak ke us paar Collectorate ki imaratein hain; Ganga ki taraf wala hissa aaj bhi purani Court of Appeal ka bahari roop banaye hue hai, chahe uske andar ka design kaafi badal gaya ho. John Shore revenue settlement se jude the, Warren Hastings Governor-General the tatha William Tayler 1857 ke samay Patna ke Commissioner the. Exam point: Bankipore ki purani Court of Appeal 1787 me William Augustus Brooke ne banwai; usme 1824 me Bishop Heber ne prachar kiya; yah imarat Ganga ki taraf wala Collectorate kshetra me hai.

qe: Randfurlie Knox, who took command of the army on 9 December 1763 after Adams's health failed, was then on the banks of which river?
qh: एडम्स के स्वास्थ्य बिगड़ने पर 9 दिसंबर 1763 को सेना की कमान संभालने वाले रैंडफर्ली नॉक्स उस समय किस नदी के तट पर थे?
e: Randfurlie Knox 1763 ke poore vijay abhiyan ke dauran Quartermaster-General ke roop me kaam kar rahe the. 9 December 1763 ko Major Adams ke swasthya kharab hone ke kaaran unhone sena ki command sambhal li, aur us samay sena Karmanasa nadi ke tat par thi. Command ka samay bahut chhota raha; mahine ke ant tak woh itne bimar ho gaye ki ilaj ke liye Patna aaye, jahan Dr. Fullarton ki dekh-rekh me 28 January 1764 ko unka nidhan ho gaya tatha unki umar 34 saal thi. Unhe Commander-in-Chief ke ghar ke purab me dafnaya gaya; aaj unki kabar Ganga ke tat par Patna me maujood hai. Exam point: Randfurlie Knox ne 9 December 1763 ko Karmanasa nadi ke tat par sena ki command sambhali tatha 28 January 1764 ko 34 saal ki umar me Patna (Bankipore) me nidhan ho gaya; woh 1763 ke abhiyan me Quartermaster-General the.

qe: In October 1763, the English prisoners kept at Patna were put to death on the orders of which Nawab of Bengal, an event known as the Patna massacre?
qh: अक्टूबर 1763 में पटना में रखे अंग्रेज कैदियों को किस बंगाल के नवाब के आदेश पर मार डाला गया, जिसे 'पटना नरसंहार' कहा जाता है?
e: 1763 me Patna me angreji kaidiyon ka narsankhar Nawab Mir Kasim ke aadesh par hua. Us samay Mir Kasim Bangal ka Nawab tha tatha angrejon se lad raha tha. Jab angreji sena aage badh rahi thi tatha Patna par khatra badh raha tha, usne 5 October 1763 ko kaidiyon ko maar dene ka hukm diya. Nawab ke Hindustani sipahiyon tatha afsaron ne yah ghatiya kaam karne se inkar kar diya, isliye Walter Reinhardt, jise 'Somroo' kaha jaata tha, ne kuch logon ke saath mil kar yah kaam karaya. Isi tarah 11 October ko Chahal Situn me rakhe bimar tatha ghayal kaidiyon ko maara gaya, jinme sirf Dr. Fullarton bach paye. Yah ghatna dikhati hai ki us daur me Bihar ki rajdhani kshetra me angrej-Nawab sangharsh kitna tez tha. Exam point: Patna narsankhar = 5 October 1763, aadesh Nawab Mir Kasim ka; kaam Walter Reinhardt (Somroo) ne karaya; 11 October ko Chahal Situn ke bimar kaidi mare gaye, sirf Dr. Fullarton bache.

qe: After the fall of Patna in November 1763, Nawab Mir Kasim fled to which neighbouring region for shelter and help?
qh: नवंबर 1763 में पटना गिरने के बाद नवाब मीर कासिम किस पड़ोसी क्षेत्र में शरण तथा सहायता के लिए भागा?
e: 1763 me Patna ka kila angreji sena ke haath me chala gaya tatha Mir Kasim ko wahan se bagna pada. Woh Awadh ke Nawab Shuja-ud-daula ke paas pahuncha, jahan use ashray tatha sena ki madad mili. Patna par hamle ka netritva Major Adams ne kiya tha: 28 October 1763 ko angreji sena shahar ke saamne pahunchi, 5 November tak uttar-purab darwaze tatha purab taraf se deewar me chaid ban gaye tatha 6 November ko kila zabardasti haasil kar liya gaya. Kuch samay baad command Randfurlie Knox ko mili, lekin woh bimar the tatha 28 January 1764 ko Bankipore me unka nidhan ho gaya. Aage Mir Kasim, Awadh ke Nawab Shuja-ud-daula tatha Mughal badshah Shah Alam teeno ki sanyukt sena ne angrejon ka saamna kiya, jiska nateeja 1764 me Buxar ki nirnayak ladai me nikla. Nepal, Bangal tatha Kaimur pahadiyaan aise ashray ka sthal nahi thi. Exam point: Patna ka kila November 1763 me Major Adams ne liya; Mir Kasim Awadh (Shuja-ud-daula ke paas) bhaga; Randfurlie Knox ka nidhan 28 January 1764 ko Bankipore me hua.

qe: The decisive battle of Buxar (1764), which made the British masters of Bihar and Bengal, was won under the command of which British officer?
qh: बिहार तथा बंगाल में अंग्रेजों का प्रभुत्व स्थापित करने वाली बक्सर की निर्णायक लड़ाई (1764) किस अंग्रेज अफसर के नेतृत्व में जीती गई?
e: 23 October 1764 ko Buxar ki ladai me Major Hector Munro ki aguvai me angreji sena ne Mir Kasim, Awadh ke Nawab Shuja-ud-daula tatha Mughal badshah Shah Alam ki sanyukt sena ko poora hara diya. Isi vijay ke baad angrej Bihar tatha Bangal ke asli shasak ban gaye. Isse pehle 1763 me Patna ke paas bhi morche bane the, jahan Major Adams ne kila liya; uske baad March se May 1764 ke beech Carnac ki command me angreji sena ne kai morche sambhale. Robert Clive 1765 me Bangal aaye tatha unhone Bengal, Bihar tatha Orissa ki diwani hasil ki, saath hi prashasan me bade badlav kiye. Robert Barker tatha Warren Hastings is ladai ke sena-neta nahi the. Isliye sahi uttar Hector Munro hai. Exam point: Buxar ki ladai 23 October 1764 = angreji sena ke sardar Hector Munro; iske baad 1765 me Clive ne Bengal, Bihar tatha Orissa ki diwani hasil ki; Patna ka kila 1763 me Major Adams ne liya tha.

qe: During the famine of 1770, which naib diwan of Bihar proposed setting apart two lakh rupees for relief work at Patna?
qh: 1770 के अकाल के दौरान बिहार के किस नायब दीवान ने पटना में राहत-कार्य के लिए दो लाख रुपये अलग रखने का प्रस्ताव रखा?
e: 1769 ke ant me Bihar me akal ke sanket dikhne lage; patjhad (autumnal) ki barsaat waqt se pehle band ho jane se khadi fasalein nasht ho gayi. 1770 me Patna me halat itni kharab ho gayi ki Shitab Rai ne bataya ki roz pachas log bhookh se mar rahe hain, tatha aage ke vivaranon me ek din me ek sau pachas mauton ka zikr milta hai. Company ke naib diwan tatha Bihar ke bade adhikari Shitab Rai ne saaf taur par do lakh rupaye rahat-karya ke liye alag rakhne ka prastav rakha, lekin Calcutta ki sarkar ne na jimmedari li tatha na us prastav ko saaf manzoori di. Akal ke isi daur me 1770 me Patna ka Revenue Council banaya gaya, jiska president James Alexander the tatha Robert Palk tatha George Vansittart uske member the; Shitab Rai nizamat yaani prashasan ke prabhari rahe. November 1770 me raiyaton ne renters ke zulm ki shikayat ki, jis par council ne lagan ki uchchatam seema utpadan ke nau-solah hisson (9/16) par tay kar di. Phir bhi sarkar ne utpadan ka bada hissa lagan ke roop me lene ki kathor neeti jaari rakhi, jisse kisanon ki halat aur bigadi. Raja Ram Narayan ko Mir Kasim ne marwaya tha, Dheraj Narain usi ka bhai tha tatha Mir Kasim Nawab tha. Exam point: 1770 ki akal me Patna me roz 50 se 150 tak mauten hoti thi; Bihar ke naib diwan Shitab Rai ne 2 lakh rupaye rahat-karya ka prastav diya; Calcutta ki sarkar ne yah prastav turant manzoor nahi kiya.

qe: Which three dangers for Pataliputra did the Buddha foretell when he visited the fortified village of Patali on the Ganga?
qh: गंगा किनारे पाटली गाँव में जाने पर बुद्ध ने पाटलिपुत्र के लिए किन तीन खतरों की भविष्यवाणी की थी?
e: Ajatashatru ne Lichchhavi ganrajya ko qaboo me rakhne ke liye Ganga ke dakshin tat par Patali gaon me ek kila banwaya tha. Apni mrityu se kuch maheene pehle Bhagwan Buddha yahan aaye tatha unhone is kila-bandh gaon ke liye bhavishyavani ki, bharat ke sabhi prasiddh sthalon tatha vyapar ke kendron me Pataliputra sabse bada hoga, lekin ise teen khatre ghere rahenge - aag, baadh tatha aapas ka jhagda. Lagbhag aadhe shatabdi baad Ajatashatru ke pote Udayin ne rajdhani Rajgir se yahin sthanantarit kar di, kyunki vyapar tatha raksha ki drishti se Ganga-kinara yah sthal sabse upyukt tha. Aage yahi shahar Maurya, Gupta tatha Pala kaalon me bharat ke rajnetik kendra ke roop me chamka tatha aaj Bihar ki rajdhani Patna usi sthal par basa hai. Aise varnan prachin sahitya tatha Bauddh parampara se milte hain. Exam point: Buddha ki bhavishyavani = Pataliputra ke liye teen khatre - aag, baadh tatha aapas ka jhagda; kila Ajatashatru ne Patali gaon me banwaya tatha Udayin ne rajdhani Rajgir se Pataliputra sthanantarit ki.

qe: In which year was Patna renamed Azimabad, after a Mughal prince who was then governor of the area?
qh: किस वर्ष पटना का नाम 'आजिमाबाद' रखा गया, जो उस समय यहाँ के गवर्नर रहे एक मुगल शहज़ादे के नाम पर था?
e: Aurangzeb ke pote Shahzade Azim-us-Shan (Muhammad Azim) jab Bihar ke gavarnar the, tab unhone Patna ka naam badal kar Azimabad rakh diya; yah ghatna lagbhag 1704 ki maani jaati hai. Us daur se pehle Patna par Daud Khan jaise gavarnaron ke vidroh, Maratha hamle tatha vyapari companies ke aagman jaise kai jhatke pade the, isliye shahar ki deewar tatha kila-bandi ko baar-baar theek karana pada. Azimabad ka naam zyada samay tak nahi chala; angreji kaal tatha aaj bhi shahar Patna hi kehlata hai, lekin kuch bazar tatha mohalle abhi bhi Azimabad naam se jaane jaate hain. Diye gaye anya varsh alag ghatnaon se jude hain - 1658 Shahjahan ke uttaradhikar ke sangharsh ka, 1739 Nadir Shah ke hamle ka tatha 1761 Panipat ki ladai ka. Isliye sahi uttar 1704 hai. Exam point: Patna ka naam Azimabad = lagbhag 1704, Shahzade Azim-us-Shan (Aurangzeb ke pote) dwara; woh us samay Bihar ke gavarnar the; aaj bhi kuch bazar-mohalle Azimabad naam se jaane jaate hain.

qe: During the 1857 revolt, European residents of Bankipore near Patna gathered for safety at which garden house, then the residence of Commissioner William Tayler?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह के दौरान पटना के निकट बांकीपुर के यूरोपीय निवासी सुरक्षा के लिए किस बाग-भवन में एकत्र हुए थे, जो उस समय कमिश्नर विलियम टेलर का निवास था?
e: 1857 ke vidroh ke dauran Patna mandal ke Commissioner William Tayler Bankipore ke Chajju Bagh bhawan me rehte the. Dinapur se khatre ki khabar milne par 7 June 1857 ko Bankipore ke European nivasi tay yojna ke mutabik Chajju Bagh me ikattha ho gaye tatha woh raat badee ashanti tatha chinta me kati, kyunki pahredari me lage kuch sipahi tatha Holmes ke kuch sowar shakkiy maane ja rahe the. Agle din, 8 June ki subah 4 baje, Captain Rattray apne Sikh sipahiyon ke saath pahunch gaye, jisse wah raat ke baad logon ko suraksha mili. 18 June ko Tayler ne isi Chajju Bagh se Maulaviyon ko giraftar kiya. Gulzar Bagh, Company Bagh tatha Jafar Khan ka bagh anya sthal hain, jahan aisi ikattha-gathering nahi hui. Exam point: 1857 me Bankipore ke European nivasi 7 June ko Chajju Bagh (Commissioner William Tayler ka nivas) me ikattha hue; 8 June ko Captain Rattray Sikh sipahiyon ke saath pahunche; 18 June ko Maulaviyon ki giraftari wahi se hui.

qe: In September 1781, which leader, at the head of five thousand followers, began to plunder the country around Patna and was routed by Captain Powell in the Guma pass?
qh: सितंबर 1781 में कौन-सा नेता पाँच हजार अनुयायियों के साथ पटना के आसपास लूटपाट करने लगा था, जिसे कैप्टन पॉवेल ने गुमा दर्रे में हराया?
e: 22 August 1781 ko Patna me Chait Singh ke vidroh ki khabar pahunchi, jisse shahar me kaafi halchal hui; Chait Singh Banaras ke zamindar the, jinhone angreji sarkar ke viruddh bagawat ki thi. Patna tatha aas-paas ke kshetra me unke paksh me kuch logon ne saazish bhi ki, lekin khul kar saath dene wale do bade zamindar hi the - Siris-Kutumba ke Narain Singh tatha Hasua parivar se jude Iqbal Ali Khan. Narain Singh ne apni zamindari par sena khadi ki tatha Captain James Crawfurd ki Grand Trunk Road par badhne wali sena ka saamna karne ki koshish ki. Iske baad September 1781 me Iqbal Ali Khan paanch hazaar anuyayiyon ke saath kshetra me lootpat shuru kar di. Captain Powell ne Dinapore se teen companies ke saath Rajauli ke paas Guma darre me unhe poora hara diya; Iqbal Ali Khan Kharakdiha bhaag gaya tatha aage Delhi chala gaya. Aise vidroh dikhate hain ki Permanent Settlement se pehle Bihar me zamindari parivaron ki apni sena tatha sarkari faujdon ke beech takrao aam baat thi. Exam point: 1781 me Chait Singh ke vidroh ka asar Patna tak pahuncha; khul kar saath dene wale bade zamindar = Narain Singh tatha Iqbal Ali Khan; Iqbal Ali Khan paanch hazaar anuyayiyon ke saath lootpat karta hua Captain Powell dwara Guma darre (Rajauli ke paas) me hara diya gaya tatha woh Kharakdiha hokar Delhi chala gaya.

qe: The Permanent Settlement, whose working in Bihar began in the last decade of the 18th century, was introduced by which Governor-General?
qh: बिहार में जिसका कार्य 18वीं सदी के अंतिम दशक में शुरू हुआ, वह स्थायी बंदोबस्त किस गवर्नर-जनरल ने लागू किया?
e: Permanent Settlement yaani sthai bandobast 1793 me Lord Cornwallis ke samay lagu hua. Is vyavastha me zamindaron ko jameen ki milkiyat tatha nirdharit lagan dene ki jimmedari di gayi; badle me sarkar ko har saal utni hi lagan milti thi, chahe fasal achhi ho ya kharab. Bihar me iski prakriya 18vein sadi ke antim dashak me chali tatha aage naye kshetron me record-of-rights banaye gaye, jisse zamindar, raiyat tatha kashtkar ke adhikar likhit roop me darj hue. Isse pehle 1765 me Bengal, Bihar tatha Orissa ki diwani angrejon ko mili thi tatha uske baad ke saalon me lagan-nirdharan tatha mukarrari bandobast jaise kai kadam liye gaye. Sthir lagan se zamindaron ko faayda hua, lekin chhote kisanon tatha bataidaron par dabav bhi badha, jo aage kisan andolanon ki ek vajah bana. Warren Hastings diwani lene se jude the tatha Wellesley tatha Dalhousie ki neetiyan alag thi. Exam point: Permanent Settlement 1793 = Lord Cornwallis; zamindaron ko jameen ki milkiyat tatha nirdharit lagan; Bihar me iski prakriya 18vein sadi ke antim dashak me; record-of-rights se adhikar likhit roop me darj hue.

qe: The Directors' despatch of 1772, announcing the intention of the Company to stand forth as Diwan, ordered the removal of which officer who was in general charge of the nizamat administration at Patna?
qh: 1772 के डायरेक्टर्स के पत्र ने, जिसमें कंपनी के 'खुद दीवान बन खड़े होने' का इरादा जताया गया था, पटना में निजामत प्रशासन के सामान्य प्रभारी किस अफसर को हटाने का आदेश दिया?
e: 1770 me Patna Revenue Council banaya gaya, jiska president James Alexander the, lekin nizamat yaani sarkari prashasan ke prabhari Shitab Rai hi rahe tatha waqt ke saath council revenue ke muddon me dakhal dene lagi. 1772 me Company ke Directors ne apna prasiddh patra bheja, jisme unka iraada zaahir hua ki Company khud Diwan ban kar khadi hogi tatha revenue ka poora kaam apne haath me legi. Isi patra ke aadhaar par Shitab Rai ko uske pad se hatane ka aadesh hua, lekin local council tatha Warren Hastings ne unhe samman ke saath hataaya; unhe Calcutta bheja gaya, jahan jaanch ke baad unhone izzat ke saath wapsi pai tatha ant me unhe phir se niyukt kar diya gaya. Woh 1773 me Patna laut kar aaye tatha kuch hi samay baad unka nidhan ho gaya. Exam point: 1772 ke Directors ke patra me Company ka 'khud Diwan ban kar khade hone' ka iraada tha tatha Shitab Rai ko pad se hatane ka aadesh diya gaya; jaanch ke baad unhe phir niyukt kiya gaya; woh 1773 me Patna me hi chale gaye.

qe: After the death of Shitab Rai in 1773, his son was appointed Rai-raiyan of Bihar with an annual salary of fifty thousand rupees. Name him.
qh: 1773 में शिताब राय की मृत्यु के बाद उनके पुत्र को सालाना पचास हजार रुपये के वेतन पर बिहार का राय-रायान बनाया गया। उसका नाम क्या था?
e: Shitab Rai 1756 se Patna kshetra ke bahut prabhavshali adhikari rahe the; ve naib diwan ke roop me Bihar me sarkar ke mukhya pratinidhi the. 1772 me Directors ke patra ke baad unhe pad se hataya gaya tatha jaanch ke liye Calcutta bheja gaya, lekin jaanch me woh samman ke saath ubhre tatha ant me unhe phir niyukt kar diya gaya. 1773 me Patna lautne ke kuch samay baad hi unka nidhan ho gaya, jiske baad unke putra Kallian Singh ko Bihar ka Rai-raiyan banaya gaya tatha unhe saalana pachas hazaar rupaye ka vetan tay hua. Shitab Rai ke naibon ko bhi phir se niyukt kiya gaya, jinme Khiali Ram Agarwala bhi the tatha unke vanshaj Patna me aaj bhi hain. Exam point: Shitab Rai ke nidhan (1773) ke baad unke putra Kallian Singh Bihar ke Rai-raiyan bane tatha unka saalana vetan pachas hazaar rupaye tha; Shitab Rai ke naibon me Khiali Ram Agarwala bhi the.

qe: When the Patna Revenue Council was abolished in 1781, the Rai-raiyan took the farm of the whole province of Bihar and divided it with which naib?
qh: जब 1781 में पटना रेवेन्यू काउंसिल समाप्त की गई, तब राय-रायान ने पूरे बिहार प्रांत का ठेका लेकर उसे किस नायब के साथ बाँटा?
e: Patna Revenue Council ka kaam santoshjanak na hone ke kaaran 1781 me council samapt kar di gayi tatha poore Bihar prant ka ijara (farm) Rai-raiyan ne le liya, jise usne apne naib Khiali Ram Agarwala ke saath baant liya. Khiali Ram ko jo pargane mile, unme Bihar ke sabse ujad tatha kam base ilake bhi the, isliye 1781 ke patjhad ke vidroh se unke liye lagan jama karana bahut mushkil ho gaya. Saal ke ant tak woh bakaya ke kaaran kaid me daal diye gaye tatha unse unki niji sampatti se rakam nikalne ki koshish ki gayi. Kallian Singh bhi un parganon me safal nahi hue, unki doosri kist se hi bakaya shuru ho gaya; ant me 1783 me yah prayog chhod diya gaya tatha John Shore Patna aaye. Exam point: 1781 me Patna Revenue Council samapt hui tatha poore Bihar prant ka ijara Rai-raiyan (Kallian Singh) ne le kar apne naib Khiali Ram ke saath baanta; Khiali Ram ke parganon me sabse ujad ilake the, isliye bakaya ho gaya tatha 1783 me yah prayog samapt ho gaya.

qe: The complaint of the raiyats on 5 November 1770 led the Revenue Council of Patna to fix the maximum rent at what fraction of the produce?
qh: 5 नवंबर 1770 को रैयतों की शिकायत के बाद पटना रेवेन्यू काउंसिल ने अधिकतम लगान उपज के किस भाग पर तय किया?
e: 1770 me Patna me Revenue Council banai gayi thi tatha usne revenue ke muddon me sakriyata se dakhal dena shuru kiya. 5 November 1770 ko raiyaton yaani kisanon ki ek badi sankhya ne renters yaani ijaredaron ke zulm tatha zyada vasooli ki shikayat ki. Is par council ne faisla kiya ki lagan utpadan ke nau-solah hisson (9/16) se zyada nahi li jayegi tatha ijaredaron se likh kar wada liya gaya ki woh is se zyada vasooli nahi karenge. Isi niyam ko dakshin Bihar ki purani manyata ka aadhaar maana jaata hai ki lagan utpadan ka nau-solah hissa rehti hai; yeh bhi mana jaata hai ki 1781 ke kabuliyaton me vasooli ki rok ke niyam ke chhoot jane se bakaya badha. Exam point: 5 November 1770 ko raiyaton ki shikayat par Patna Revenue Council ne lagan ki uchchatam seema utpadan ke nau-solah hisson (9/16) par tay ki; ijaredaron se likh kar wada liya gaya; yah niyam dakshin Bihar ki purani lagan-manyata ka aadhaar bana.

qe: Who was the President of the Revenue Council appointed at Patna in 1770?
qh: 1770 में पटना में नियुक्त रेवेन्यू काउंसिल का अध्यक्ष कौन था?
e: 1770 me prashasan ki vyavastha badal kar Patna me ek Revenue Council banai gayi, jiska president James Alexander ko banaya gaya tatha Robert Palk tatha George Vansittart uske members the. Is council ko revenue ke muddon me naib diwan par adhikar diya gaya, jabki nizamat yaani sarkari prashasan ka samanya prabhar Shitab Rai ke paas hi raha. Council ne saal ke ant me raiyaton ki shikayaton par sunwai ki tatha lagan ki uchchatam seema tay ki. Aage ke varshon me council ke kai badle huye presidents rahe, jinme Richard Barwell, John Graham, George Vansittart, George Hurst, Thomas Lane, Robert Palk, Isaac Sage, Ewan Law tatha William Maxwell ke naam aate hain; 1781 me council ko hi samapt kar diya gaya. Exam point: 1770 me Patna Revenue Council ke president James Alexander the tatha Robert Palk tatha George Vansittart member the; council ko revenue ke muddon me adhikar mila tatha Shitab Rai nizamat ke prabhari rahe; 1781 me council samapt kar di gayi.

qe: In 1788, which officer broke up the estate of Iqbal Ali Khan and made a permanent settlement village by village with maliks and small farmers?
qh: 1788 में किस अफसर ने इकबाल अली खान की जागीर तोड़कर मालिकों तथा छोटे काश्तकारों के साथ गाँव-गाँव स्थायी बंदोबस्त कर दिया?
e: 1781 ke vidroh ke baad Iqbal Ali Khan Kharakdiha hokar Delhi chala gaya tatha uski Rajgir tatha Amarthu wali jagirein doosre adhikari ko de di gayin. 1784 ke ant me jab use Patna lautne ki anumati mili, tab tak uski bachi hui jagir John Shore ke settlement ke tahet ijaredaron ke paas thi. Yeh ijare 1788 tak chalte rahe; us saal ijaredaron ke bakaya ke kaaran Thomas Law ne us jagir ko poora tod kar gaon-gaon me malikon tatha chhote kisanon ke saath permanent settlement kar diya, jisme har gaon ka alag bandobast hua. Iqbal Ali Khan ka 1800 me nidhan hua tatha unke koi vaidh vanshaj nahi rahe. Exam point: 1788 me Thomas Law ne Iqbal Ali Khan ki jagir ko tod kar gaon-gaon me malikon tatha chhote kisanon ke saath permanent settlement kiya; Iqbal Ali Khan ka nidhan 1800 me hua; uski Rajgir-Amarthu wali jagirein pehle doosre adhikari ko mili thi.

qe: The estates of Iqbal Ali Khan in Rajgir and Amarthu were granted after his revolt to Ali Ibrahim Khan, who had tried to prevent which event of 1763?
qh: इकबाल अली खान की राजगीर तथा अमरथू वाली जागीरें उसके विद्रोह के बाद अली इब्राहिम खान को दी गईं, जिन्होंने 1763 की किस घटना को रोकने की कोशिश की थी?
oe: The mutiny of officers at Bankipore
e: 1781 ke vidroh me Iqbal Ali Khan paanch hazaar anuyayiyon ke saath lootpat karta hua Captain Powell dwara Guma darre me hara diya gaya tatha woh Kharakdiha hokar Delhi chala gaya. Patna kshetra me uski Rajgir tatha Amarthu wali jagirein us daur ke ek prabhavshali adhikari Ali Ibrahim Khan ko de di gayin. Ali Ibrahim Khan ka naam isliye bhi yaad rakha jaata hai ki unhone 1763 me Patna me angreji kaidiyon ko bachane ki koshish ki thi, tatha ve Warren Hastings ke saath Benaras ki yatra me bhi gaye the. Unke bhai ke vanshaj aaj bhi Nawab of Husainabad ke naam se jaane jaate hain tatha wahi sampatti rakhte hain. Exam point: 1781 ke vidroh ke baad Iqbal Ali Khan ki Rajgir tatha Amarthu wali jagirein Ali Ibrahim Khan ko milin, jinhone 1763 me Patna narsankhar rokne ki koshish ki thi; unke bhai ke vanshaj Nawab of Husainabad ke naam se jaane jaate hain.

qe: Rennell's map of south Bihar specially showed which two zamindaris, as if they were semi-independent states?
qh: दक्षिण बिहार के रेनल के नक्शे में किन दो जमींदारियों को विशेष रूप से दिखाया गया था, मानो वे अर्ध-स्वतंत्र राज्य हों?
e: Angreji kaal ke shuru me dakshin Bihar ki kuch zamindariyan itni prabhavshali thi ki unhe lagbhag chhote rajya jaisa darja prapt tha. Rennell ke dakshin Bihar ke nakshe me Narhat-Samai tatha Siris-Kutumba ki zamindariyan vishesh roop se dikhayi gayi thin, mano woh ardh-svatantra rajya hon. Aage ke saalon me dono hi zamindariyan vidroh ka srot banin: Narhat-Samai ke Kamgar Khan tatha unke parivar ke log Nawab ki sarkar ke viruddh khade rahe, tatha Siris-Kutumba ke Narain Singh ne 1781 me Chait Singh ka saath diya. Isliye Rennell ke nakshe ka yah vishleshan aage ki ghatnaon se sahi sabit hua. Exam point: Rennell ke dakshin Bihar ke nakshe me Narhat-Samai tatha Siris-Kutumba ki zamindariyan vishesh roop se dikhayi gayi thin, mano woh ardh-svatantra rajya hon; Kamgar Khan Narhat-Samai se tatha Narain Singh Siris-Kutumba se jude the; dono ne aage vidroh me hissa liya.

qe: Who came to Patna in 1783 and made a re-settlement of revenue for a term of three years after the experiment of farming out the province failed?
qh: प्रांत को ठेके पर देने का प्रयोग विफल होने पर 1783 में पटना आकर तीन वर्ष की अवधि के लिए राजस्व का पुनर्निर्धारण किसने किया?
e: 1781 me Patna Revenue Council samapt hone ke baad poore Bihar prant ka ijara Rai-raiyan tatha unke naib Khiali Ram ne liya, lekin 1781 ke patjhad ke vidroh tatha bakaya ke kaaran yah prayog safal nahi hua; Khiali Ram bakaya ke kaaran kaid me daal diye gaye tatha Kallian Singh ki doosri kist se hi bakaya shuru ho gaya. Ant me 1783 me yah prayog chhod diya gaya tatha John Shore Patna aaye, jinhone revenue ka naya settlement teen saal ke liye kiya. Ye settlement kisi sahi assets yaani aamdani ke aakdon par aadhaarit nahi tha, isliye ise saal-dar-saal badhaya jaata raha tatha aage Decennial Settlement tak chala. Isi daur me Patna se Calcutta jaate samay Shore ne bade bhandaron ki yojna bhi rakhi thi. Exam point: 1783 me John Shore Patna aaye tatha unhone teen saal ke liye revenue ka naya settlement kiya; yah farming experiment ki asafalta ke baad hua; yeh settlement sahi assets ke aakdon par aadhaarit na hone se saal-dar-saal badhta raha.

qe: Mustafa Khan, whose body was cut in two and half of it hung at each of the two gates of old Patna's wall, was a rebellious general of which Nawab?
qh: पुराने पटना की दीवार के दोनों दरवाज़ों पर जिसका शरीर दो टुकड़ों में लटकाया गया था, वह मुस्तफा खान किस नवाब का विद्रोही सेनापति था?
e: Purane Patna ki deewar ke purabi tatha pashchimi darwaze ab bhi patthar ke nishanon se pehchane jaate hain. Us daur me jab koi bada vidrohi senapati pakda jaata ya maara jaata, to uske shareer ke do tukde kar ke ek tukda ek darwaze par tatha doosra doosre darwaze par latka diya jaata tha, taaki sab log dekh kar darr jaayein. Mustafa Khan Alivardi Khan ka vidrohi senapati tha; uske maare jaane par usi tarah uske shareer ke do tukde kar ke dono darwazon par latka diye gaye the. Kai saal baad, 1748 me Zain-ud-din ki Afghan logon dwara hatya ke baad uske saath bhi aisa hi kiya gaya. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki 18vein sadi ke Patna me shahar ki deewar sirf suraksha ka sadhan nahi thi, balki satta tatha darr dikhane ka sthal bhi thi. Exam point: vidrohi senapati Mustafa Khan ke shareer ke do tukde Patna ki deewar ke dono darwazon par latkaye gaye the tatha 1748 me Zain-ud-din ke saath bhi aisa hi hua; Mustafa Khan Alivardi Khan ka vidrohi senapati tha.

qe: Of the four great towers at the corners of Patna's old city wall, the one strengthened in 1763 to command the neighbouring English factory was demolished in which year?
qh: पटना की पुरानी शहरपनाह के चारों कोनों के बड़े बुर्जों में, जिसे 1763 में पास की अंग्रेज फैक्ट्री पर नियंत्रण के लिए मज़बूत किया गया था, वह किस वर्ष गिरा दिया गया?
e: Purane Patna ki deewar ke chaar kono par chaar bade burj the. Unme se teen burj aaj bhi bache hue hain - ek kila ke purab me Ganga ke kinare, doosra Patna City railway station ke kareeb tatha teesra Gulzarbagh railway station ke purab me. Chautha burj, jo 1763 me angreji factory par nazar rakhne ke liye mazboot kiya gaya tha, 1857 ke vidroh ke dauran gira diya gaya tatha ab maujood nahi hai. Is tarah Patna ki purani suraksha-vyavastha ke nishaan dhire-dhire mit gaye; aaj bhi purani deewar ki line zameen par aasani se pehchani ja sakti hai. Aisi jankari dikhati hai ki 18vein tatha 19vein sadi me shahar ki raksha deewar, khai tatha burjon par nirbhar thi, isliye jab yeh vyavastha kamzor padi to shahar bahari hamlon ke liye khula ho gaya. Exam point: Patna ki purani deewar ke chaar kono ke burjon me teen aaj bhi maujood hain; 1763 me angreji factory ke liye mazboot kiya gaya chautha burj 1857 me gira diya gaya; purani deewar ki line aaj bhi pehchani ja sakti hai.

qe: How many of the great towers that stood at the four corners of Patna's old city wall still exist?
qh: पटना की पुरानी शहरपनाह के चारों कोनों पर खड़े बड़े बुर्जों में से कितने आज भी मौजूद हैं?
e: Patna ki purani deewar mukhya roop se mitti ki thi, isliye use baar-baar marammat ki zarurat padti thi. Deewar ke chaar kono par chaar bade burj the, jinse shahar ki raksha hoti thi. Aaj unme se teen burj bache hue hain: ek kila ke purab me Ganga ke kinare, doosra Patna City railway station ke kareeb tatha teesra Gulzarbagh railway station ke purab me. Chauthe burj ko, jo 1763 me angreji factory par nazar rakhne ke liye mazboot kiya gaya tha, 1857 me gira diya gaya. Zain-ud-din ne deewar ke chaaron taraf gehri khai khudwai tatha mitti se deewar ko oonchi tatha mazboot karwaya; Maratha hamlon ke samay log isi deewar ke andar panah lete the tatha bahar ke ghar bhi burjon ki topon se surakshit rahte the. 1772 me deewar ek baar phir marammat karai gayi, kintu uske baad use dhyan nahi diya gaya. Exam point: Patna ki purani deewar ke chaar kono ke burjon me se teen aaj bhi maujood hain; yah deewar mukhya roop se mitti ki thi tatha Maratha hamlon ke samay log isi ke andar panah lete the; 1763 me mazboot chautha burj 1857 me gir gaya.

qe: The beehive-shaped granary at Bankipore, with two staircases on the outside winding to the top, stands how high?
qh: बांकीपुर का मधुमक्खी-छत्ते जैसा अनाज-भंडार, जिसकी बाहर दो सीढ़ियाँ घूमती हुई ऊपर तक जाती हैं, कितना ऊँचा है?
e: Bankipore ka gola yaani Golghar ek madhumakkhi ke chhatte jaisa bada anaj-bhandar hai, jise 1786 me John Garstin ne banwaya tha. Iski unchai 96 feet hai tatha neeche ki taraf iski deewarein 12 feet moti hain; bahar do seedhiyan ghoomti hui chhat tak jaati hain, jahan se Ganga tatha poore shahar ka sundar nazara dikhta hai. Is imarat ki ek khaas baat uske andar ka goonjta hua echo hai, isliye yahan aawaz kai baar laut kar sunai deti hai. Golghar banane ka uddeshya 1770 ki bhayankar akal jaisi vipatti me anaj ka bada bhandar rakhna tha, taaki aage kisi akal me log bhookh se na marein; isliye ise akal tatha bhookh se bachaav ki soch ka prateek maana jaata hai. Exam point: Golghar ki unchai 96 feet tatha neeche ki deewaron ki motai 12 feet hai; bahar do ghoomti hui seedhiyan hain; yah 1786 me John Garstin dwara Bankipore me anaj-bhandar ke roop me banaya gaya.

qe: The scheme for building a number of granaries, to be kept filled in anticipation of scarcity, was put forward in 1783 by which officer?
qh: अकाल की आशंका में भरे रखने योग्य अनेक अनाज-भंडार बनाने की योजना 1783 में किस अफसर ने रखी थी?
e: 1783 me Patna kshetra me akal ka bhay phir se jaga, kyunki 1770 ki bhayankar akal ki yaadein logon ke zehen me taaza thi. Us saal John Shore Patna se Calcutta wapas ja rahe the, to unhone ek yojna rakhi ki kai bade anaj-bhandar (granaries) banaye jaayein tatha unhe akal ki ashanka ke samay bhara rakha jaaye. Isi soch se 1786 me Bankipore me bada gola yaani Golghar banaya gaya, jispar yah bhi likha gaya ki yah bhookh ko hamesha ke liye rokne ke liye banwaya gaya hai. Lekin bhandar ban jane ke baad usme kabhi anaj nahi bhara gaya tatha aisi aur granaries bhi nahi banai gayin, isliye Golghar 1783 ki is tanqidi tatha 1770 ki akal ke bhaye ka yaadgar ban kar rah gaya. John Garstin ne 1786 me Golghar banwaya tha, Warren Hastings us daur ke Governor-General the tatha William Tayler 1857 me Patna ke Commissioner the. Exam point: anaj-bhandaron yaani granaries ki yojna 1783 me John Shore ne rakhi; Golghar 1786 me banwaya gaya, kintu usme anaj kabhi bhara nahi gaya tatha aisi aur granaries nahi banai gayin.

qe: The famous mutiny of officers at the Bankipore cantonments in 1766 was occasioned by discontent at the abolition of what?
qh: 1766 में बांकीपुर छावनी में अफसरों का प्रसिद्ध विद्रोह किस चीज़ को समाप्त किए जाने से हुए असंतोष के कारण हुआ था?
e: 1765 me Clive ke nirdesh par Ganga ke kinare Bankipore me Third Brigade ki nayi chhawni banai gayi. Agle varsh 1766 me isi chhawni me angreji afsaron ka prasiddh vidroh hua, jiska mukhya karan 'double batta' yaani yuddh ke samay milne wala dohra bhatta khatm kar diya jaana tha. Is faisle se naraz hokar bahut se afsar apne commission chhodne ki dhamki dene lage tatha vidroh ke dauran chhawni ke kai bungalow jal bhi gaye; jaanch me pata chala ki aag ek jhagde me palat gaye lamp se lagi thi, jo ek aise afsar se hua kar raha tha jo apna commission wapas karne ko taiyar nahi tha. Afsaron ne ek saath apne commission chhod diye, lekin Brigade ke commandar Sir Robert Barker ke prabhav se unhe apni duty chhodne se rok liya gaya tatha 20 May ko Clive Bankipore pahunche, tab unhone aagya maan li. Exam point: Bankipore ki chhawni 1765 me Clive ke nirdesh par bani; 1766 ka afsar-vidroh double batta khatm hone ke viruddh tha; Sir Robert Barker ne afsaron ko kaabu me rakha tatha 20 May ko Clive ke aane par sab ne aagya maan li.

qe: The old cantonments of the Third Brigade on the river-front at Bankipore were built in 1765 under whose directions?
qh: बांकीपुर में गंगा-तट पर तीसरी ब्रिगेड की पुरानी छावनी 1765 में किसके निर्देश पर बनाई गई थी?
e: 1765 me Clive ke nirdesh par Bankipore me Ganga ke kinare Third Brigade ki chhawni banai gayi. Yah wahi saal tha jab Buxar ki vijay ke baad angrejon ne Bengal, Bihar tatha Orissa ki diwani hasil ki tatha Bankipore Patna kshetra me unka pramukh chhawni tatha prashasanik kendra ban gaya. Isi chhawni tatha Company ki factory ki zaruraton ke liye paas me ek bazaar basa, jise Barkerganj kaha gaya, jisse Patna ke pashchimi ilaake ka bahut vikas hua. Kuch samay baad Brigade ko Dinapore sthalantarit kar diya gaya, lekin Bankipore ka paschim ki taraf phailav jaari raha. Sir Robert Barker is brigade ke commandar the tatha Hector Munro ne Buxar ki ladai ladi thi. Exam point: Bankipore ki Third Brigade chhawni 1765 me Clive ke nirdesh par bani; isi saal 1765 me Bengal, Bihar tatha Orissa ki diwani mili thi; chhawni ki zarurat se Barkerganj bazaar bana tatha aage Brigade Dinapore chali gayi.

qe: Which bazar, grown to serve the needs of the Brigade at Bankipore and leading to the development of Patna's western suburbs, is named after the officer commanding that Brigade?
qh: बांकीपुर की ब्रिगेड की ज़रूरतें पूरी करने के लिए बसा तथा पटना के पश्चिमी उपनगरों के विकास का कारण बना कौन-सा बाज़ार उस ब्रिगेड के कमांडर अफसर के नाम पर है?
e: Bankipore me Third Brigade ki chhawni ban jane ke baad wahan rahne wale sipahiyon tatha afsaron ki zaruraton ke liye paas me ek bazaar basa, jise Brigade ke commandar Sir Robert Barker ke naam par Barkerganj kaha gaya. Is bazaar tatha Bankipore me East India Company ki factory ke aane se Patna ke pashchimi ilaake ka bahut vikas hua; Bankipore se Digha tatha Sherpur se Gulzarbagh tak lambe raste baste gaye, chahe in raston ke beech kai jagah jungle tatha khet bhi bache rahe. Isi tarah 1741 tak shahar purani deewar se bahar bhi phail chuka tha tatha bade logon ke bagh-ghar Bankipore tak Ganga ke kinare ban gaye the. Gulzarbagh, Alamganj tatha Kumrahar Patna ke anya purane ilake hain, jin ke naam is brigade ke commandar se nahi jude. Exam point: Barkerganj bazaar ka naam Third Brigade ke commandar Sir Robert Barker se juda hai; Bankipore me Company ki factory tatha brigade ke kaaran Patna ka pashchimi kshetra bahut phaila; 1741 tak shahar purani deewar ke bahar bhi phail chuka tha.

qe: By 1741 the city of Patna had spread beyond its walls, and the East India Company had a garden on the Ganges at Bankipore known as?
qh: 1741 तक पटना नगर अपनी शहरपनाह से बाहर भी फैल चुका था तथा बांकीपुर में गंगा के किनारे ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी का एक बाग़ था, जो किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
e: 1741 tak Patna ka shahar apni purani deewar ke bahar bhi phail chuka tha. Bade logon ne apne bagh-ghar Ganga ke kinare Bankipore tak banwa liye the, tatha Bankipore me Ganga ke kinare East India Company ka ek bagh tha, jise Company Bagh kaha jaata tha. Aage chal kar Company ne apni factory isi bagh ke paas, thoda pashchim ki taraf, sthalantarit kar di tatha wahan ek bazaar bas gaya, jisse Bankipore ka kshetra kaafi viksit ho gaya; Brigade ke Dinapore chale jaane ke baad bhi yah phailav jaari raha. Chajju Bagh ka sambandh 1857 ke vidroh se hai, jab wah Commissioner William Tayler ka nivas tha tatha wahan European nivasi suraksha ke liye ikattha hue the; Gulzarbagh tatha Kumrahar Patna ke anya purane sthal hain, isliye yah vikalp is bagh ka naam nahi hai. Exam point: 1741 tak Patna shahar deewar ke bahar phail chuka tha; Bankipore me Ganga ke kinare East India Company ka bagh Company Bagh kehlata tha; aage factory usi ke paas sthalantarit hui tatha Bankipore ka kshetra viksit hua.

qe: In January 1784 the erection of the great granary at Bankipore was sanctioned as one result of measures which included the removal of transit duties on grain and the cancelling of the order prohibiting export of grain from which two districts?
qh: जनवरी 1784 में बांकीपुर के महान अनाज-भंडार के निर्माण की स्वीकृति उन उपायों के एक परिणाम के रूप में मिली, जिनमें अनाज पर आने-जाने का शुल्क हटाना तथा किन दो जिलों से अनाज के निर्यात पर लगी रोक रद्द करना शामिल था?
e: 1783 me Patna kshetra me akal ka bhay phir se jaga tatha usi daur me John Shore ne ek yojna rakhi, jisme anya kadmon ke saath yah bhi shamil tha ki anaaj par lagne wale aane-jaane ke shulk yaani transit duties hata di jayein tatha Saran tatha Tirhut se anaaj ke niryat par lagai gayi rok radd kar di jaye. In upayon se anaaj ka aana-jaana aasan hua aur akal ke samay kshetra me anaaj pahunch paya. Inhi sujhaavon ka ek parinaam yah nikla ki Bankipore me bada anaj-bhandar yaani Golghar banane ki swikriti January 1784 me mil gayi tatha 1786 me imarat taiyar ho gayi. Aisa bhandar banane ki soch 1770 tatha 1783 ki tanqidi ki yaad dilati hai, jab bhookh se hazaaron logon ki maut hui thi. Exam point: anaaj par transit duty hatana tatha Saran-Tirhut se niryat ki rok radd karna John Shore ke 1783 ke upayon me shamil tha; Bankipore ke bade anaj-bhandar (Golghar) ki swikriti January 1784 me mili tatha imarat 1786 me ban kar taiyar hui.

qe: In July 1787 the office of Revenue Chief was abolished and Thomas Law became Collector of which district, with its headquarters at Gaya?
qh: जुलाई 1787 में रेवेन्यू चीफ का पद समाप्त कर दिया गया तथा थॉमस लॉ किस जिले का कलेक्टर बना, जिसका मुख्यालय गया में था?
e: July 1787 me Company ne prashasan me ek bada badlav kiya tatha Revenue Chief ka pad hi samapt kar diya. Us samay Thomas Law 'district of Bihar' ke Collector bane; is jile ka kshetra prachin sarkar Bihar se milta tha tatha iska mukhyalay Gaya me tha. Is jile me aaj ke Patna tatha Gaya jile, Japla tatha Belaunja ke ilake bhi shamil the tatha pargane Kiul nadi tak phaile hue the. Yaad rahe ki us daur me jile ka roop aaj ke jilon se bahut alag tha; aaj ka Patna jila apni alag pehchan ke saath 1825 me banaya gaya. Thomas Law ka naam aage isliye bhi mahatvapurn hua ki unhone gaon ke malikon ke saath permanent settlement ka prayog kiya. Exam point: July 1787 me Revenue Chief ka pad samapt hua tatha Thomas Law 'district of Bihar' ke Collector bane jinka mukhyalay Gaya tha; is jile me aaj ke Patna-Gaya kshetra shamil the tatha pargane Kiul nadi tak pahaunchte the.

qe: In the temporarily settled area of the old Hasua zamindari, whose plan of making a permanent settlement with the village maliks was complimented by the Court of Directors in 1792?
qh: पुरानी हसुआ जमींदारी के अस्थायी रूप से बंदोबस्त वाले क्षेत्र में गाँव के मालिकों के साथ स्थायी बंदोबस्त करने की किसकी योजना की 1792 में कोर्ट ऑफ डायरेक्टर्स ने प्रशंसा की?
e: 1781 ke vidroh ke baad purani Hasua zamindari ke kshetra me ijaredaron ne lagan dena band kar diya tatha 1787 ke ant tak sabhi farmers bakaya kar gaye. Is par Thomas Law ne gaon ke malikon ke saath permanent settlement karne ki yojna banayi. Malikon ko zamindar banane ka ek fayda yah tha ki unki milkiyat aise logon ko rok degi jo purane zamindar ke naam par kabza karne ki koshish kar sakte the; iske alava permanent proprietor se yah ummeed thi ki woh sinchai tatha sudhar ke kaam me dhyan dega, jabki ijaredar aise kaam me kam ruchi lete the. 1783 se Law permanent settlement ki maang kar rahe the; Board of Revenue ne unki yojna ko manzoor nahi kiya, lekin 1792 me Court of Directors ne unke settlement ko permanent bana diya tatha unki sakriyata, jaankari tatha manavta ki prashansa ki. Exam point: Thomas Law ne Hasua zamindari ke kshetra me gaon ke malikon ke saath permanent settlement ki yojna banayi; malikon ko zamindari ka laabh unki milkiyat ko surakshit karta tha; 1792 me Court of Directors ne Law ke settlement ko permanent banaya tatha unki prashansa ki.

qe: The Decennial Settlement of the rest of the Patna district began in which year and was made permanent in 1793?
qh: पटना जिले के शेष भाग का दशवर्षीय बंदोबस्त किस वर्ष शुरू हुआ, जिसे 1793 में स्थायी बना दिया गया?
e: Thomas Law ke Hasua kshetra wale settlement ke baad jile ke shesh hisse ka bandobast alag kram me hua. Jile ke shesh bhaag ka Decennial Settlement yaani das-varsh ka bandobast 1789 me shuru hua tatha 1790 tak poora ho gaya; aage ise 1793 me permanent bana diya gaya. Kayi pargane zamindaron ke saath bandobast kiye gaye tatha kayi pargane gaon ke malikon ke saath; kuch pargane aise bhi the jo kisi ijaredar ko permanent patte par diye gaye the, lekin 1792 me unke bakaya karne par unhe bhi malikon ke saath bandobast kar diya gaya. Is tarah Patna kshetra me zamindari, malikana tatha rayat ki vyavastha likhit roop me tay hui, jo aage ki sadi me kshetra ki samajik tatha aarthik sthiti ka aadhaar bani. Exam point: Patna jile ke shesh bhaag ka Decennial Settlement 1789 me shuru hua tatha 1790 tak poora hua; 1793 me ise permanent bana diya gaya; kayi pargane zamindaron tatha gaon ke malikon ke saath bandobast huye.

qe: In 1790 the administration of criminal law in Patna district was definitely taken over by the Company from which authority?
qh: 1790 में पटना जिले में दंड-विधि का प्रशासन कंपनी ने किससे निश्चित रूप से अपने हाथ में ले लिया?
e: 1789 ke Decennial Settlement ke saath Patna kshetra me revenue tatha samanya prashasan ka naya daur shuru hua. 1790 me Company ne dand-vidhi yaani criminal law ka prashasan, jo ab tak Murshidabad ke Nawab-Nazim ke paas tha, nishchit roop se apne haath me le liya. Is badlav ke saath kuch purani tatha kathor sazayein bhi bandh ho gayin: ang-bhang ki saza yaani mutilation ab ek manya dand nahi rahi, bache hue dandon ki punah jaanch hui tatha yatana de kar bayan nikalne ki pratha ko rokne ki koshish ki gayi. Isi daur me Patna ka pehla Magistrate bhi niyukt hua tatha uske kshetra me shahar tatha Bankipore-Jaywar police circle shamil the. Exam point: 1790 me dand-vidhi ka prashasan Company ne Murshidabad ke Nawab-Nazim se apne haath me liya; ang-bhang (mutilation) ki saza bandh ho gayi, bache dandon ki punah jaanch hui tatha yatana se bayan lene ki pratha rokne ki koshish hui.

qe: Who was the first Magistrate of Patna, whose charge included only the city and the Bankipore-Jaywar police circle?
qh: पटना का पहला मजिस्ट्रेट कौन था, जिसके कार्यक्षेत्र में केवल शहर तथा बांकीपुर-जयवर पुलिस सर्कल था?
e: 1790 me dand-vidhi ka prashasan Company ke haath me aane ke baad Patna kshetra me Magistrate ka pad bana. Patna ka pehla Magistrate Charles Francis Grand tha, jiske kshetra me sirf shahar tatha Bankipore-Jaywar police circle shamil the; 1792 me uski jagah Henry Douglas ne li. Us daur me Gaya me baitha Magistrate Patna ke paas ki ghatnaon par theek samay par karwai nahi kar paata tha, isliye 1798 me Patna ke Magistrate ka kshetra badha kar chaar sau teen square mile kar diya gaya, jo Fatuha se Maner tak tatha dakshin me Naubatpur tak phaila tha. Aage 1825 me ek alag Patna jile ka nirman hua, jiske revenue tatha police dono seema ek hi tarah ki thi. Exam point: Patna ka pehla Magistrate Charles Francis Grand tha (1790), jiske kshetra me shahar tatha Bankipore-Jaywar circle shamil the; 1792 me Henry Douglas ne unki jagah li; 1798 me kshetra badh kar 403 square mile ho gaya.

qe: On the night of 1 February 1791, the camp of which unit was raided and looted at Jafar Khan's Bagh near Patna?
qh: 1 फरवरी 1791 की रात को पटना के निकट जाफर खान के बाग में किस यूनिट के शिविर पर डकैतों ने धावा बोलकर लूटपाट की?
e: Permanent settlement ke shuruaati saalon me Patna kshetra me daakoo tatha lutere bahut sakriy the. 1791 me ek bada aman ka bhagnaak ghatna hui: 1 February 1791 ki raat ko Jafar Khan ke Bagh me 32nd Native Infantry ke camp par dakaiton ne dhava bol kar lootpat ki. Us daur me dakoo giroh ka sambandh aksar sthanik darogaon se hota tha, isliye unhe pakadna mushkil tha. Fatuha se aage nadi ke raste se jahaz se yatra bhi khatarnak maani jaati thi, kyunki bina bhaari pahredari ke navon par hamla ho jaata tha. Jab dakoo giroh tutne lage, to thaggi yaani musafiron ko dhokha de kar maal lootne ki kala kshetra me sabse pramukh apradh ban gayi. Exam point: 1 February 1791 ki raat ko Jafar Khan ke Bagh (Patna) me 32nd Native Infantry ke camp par dakaiton ne hamla kar lootpat ki; us daur me darogaon tatha dakoo giroh ka sambandh aam baat thi; aage thaggi pramukh apradh bani.

qe: In 1798 the jurisdiction of the Magistrate at Patna was extended to cover how many square miles, from Fatuha to Maner?
qh: 1798 में पटना के मजिस्ट्रेट का अधिकार-क्षेत्र फतुहा से मनेर तक कितने वर्ग मील कर दिया गया?
e: Gaya me baithne wale Magistrate ke liye Patna kshetra ki ghatnaon par samay par karwai karna aasan nahi tha, kyunki dono ke beech kaafi doori thi. Isliye 1798 me Patna ke Magistrate ka adhikar-kshetra badha kar 403 square mile kar diya gaya; yah kshetra Fatuha se Maner tak phaila hua tha tatha dakshin me Naubatpur tak chala jaata tha. Is badlav se shahar tatha uske aas-paas ke ilake me apradhon par turant karwai karna aasan hua. Aage jab thaggi kshetra me badhi tatha Ganga road Fatuha ke purab wale hisse me yatree loote jaane lage, to 1825 me alag Patna jile ka nirman kiya gaya, jisme revenue tatha police dono ki seema ek hi thi. Exam point: 1798 me Patna ke Magistrate ka kshetra 403 square mile kar diya gaya, jo Fatuha se Maner tak tatha dakshin me Naubatpur tak phaila tha; Gaya ka Magistrate door hone ke kaaran karwai der se hoti thi; aage 1825 me alag Patna jile bana.

qe: The parganas of Bihar and Rajgir were transferred from the district of Bihar to the district of Patna in which year?
qh: बिहार तथा राजगीर के परगने बिहार जिले से पटना जिले को किस वर्ष हस्तांतरित किए गए?
e: 1825 me Patna ek alag jile ke roop me banaya gaya, jisme revenue tatha police dono ki seema ek hi tarah rakhi gayi. Lekin us samay bhi Bihar tatha Rajgir ke pargane is naye jile me shamil nahi the; woh aage tak alag Bihar jile ka hissa rahe. Yah do pargane 1865 me Bihar jile se nikal kar Patna jile me shamil kiye gaye, tab ja kar aaj ke Patna jile ka roop poora hua. Aise badlav dikhate hain ki jilon ki seemayein sthir nahi hoti thi; colonial prashasan apni suvidha tatha apradh par nazar rakhne ke liye inhe baar-baar badalta raha tha. Exam point: Patna jila 1825 me alag bana tatha uski revenue-police seema ek hi rakhi gayi; Bihar tatha Rajgir ke pargane 1865 me Bihar jile se Patna jile me aaye; angreji kaal me jilon ki seemayein baar-baar badalti rahin.

qe: The ditch of the fort of Behar, now entirely cultivated, was enormous; how wide did it appear where it is most entire on the east face of the fort?
qh: बिहार के किले की खाई, जो अब पूरी तरह खेती में बदल चुकी है, बहुत बड़ी थी; किले के पूर्वी हिस्से पर सबसे साबुत जगह वह कितनी चौड़ी दिखती थी?
e: Khandak yaani kila ke charon or khodi gayi khai kila ki suraksha ka pehla sadhan hoti thi; isse dushman ki sena fauji deewar ke paas nahi pahunch paati thi tatha kila khodne ka kaam bhi mushkil ho jaata tha. Behar ke kila ki khai bahut badi thi; purvi hisse par, jahan woh sabse saabut bachi thi, uski chaudai lagbhag 600 feet dikhti thi, jabki pashchim ki or jahan woh sabse patli thi wahan lagbhag 400 feet. Aaj yah khai poori tarah kheti me badal chuki hai tatha usme chhoti-chhoti nahrein banti hain. Kile ke andar eenton ke dhair batate hain ki wahan eenton ki kai badi imaratein thi, jo sambhavtah raja ke mahal se judi thi, jabki khai ke bahar ka shahar khula tha. Exam point: Behar ke kila ki khai purvi hisse par lagbhag 600 feet chaudi thi; yah khandak kila ki suraksha ke liye bani thi tatha ab kheti me badal chuki hai.

qe: Inside the fort of Behar the walls of the office of the Amil were still standing; of what was this building chiefly made, with only a few bricks intermixed?
qh: बिहार के किले के भीतर अमील के दफ़्तर की दीवारें अब भी खड़ी थीं; यह इमारत मुख्य रूप से किस चीज़ से बनी थी, जिसमें केवल थोड़ी ईंटें मिली हुई थीं?
e: Amil ka matlab tha mahal ki aay yaani rajasv ka prabandhak, jo kila ke andar apni Kacheri yaani daftar chalata tha. Kile ke andar us daftar ki deewarein ab bhi khadi thi, jinhe mukhyatah mitti se bana kar usme thodi eentein milayi gayi thin; is imarat par safai ke saath sajaawat ki gayi thi tatha us par chamakdar lep chadha tha. Purane kila ke andar rahne wale ye Amil log apni niyukti ko asthir maante the, isliye woh imaraton par paisa kharch karne ki soch nahi rakhte the. Kile ke andar ek chhota mitti ka karya bhi tha, jiska uddeshya keval zamindaron ke achank aakraman ko rokna tha; us chhote mud fort ke har kone par ek chhota buraj bana tha. Exam point: kila ke andar Amil ke daftar ki deewarein mitti se bani thin, jisme thodi eentein milayi gayi thin; Amil yaani rajasv-prabandhak apni asthir niyukti ke karan imaraton par kharch nahi karte the.

qe: In its decay the old town of Behar had divided into separate villages; before the famine and before it had been twice sacked by which power did it go entirely round the fort ditch in a compact form?
qh: पतन के दौर में बिहार का पुराना नगर अलग-अलग गाँवों में बँट गया था; अकाल तथा किस शक्ति द्वारा दो बार लूटे जाने से पहले यह किले की खाई के चारों ओर एक सुगठित रूप में फैला हुआ था?
e: Behar ka purana shahar kila ki khai ke bahari kinare par phaila hua tha. Uske patan se pehle yah shahar khai ke charon or poora ghoomta tha tatha aam Bhartiya shaharon ki tarah sugthit roop me basa tha; Hindu shasan ke samay me yah kaafi bada raha hoga. Lekin akal (famine) aur us samay ke aakraman ke baad shahar bikhra tatha alag-alag gaonon me bat gaya; jile ke varnan me kaha gaya hai ki ise Maratha shakti dwara do baar loota gaya tha. Yah bhi bataya gaya ki kila ke andar eenton ke dhair hi bache, kyunki wahan raja ke mahal ki badi imaratein thi, jabki khai ke bahar ka shahar khula tha. Exam point: Behar ka purana shahar akal tatha Maratha shakti dwara do baar loote jaane se pehle kila ki khai ke charon or sugthit roop me phaila tha; iske baad woh alag-alag gaonon me bat gaya.

qe: Broken images collected round a tree and round a small modern temple, both inside the fort of Behar, were evident representations of Munis; what did this suggest about the Rajah of the place?
qh: बिहार के किले के भीतर एक पेड़ के नीचे तथा एक छोटे आधुनिक मंदिर के पास इकट्ठी की गई टूटी मूर्तियाँ स्पष्ट रूप से मुनियों की थीं; इससे वहाँ के राजा के बारे में क्या संकेत मिलता है?
oe: He was probably of the Buddhist sect
He was a follower of Vishnu
oh: वह संभवतः बौद्ध संप्रदाय का था
e: Kile ke andar ek ped ke niche tatha ek chhote adhunik mandir ke paas ikatthi ki gayi murtiyan Muniyon ki thin, yaani sadhuon ya bhikshuon ki aakritiyan, jo Bauddh kalakriti ki pehchan hoti hain. Isse anuman lagaya gaya ki is sthal ka raja sambhavtah Bauddh sampraday ka tha. Isi tarah kile ke ek darwaze me lage patthar par Buddha tatha Ganesa ki aakritiyan mili thin, jo dikhati hain ki us daur ke baad purani imaraton ke patthar dobara istemal kiye gaye. Muniyon ki in murtiyon ka milna is baat ka bhi sanket hai ki yahan Bauddh dharm ka prabhav raha hoga tatha uske baad anya paramparaon ka vistar hua. Exam point: kila ke andar ped ke niche mili murtiyon me Muniyon ki aakritiyan thi, jisse lagta hai ki is sthal ka raja sambhavtah Bauddh sampraday ka tha.

qe: What evidence led the surveyor to conclude that the old Hindu abode at Behar could not have been a place of much splendour?
qh: किस प्रमाण से सर्वेक्षक ने यह निष्कर्ष निकाला कि बिहार का पुराना हिंदू निवास बहुत वैभवशाली स्थान नहीं रहा होगा?
oe: Hardly any ornamented stones were found about the place
The mosque was built of marble
The fort walls were built of rough stone
The town had no tanks or temples
oh: वहाँ आस-पास लगभग कोई अलंकृत पत्थर नहीं मिला
किले की दीवारें कच्चे पत्थर की थीं
नगर में कोई तालाब या मंदिर नहीं था
e: Sarvekshak ne dekha ki Behar me kisi bhi imarat me alankrit yaani nakashi wale patthar nahi mile tatha na hi wahan alankrit patthar bikhire pade the.
