Keval kuch saadharan ya khurdure khambhe Muhammadan puja-sthalon me laga diye gaye the, jinme ek darwaze wale patthar ka zikr bhi hai. Iske aadhar par nishkarsh nikala gaya ki yah purana Hindu sthal kabhi bahut vaibhavshali nahi raha hoga, kyunki bade mandiron ya mahalon me nakashi wale pattharon ka istemal aam hota tha. Kile ke andar eenton ke dhair se pata chalta hai ki wahan eenton ki kai badi imaratein thi, lekin unka koi aakar ya roop bacha nahi; isliye unhe raja ke mahal se juda maana gaya. Exam point: Behar me alankrit patthar na milne ke kaaran nishkarsh nikala gaya ki yah purana Hindu sthal vaibhavshali nahi raha hoga; keval kuch khurdure khambhe Muhammadan puja-sthalon me laga diye gaye the.

qe: Akbar's assessment of Sarkar Bihar was 20.79 lakhs of rupees; by which year had it been enhanced to 86.49 lakhs?
qh: अकबर के समय सरकार बिहार का आकलन 20.79 लाख रुपये था; किस वर्ष तक यह बढ़कर 86.49 लाख रुपये हो गया था?
e: Akbar ke samay Sarkar Bihar ka malguzari yaani land revenue ka aakalan 20.79 lakh rupaye tha. Uske baad yah rakam kaafi badhi; 27ve saal me Avrangzeb ke raaj me is aakalan me vriddhi ki gayi, jiska nateeja yah hua ki 1685 tak yah badh kar 86.49 lakh rupaye ho gayi. Aage Alivardi Khan ne 1750 me is aakalan me punah sanshodhan kiya tatha yah 88.48 lakh rupaye tak pahunch gayi. Is tarah sarkar Bihar ke aakalan me keval 20.79 lakh se 88.48 lakh rupaye tak ki char-guni se bhi adhik vriddhi hui, jo dikhati hai ki rupaye ki keemat tatha utpadan dono me bada badlav aaya. Muhammad Reza Khan ne 1766 me apne aakalan ka aadhar 1750 ka sanshodhit aakalan hi banaya. Exam point: Sarkar Bihar ka aakalan Akbar ke samay 20.79 lakh rupaye tha, jo 1685 tak badh kar 86.49 lakh tatha 1750 me 88.48 lakh rupaye ho gaya.

qe: Who took the revised assessment of 1750 as his standard and made a new assessment of the Bihar district in 1766?
qh: किसने 1750 के संशोधित आकलन को अपना मानक बनाकर 1766 में बिहार जिले का नया आकलन किया?
e: Sarkar Bihar ka aakalan samay-samay par badhta raha. Alivardi Khan ne 1750 me is aakalan ka punah nirdharan kiya, jisse yah 88.48 lakh rupaye ho gaya. Iske baad Muhammad Reza Khan ne 1750 ke isi sanshodhit aakalan ko apna aadhar yaani standard maan kar 1766 me ek naya aakalan tay kiya. Reza Khan ka aakalan Bihar jile ki aay ke itihas me ek pramukh padav maana jaata hai, kyunki aage chal kar angrezi adhikariyon ke aakalanon tatha Permanent Settlement se pehle ki farmi vyavastha ka aadhar bhi yahi rakam bani. Isi kram me aage Thomas Law ka mukarrari settlement tatha John Shore ka farmi settlement aaya. Exam point: Muhammad Reza Khan ne 1750 ke Alivardi Khan ke sanshodhit aakalan ko aadhar maan kar 1766 me Bihar jile ka naya aakalan tay kiya, jo aage ke angrezi aakalanon ka bhi aadhar bana.

qe: In which year did Thomas Law make his mukarrari settlement with the village maliks, which the Board of Revenue disapproved of though Law persuaded Cornwallis and the Board of Directors to confirm it?
qh: थॉमस लॉ ने गाँव के मालिकों के साथ अपना मुकर्ररी बंदोबस्त किस वर्ष किया, जिसे राजस्व बोर्ड ने अस्वीकार कर दिया था, पर लॉ ने कॉर्नवॉलिस तथा बोर्ड ऑफ डायरेक्टर्स को उसे स्वीकार कराने के लिए मना लिया?
e: Thomas Law ne gaon ke malikon yaani village maliks ke saath mukarrari settlement kiya; mukarrari yaani aisi vyavastha, jisme lagaan ki rakam sthiri roop se tay kar di jaati hai. Yah settlement 1788 me hua. Board of Revenue ne is settlement ko asweekar kar diya, lekin Thomas Law ne permanent settlement ke labhon ko lagatar pesh kiya tatha Lord Cornwallis tatha Board of Directors ko apne mukarraridars yaani mukarrari lene wale logon ko sweekriti dene ke liye maan liya. Permanent Settlement ki yojana tatha Bihar Regulations ki bhasha par Law ke likhon ka bada asar dikhta hai. Isi karan aise sthanon par, jahan malik settlement lene ko taiyar the, Law ne gaon ke malikon ke saath settlement kiya. Exam point: Thomas Law ka gaon ke malikon ke saath mukarrari settlement 1788 me hua; Board of Revenue ne ise asweekar kiya, par Law ne Cornwallis tatha Board of Directors ko mukarraridars ko sweekriti dene ke liye maan liya.

qe: Thomas Law's principle of making the settlement village by village was applied to a village which was not a definite geographical unit but the charge of which official?
qh: थॉमस लॉ का गाँव-गाँव बंदोबस्त करने का सिद्धांत ऐसे गाँव पर लागू होता था, जो कोई निश्चित भौगोलिक इकाई नहीं था, बल्कि किस अधिकारी के प्रभार का क्षेत्र था?
e: Thomas Law ka ek mukhya siddhant yah tha ki settlement gaon-gaon kar ke kiya jaaye. Is siddhant me ek dikkat thi - unka gaon koi nishchit bhaugolik ikai nahi tha, balki ek patwari ke charge yaani kshetra ke barabar tha. Jab tak kanungo apne padon par bane rahe tatha kanungo ka register chalta raha, tab tak koi kathinai nahi aayi. Lekin kanungo ke pad khatm hone ke baad ye Collectorate villages, jo aksar keval us malik ke naam se jaane jaate the jisne settlement liya tha, Patna jile me bahut bhram tatha ulajh ka karan ban gaye. Exam point: Thomas Law ke gaon-gaon settlement ka gaon koi nishchit bhaugolik ikai nahi, balki ek patwari ke charge ka kshetra tha; kanungo ke pad khatm hone ke baad in Collectorate villages se Patna jile me bahut ulajh paida hui.

qe: After the Decennial Settlement the average incidence of land revenue in the district was at what rate per acre of revenue-paying land, a rate regarded as high?
qh: दशवर्षीय बंदोबस्त के बाद जिले में भू-राजस्व का औसत भार राजस्व देने वाली भूमि के प्रति एकड़ किस दर पर था, जिसे ऊँचा दर माना गया?
e: Decennial Settlement yaani das-varshiya bandobast ke baad Patna jile me land revenue yaani malguzari ka ausatan bhaar revenue-paying yaani malguzari dene wali zameen ke prati acre par Re 1-3-0 tha, jo un dino ke hisaab se ek uncha dar tha. Isi karan attharahvin sadi ke ant tak malguzari vasool karne me kaafi kathinai rahi, vishesh roop se un gaon ke malikon se jinhone Bihar tatha Gayaspur me settlement liya tha. Act VII of 1799 ne zameendaron ko distraint yaani malguzari vasoolne ke liye zyada shaktisheel adhikar diye; iske prabhav raiyaton ke liye nishchit roop se kathin the, lekin Patna me Permanent Settlement ko bachaye rakhne ke liye is tarah ka koi intezaam zaroori maana gaya. Aage chal kar jab chandi ki tulnatmak keemat giri, tab yah bhaar halka padne laga. Exam point: Decennial Settlement ke baad jile me malguzari ka ausatan bhaar prati acre Re 1-3-0 tha, jo uncha maana gaya; attharahvin sadi ke ant tak ise vasool karne me kaafi kathinai rahi.

qe: Which Act of 1799 gave landlords increased powers of distraint, the provisions of which were hard on the raiyats but necessary to preserve the Permanent Settlement in Patna?
qh: 1799 का कौन-सा अधिनियम ज़मींदारों को ज़ब्ती के बढ़े अधिकार देता था, जिसके प्रावधान रैयतों के लिए कठिन थे, पर पटना में स्थायी बंदोबस्त बचाने के लिए आवश्यक थे?
e: Attharahvin sadi ke ant tak Patna jile me malguzari vasool karne me kaafi kathinai aati rahi, vishesh roop se un gaon ke malikon se jinhone Bihar tatha Gayaspur me settlement liya tha. Isi samasya ko dekhte hue Act VII of 1799 dwaara zameendaron ko distraint yaani vasooli ke liye kisanon ki sampatti rokne tatha zabt karne ke bade adhikar diye gaye. Is Act ke pravan raiyaton ke liye nishchit roop se kathin the, lekin Patna me Permanent Settlement ko bachaye rakhne ke liye is tarah ka koi intezaam zaroori maana gaya. Jab unnisvin sadi ke shuru me chandi ki tulnatmak keemat giri, tab malguzari ka bhaar pehle se halka padne laga tatha jo aakalan shuru me bahut bhari tha, woh ant me halka ho gaya. Exam point: Act VII of 1799 ne zameendaron ko malguzari vasoolne ke liye distraint ke bade adhikar diye, jisse Patna me Permanent Settlement ko bachaya ja sake.

qe: At the Permanent Settlement nearly what proportion of the area of the district escaped assessment, as Government postponed the enquiry into the claims of occupiers to hold their land revenue-free?
qh: स्थायी बंदोबस्त के समय जिले के क्षेत्र का लगभग कितना भाग आकलन से बच गया था, क्योंकि सरकार ने भूमि को राजस्व-मुक्त रखने के अधिवासियों के दावों की जाँच आगे के लिए टाल दी थी?
e: Permanent Settlement ke samay Patna jile ke kshetra ka lagbhag chalis pratishat hissa assessment yaani malguzari se bach gaya tha, kyunki sarkar ne un kshetron ke adhikaron ki jaanch, jahan rahne walon ka dava tha ki unki zameen malguzari se mukt hai, aage ke liye taal di thi. Isse un zameendaron ko koi rahat nahi mili jo khud aise revenue-free estates ke maalik nahi the, halanki Kallian Singh jaise bade jagirdar bahut sampann ho gaye the. Atharahvin sadi ke ant tak malguzari vasool karne me kathinai ka ek bada karan yah bhi tha. Exam point: Permanent Settlement ke samay jile ke lagbhag chalis pratishat kshetra par malguzari nahi lagi thi tatha sarkar ne malguzari-mukt dawaon ki jaanch aage ke liye taal di thi.

qe: Grants made by provincial governors were distinguished from altamgha grants, which were permanent grants made by the Mughal Emperor under the great seal; 132,800 acres were claimed in the district under which name?
qh: प्रांतीय गवर्नरों द्वारा दिए गए अनुदान अल्तमगा अनुदानों से अलग माने जाते थे; अल्तमगा वे स्थायी अनुदान थे जो मुगल बादशाह महान मुहर लगाकर देते थे; जिले में 1,32,800 एकड़ किस नाम से दावे में लाए गए थे?
e: Malguzari-mukt dawaon ki jaanch ke samay bahut se aise dave aaye, jo kshetra ke bade hisson par the. Sabse bade dave altamgha tatha kharid jama grants ke the. Altamgha grant yaani Mughal badshah dwaara muhar lagakar diya gaya sthayi yaani permanent grant tha. Kharid jama grant altamgha se is baat me alag tha ki woh pradesh ke governor yaani subahdar dwaara diya gaya tha. Bihar district me 106,000 acre zameen altamgha grants ke roop me davi gayi, jabki 132,800 acre zameen kharid jama grants ke roop me davi gayi. Iske alawa dharmik uddeshyon ke liye diye gaye grants tatha khaas jagiron ke roop me bhi bade kshetra dave gaye. Exam point: 132,800 acre zameen kharid jama grants ke roop me davi gayi, jo provincial governors dwaara diye gaye grants the, jabki altamgha grants Mughal badshah dwaara muhar lagakar diye gaye sthayi grants the.

qe: Among the grants claimed for religious purposes, which covered the largest area, 115,000 acres, followed by khairat with 72,300 acres?
qh: धार्मिक उद्देश्यों के लिए दावा किए गए अनुदानों में किसका क्षेत्र सबसे बड़ा, 1,15,000 एकड़ था, जिसके बाद 72,300 एकड़ वाला खैरात आता था?
e: Malguzari se mukt dawaon me dharmik uddeshyon ke liye diye gaye grants ka bhi bada hissa tha. Aima grants ke roop me 115,000 acre, khairat ke roop me 72,300 acre, Bishunprit aur Sivottar ke roop me 14,000 acre tatha Brahmottar ke roop me 3,700 acre zameen davi gayi; is prakar aima grants sabse bade the. Aima yaani aise grants jo vidwanon tatha dharmik vyaktiyon ke nirvah ke liye diye jaate the tatha khairat yaani dharmarth karya ke liye diye gaye grants the. Iske alawa khaas jagiron ke roop me 84,000 acre tatha madad ma'ash ke roop me 38,000 acre dava hua. Mafi ke roop me 10,000 acre tatha retired sipahiyon ki jagir English settlements ke roop me 15,000 acre dave gaye. Exam point: Dharmik grants me aima sabse bada tha, jisme 115,000 acre zameen davi gayi; iske baad khairat 72,300 acre tatha Bishunprit aur Sivottar 14,000 acre the.

qe: 17,000 acres in the district were claimed as sarsikhan land, which was given to whom?
qh: जिले में 17,000 एकड़ भूमि सरसिखान भूमि के रूप में दावा की गई थी, जो किन्हें दी जाती थी?
oe: To descendants of the Mughal Emperors
To descendants of zamindars killed in battle
To retired sepoys of the Company
To village headmen for services rendered
oh: युद्ध में मारे गए ज़मींदारों के वंशजों को
की गई सेवाओं के लिए गाँव के मुखियाओं को
e: Malguzari-mukt dawaon me kuch zameen sarsikhan land ke naam se davi gayi, jiska kshetra 17,000 acre tha. Sarsikhan land woh zameen thi, jo un zameendaron ke vanshajon yaani descendants ko di jaati thi jo yuddh ke maidan me maare gaye the. Isi tarah madad ma'ash ke roop me 38,000 acre davi gayi; madad ma'ash yaani nirvah-bhatta ke liye di gayi zameen. Retired sepoyon yaani Company ke chhutte hue sipahiyon ki settlements, jinhe jagir English kaha jaata tha, 15,000 acre ke liye davi gayi. Mafi ke roop me bhi 10,000 acre dava kiya gaya. Exam point: 17,000 acre sarsikhan land ke roop me davi gayi, jo un zameendaron ke vanshajon ko di gayi thi jo yuddh me maare gaye the; madad ma'ash 38,000 acre tatha jagir English 15,000 acre ke the.

qe: The enquiry into the validity of the revenue-free claims was postponed from time to time; a little was done in 1819, but in which year were special resumption and settlement officers appointed?
qh: राजस्व-मुक्त दावों की वैधता की जाँच समय-समय पर टाली जाती रही; 1819 में थोड़ा काम हुआ, परंतु किस वर्ष ज़ब्ती तथा बंदोबस्त के विशेष अधिकारी नियुक्त किए गए?
e: Malguzari-mukt dawaon ki vaidhata ki jaanch baar-baar aage taal di jaati rahi. 1819 me thoda kaam hua, lekin 1835 me vishesh resumption tatha settlement adhikari niyukt kiye gaye. Resumed yaani sarkar me liye gaye grants Regulation VII of 1822 ke antargat settle kiye jaate the. Aise settlement me tarjih pahle us vyakti ko di jaati thi, jo revenue-free grant ka dhark yaani holder tha; uske na hone par, jahan sambhav ho, wahan malik yaani gaon ka malik, na ki zameendar, settlement karaya jaata tha. Jahan nayi riyasat malik ke paas rehni thi, wahan settlement aadhi assets par kiya jaata tha tatha jahan malikana dena padta tha, wahan aadhi assets me aadhi malikana jod kar. Exam point: 1835 me resumption tatha settlement ke vishesh adhikari niyukt kiye gaye; resumed grants Regulation VII of 1822 ke antargat settle hote the tatha settlement pahle grant ke holder ke saath karaya jaata tha.

qe: 3,216 acres in small parcels had escaped the notice of the resumption officers, being neither resumed nor confirmed as revenue-free; detected at the Revenue Survey of 1840-41, under what name were they entered in a special register?
qh: छोटे-छोटे टुकड़ों में 3,216 एकड़ भूमि ज़ब्ती अधिकारियों की नज़र से बच गई थी तथा न ज़ब्त हुई थी और न राजस्व-मुक्त के रूप में स्वीकृत; 1840-41 के राजस्व सर्वेक्षण में पकड़ी जाने पर उन्हें किस नाम से विशेष रजिस्टर में दर्ज किया गया?
e: Jab resumption ke adhikari malguzari-mukt grants ki jaanch kar rahe the, tab 3,216 acre zameen chhote-chhote tukdon me hokar unki nazar se bach gayi. Is zameen ka na to resumption hua tatha na hi ise malguzari-mukt ke roop me sweekriti mili. In chhoti-chhoti riyasaton ka pata 1840-41 ke Revenue Survey me chala; tab inhe ek vishesh register me zaid-fihrist lands ke naam se darj kiya gaya. Zaid-fihrist ka matlab hai alag fehrist me darj ki gayi zameen. In par kabhi resumption nahi hua tatha 1914 ke baad se inhe confirmed revenue-free estates yaani sweekrit malguzari-mukt riyasaton ki tarah dekha jaata hai. Exam point: 1840-41 ke Revenue Survey me pakdi gayi 3,216 acre ki un chhoti zameenon ko zaid-fihrist lands ke naam se ek vishesh register me darj kiya gaya tatha 1914 ke baad unhe sweekrit malguzari-mukt riyasat maana gaya.

qe: The resumption proceedings raised the revenue demand of the district by Rs 4,94,000; what was the district's total revenue demand in the 1920s, of which Rs 13,96,196 was assessed on permanently settled estates?
qh: ज़ब्ती की कार्यवाही से जिले की राजस्व माँग 4,94,000 रुपये बढ़ गई थी; 1920 के दशक में जिले की कुल राजस्व माँग कितनी थी, जिसमें से 13,96,196 रुपये स्थायी रूप से बसी जमींदारियों पर लगते थे?
e: Resumption ki karyavahi ke karan Patna jile ki malguzari ki maang yaani revenue demand Rs 4,94,000 badh gayi. Beesvin sadi ke tisre dashak me jile ki kul malguzari ki maang Rs 15,39,600 thi, jisme se Rs 13,96,196 sthayi roop se settle ho chuki riyasaton par lagta tha tatha shesh rakam asaikalin yaani temporarily settled riyasaton tatha sarkari riyasaton par. Is malguzari ke virudh sarkar ki malikana sambandhi dayita bhi thi, jo Rs 30,841 banti thi tatha 1,405 riyasaton ke liye deya tha. Iske alawa Cess Act ke antargat hui punarmulyankan, jo 1926 me poori hui, ke hisaab se jile ka kul rental Rs 1,04,62,859 tha tatha cess ki maang Rs 6,04,693 thi. Exam point: Resumption se jile ki malguzari ki maang Rs 4,94,000 badhi tatha beesvin sadi ke tisre dashak me kul maang Rs 15,39,600 thi, jisme Rs 13,96,196 sthayi riyasaton par lagta tha.

qe: In 1789 there were only 1,156 estates in the district; by 1876 the number had risen to 5,930, and in the 1920s there were 1,411 revenue-free estates along with how many revenue-paying estates?
qh: 1789 में जिले में केवल 1,156 जमींदारियाँ थीं; 1876 तक यह संख्या बढ़कर 5,930 हो गई, तथा 1920 के दशक में 1,411 राजस्व-मुक्त जमींदारियों के साथ कितनी राजस्व देने वाली जमींदारियाँ थीं?
e: Patna jile me zamindari adhikaron ka baantwara yaani subdivision bahut tez gati se hua. 1789 me, jabki tab bhi bahut si riyasatein chhoti milkiat hi thin, jile me keval 1,156 riyasatein thi. 1876 tak yah sankhya badh kar 5,930 ho gayi. Beesvin sadi ke tisre dashak me jile me 15,107 revenue-paying yaani malguzari dene wali tatha 1,411 revenue-free yaani malguzari-mukt riyasatein thi. Iske alawa riyasaton ke khud bahut se sa-jisedar yaani co-sharers hote the, isliye ek akela hissedar ab ausatan das acre se bhi kam zameen rakhta tha. Is tarah ke kisan-malik yaani peasant proprietors vishesh roop se Barh tatha Bikram thanon me zyada the; Sihora me 44 hissedar 58 acre zameen rakhte the. Exam point: Jile me 1789 me 1,156 riyasatein thi, jo 1876 tak 5,930 ho gayin tatha beesvin sadi ke tisre dashak me 15,107 malguzari wali tatha 1,411 malguzari-mukt riyasatein thi.

qe: Raja Harihar Prashad Sinha Bahadur of Ammawan, the most powerful zamindar of the district, was descended from Basdeo Rai, a Bhumihar Brahman who acquired milkiat property about 1670 in which pargana?
qh: जिले के सबसे शक्तिशाली ज़मींदार अम्मावाँ के राजा हरिहर प्रसाद सिंह बहादुर बसदेव राय के वंशज थे; बसदेव राय, जो एक भूमिहार ब्राह्मण थे, ने लगभग 1670 में किस परगने में मिल्कियत संपत्ति प्राप्त की थी?
e: Patna jile ka sabse shaktishali zameendar beesvin sadi ke tisre dashak me Ammawan ke Raja Harihar Prashad Sinha Bahadur the. Woh Basdeo Rai ke vanshaj the; Basdeo Rai ek Bhumihar Brahman the, jinhone 1670 AD ke aas-paas Malda pargana me milkiat yaani bhoomi-sampatti prapt ki thi. Unke pote Chaudhri Bhelam Singh ne khareed ke roop me is milkiat ka kaafi vistar kiya. Inke purvajon ne 1788 me Thomas Law ke Malda ke permanent settlement ke samay apni milkiat ko zamindari me nahi badla, isliye unke paas keval malikana adhikar hi rah gaye; is parampara ka ek dilchasp avshesh yah raha ki Barbigha ke dukaandar Raja ko har saal upahar dete the. Exam point: Ammawan ke Raja Harihar Prashad Sinha Bahadur Basdeo Rai ke vanshaj the, jinhone 1670 AD ke aas-paas Malda pargana me milkiat prapt ki thi tatha 1788 me unke purvajon ne apni milkiat ko zamindari me nahi badla.

qe: Settlements of invalided sepoys, known as jagir English, were made under Regulations of 1789, 1793, 1804 and 1808; what were these settlements called, lying chiefly on the main lines of communication?
qh: अमान्य घोषित सिपाहियों की बस्तियाँ, जिन्हें जागीर इंग्लिश कहा जाता था, 1789, 1793, 1804 तथा 1808 के विनियमों के अंतर्गत बनाई गई थीं; मुख्य संचार-मार्गों पर स्थित इन बस्तियों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Chhutte hue yaani invalided sepoyon ki settlements, jinhe jagir English kaha jaata tha, February 1789, 1793, 1804 tatha 1808 ke Regulations ke antargat banayi gayi thin. In settlements ko thana kaha jaata tha tatha yah mukhyatah mukhya sanchar-margon par sthit the, isliye jile ki sadkon par aate-jaate samay aise thane aksar milte the. Bahut si zameen, jo un mul sipahiyon ne jotne yogya banayi thi, unke vanshajon ne aage bech ya hataye di; lekin woh ghar ki zameen yaani homestead land, jo patia me alag se likhi jaati thi, tatha thane ki sanjhi charagah tatha parade ground ab bhi aksar in mul dharkon ke vanshajon ke paas hoti hai. Inhe sthanik roop se khana muofi sakunat tatha ghulam gardish kaha jaata hai. Exam point: Invalided sepoyon ki jagir English settlements ko thana kaha jaata tha, jo mukhyatah sanchar-margon par sthit the; inki homestead land, sanjhi charagah tatha parade ground aaj bhi unke vanshajon ke paas hoti hai.

qe: Paul Richard Pearkes reopened the English Factory at Patna in July of which year, during the troubled time of 1756-57 when there were no covenanted servants of the Company at the factory?
qh: पॉल रिचर्ड पियर्क्स ने पटना की अंग्रेजी फैक्ट्री को किस वर्ष जुलाई में दोबारा खोला, जब 1756-57 के उपद्रवों के समय उस फैक्ट्री में कंपनी का कोई नियमित (कविनेंटेड) कर्मचारी नहीं था?
e: Patna ki English Factory kabhi band bhi ki gayi thi. Us daur me, jab 1756-57 ke upadrav chal rahe the, is factory me Company ka koi covenanted servant yaani niyamit naukar nahi tha. July 1757 me Paul Richard Pearkes ne is factory ko dobara khola. Iske baad 26 July 1757 ko Eyre Coote apni poori sena ke saath yahan thehar sake, kyunki tyaag ki avadhi me bhi imarat ko gira jaane nahi diya gaya tha. Coote ne samay par sakhti dikha kar apne baghi sainikon me anushasan bahal kiya. Agle jade ke mausam me Clive bhi apni sena ke saath yahan ruke, isse pehle ki woh Bankipore ki or badhe. Is tarah Patna ki factory nadi-kinare ke sainik tatha vyaparik jeevan ka kendra rahi. Exam point: Paul Richard Pearkes ne Patna ki English Factory ko July 1757 me dobara khola; isi imarat me 26 July 1757 ko Eyre Coote ne apni sena thehrai tatha baghi sainikon me sakhti se anushasan bahal kiya.

qe: During the troubles of 1763, who mounted light guns on the tower crowning the factory house at Patna, vainly trying to withstand the fire of Markar's heavier artillery before escaping by boats to the Saran bank?
qh: 1763 के संघर्ष में किसने पटना की फैक्ट्री के भवन पर बने टावर पर हल्की तोपें चढ़ाईं तथा मरकार की भारी तोपखाने की गोलाबारी का सामना करने का व्यर्थ प्रयास किया, और अंत में नावों से सारण के किनारे भाग गए?
e: Ganga ke kinare sthit English Factory ke tower par halki topen chadha kar Ellis ne purb ki or bane bade bastion se Markar ki bhaari topkhane ki firing ka muqabla karne ki koshish ki. Markar ka bhaari hathiyaar aakhir bhari pad gaya tatha Ellis ko factory chhod kar naavon ke raste Saran ke kinare par bhaag jaana pada. Isi daur me, 28 April 1760 ki subah, factory ke adhikariyon ne Randfurlie Knox ki Burdwan se aane wali tez march ki flying column ko nadi ke terrace se dekha tha; tatha isi jagah se saat hafte baad Amyatt ne Birpur ke upadrav ka parinaam jaanne ke liye intezaar kiya tha. Exam point: 1763 ke sangharsh me Ellis ne factory ke tower par halki topen chadha kar Markar ki bhaari topkhane ka muqabla karne ki koshish ki tatha ant me naavon se Saran ke kinare bhaag gaye.

qe: Which factory at Patna was used for military stores and known as the Grand Magazine until it was made over to the Opium Agents, after which Bihar opium was manufactured there until 1910?
qh: पटना की कौन-सी फैक्ट्री सैनिक सामान के लिए प्रयोग होती थी तथा ग्रैंड मैगज़ीन कहलाती थी, जब तक उसे अफीम एजेंटों को नहीं सौंपा गया, जिसके बाद 1910 तक वहीं बिहार की अफीम बनती रही?
e: Patna me shahar ke andar Company ki factory ke liye Gulzarbagh ka sthan bhi kaam me laaya gaya. Jab Patna ke dobara kabze ke baad factory ko wahan se hataane ki soch bani, to 1765 me kila ke kshetra me nirman-karya bhi shuru hua, lekin 1767 me Thomas Rumbold ne iske virudh faisla liya tatha factory Bankipore ke makan me le jaayi gayi. Uske baad Gulzarbagh ki factory sena ke saamaan ke liye kaam me aayi tatha Grand Magazine yaani bada hathiyaar-khana kahlai. Ant me yah Opium Agents yaani afim sambandhi adhikariyon ko de di gayi, jiske baad Bihar ki afim ka nirmaan yahan 1910 tak hota raha. Exam point: Gulzarbagh Factory sena ke saamaan ka Grand Magazine bani tatha Opium Agents ko diye jaane ke baad yahan Bihar ki afim ka nirmaan 1910 tak hota raha.

qe: The site of the Dutch Factory at Patna, which was rebuilt in 1752, is still known by what name, and it was here that Dr. Fullarton found refuge during the Patna massacre?
qh: पटना में 1752 में दोबारा बनाई गई डच फैक्ट्री का स्थान आज भी किस नाम से जाना जाता है, तथा पटना हत्याकांड के समय डॉ. फुलरटन को यहीं शरण मिली थी?
e: 18vin sadi me shahar ke nadi-kinare par bade-bade ghar kataar me bane hue the, jinme se ab bahut kam nishan bache hain. Shitab Rai ke ghar ke sthan par aaj ek unchi khaali jagah dikhti hai. Ibrahim Ali Khan tatha Mir Ashraf ke ghar tatha Dutch Factory ke sthan par purani deewaron ke bade avshesh milte hain. Dutch Factory ko 1752 me dobara banaya gaya tha tatha uske sthan ko aaj bhi Hollandez Poshta ke naam se jaana jaata hai; wahan ki imaraton ka ab kuch baki nahi hai. Yahi woh jagah hai, jahan Patna hatyakand ke dauran Dr. Fullarton ko sharan mili thi tatha wahin se woh nadi ke raste Patna se bach kar nikal gaye. Exam point: 1752 me dobara banayi gayi Dutch Factory ke sthan ko aaj bhi Hollandez Poshta kaha jaata hai; Patna hatyakand ke samay Dr. Fullarton ko isi sthan par sharan mili thi tatha woh nadi ke raste yahan se bach nikle.

qe: Maharaj Ghat at Patna is named after which Governor of Patna, who was put to death by Mir Kasim in 1763 and whose house stands on the western side of the ghat?
qh: पटना का महाराज घाट किस गवर्नर के नाम पर है, जिनकी मीर कासिम ने 1763 में हत्या कर दी थी तथा जिनका घर घाट के पश्चिमी किनारे पर स्थित है?
e: Dutch Factory ke compound se niche Maharaj Ghat hai. Yah ghat Maharaja Ramnarain ke naam par hai, jo Patna ke governor the tatha jinke Mir Kasim ne 1763 me vadh kar diya tha. Unka ghar is ghat ke pashchimi kinare par khada hai, jo aaj up-ekshit halat me hai. Yahan ek sundar Shiv mandir bhi hai. Ramnarain ka naam Patna ke itihas me isliye bhi mahatvapurna hai ki 1763 me shahar par Mir Kasim ke aakraman tatha uske baad Patna hatyakand ke dauran unki bhoomika bani rahi; unke vanshajon ka ghar aaj bhi Maharaj Ghat ke paas maujood hai tatha ghat nadi-kinare ke vyast jeevan ka gawah raha hai. Exam point: Maharaj Ghat Maharaja Ramnarain ke naam par hai, jo Patna ke governor the tatha jinke Mir Kasim ne 1763 me vadh kar diya; unka ghar ghat ke pashchimi kinare par aaj bhi up-ekshit halat me khada hai.

qe: Which house at Patna, built by Captain Alexander Hardy, was sold to the Government of Nepal in 1781 for Rs 1,601 to serve as a resting place for pilgrims from Nepal to Gaya?
qh: पटना का कौन-सा घर, जिसे कैप्टन अलेक्जेंडर हार्डी ने बनवाया था, 1781 में नेपाल से गया जाने वाले तीर्थयात्रियों के विश्राम के लिए 1,601 रुपये में नेपाल सरकार को बेचा गया था?
e: Kile ke kshetra me purane commandant ke ghar ke roop me ek kothi Captain Alexander Hardy ne banwayi thi. 1781 me unhe ise Nepal ki sarkar ko Rs 1,601 me bechne ki anumati mili; yah kothi Nepali Kothi ke naam se mashhoor hai. Iska mool uddeshya yah tha ki Nepal se Gaya jaane wale teerth-yatri, jo Ganga ke kinare snan karte hue jaate the, yahan vishram le sakein. Nepal rajya aaj bhi iska istemal karta hai tatha kothi aaj tak Nepal sarkar ki sampatti hai. Kila ke andar teerth-yatriyon ke thaharne se sainik adhikariyon tatha Nepali rakhvalon ke beech aaye din jhagde hote rehte the, phir bhi yah sthan Nepal rajya ke kabze me bana raha. Exam point: Nepali Kothi ko Captain Alexander Hardy ne banwaya tha, jo 1781 me Nepal sarkar ko Rs 1,601 me bechi gayi tatha Nepal se Gaya jaane wale teerth-yatriyon ke vishram ke liye di gayi; yah aaj tak Nepal sarkar ki sampatti hai.

qe: The old jail at Patna, commonly known as the Diwani jail, was built in 1784 by which officer, of whom it was observed that the building was not strong enough to confine ruffians?
qh: पटना की पुरानी जेल, जिसे आम तौर पर दीवानी जेल कहा जाता था, 1784 में किस अधिकारी ने बनवाई थी, जिसके बारे में कहा गया कि यह इमारत उपद्रवियों को कैद रखने के लिए मजबूत नहीं है?
e: Gulzarbagh ke compound ki zyadatar imaratein apekshakrit nayi hain, lekin ek purani jail bhi wahin hai. Yah jail 1784 me General Garstin ne banwayi thi tatha ise aam taur par Diwani jail kaha jaata tha. Diwani ka matlab hai nagari yaani deewani adalat sambandhi. Is imarat ke baare me kaha gaya tha ki yah shararti kaidiyon ko rokne ke liye majboot nahi hai; yah tippani kuch saal baad sahi sabit hui, jab kaidiyon ne bahar nikalne ka prayas kiya. Is tarah yah jail apne samay ki jail vyavastha ki kamzoriyon ka udaharan ban gayi tatha aage suraksha badhane ki zarurat mehsoos ki gayi. Exam point: Gulzarbagh ki woh purani jail, jise Diwani jail kaha jaata tha, 1784 me General Garstin ne banwayi thi; uske baare me kaha gaya tha ki yah shararti kaidiyon ko rokne ke liye majboot nahi hai.

qe: On the evening of 7 May 1817 thirty-nine convicts broke through the weak eastern door of the enclosing wall of the Diwani jail; how many were killed in the attempt to check their escape?
qh: 7 मई 1817 की शाम को उनतालीस कैदियों ने दीवानी जेल की चारदीवारी के कमजोर पूर्वी दरवाजे को तोड़ दिया; उनके भागने को रोकने के प्रयास में कितने मारे गए?
e: Gulzarbagh ki purani jail, jise Diwani jail kaha jaata tha, 1784 me General Garstin ne banwayi thi. Uske baare me pehle hi kaha gaya tha ki yah shararti kaidiyon ko rokne ke liye paryapt majboot nahi hai. Yah baat sahi nikli - 7 May 1817 ki shaam ko unchaalis kaidiyon ne mil kar bahari deewar ke kamzor purbi darwaze ko tod kar bhaagne ki koshish ki. Is bhaagne ke prayas ko rokne ki koshish me battis kaidi maare gaye. Is ghatna ne Patna ki jail vyavastha ki kamzoriyan sabke saamne rakh din tatha aage jail ki suraksha sudharne ki zarurat mehsoos ki gayi; aise kaand dikhate hain ki imarat ki bananaawat ka seedha asar bandi-vyavastha par padta hai. Exam point: 7 May 1817 ki shaam ko unchaalis kaidiyon ne Diwani jail ki bahari deewar ke kamzor purbi darwaze ko toda, jisme bhaagne ke prayas ko rokne me battis kaidi maare gaye.

qe: The office of the Imperial Bank at Bankipore stands in the burying ground of Nawab Jahangir Quli Khan, Governor of Patna from 1605 to 1607, whose tomb lies on a high mound in which corner of the compound?
qh: बांकीपुर में इंपीरियल बैंक का दफ्तर नवाब जहाँगीर कुली खान के कब्रिस्तान की भूमि पर है, जो 1605 से 1607 तक पटना के गवर्नर थे; उनकी मजार परिसर के किस कोने में ऊँचे टीले पर है?
e: Bankipore ke maidan ke uttar me, maidan ke saamne, Imperial Bank ka daftar hai. Yah daftar Nawab Jahangir Quli Khan ke kabristan ki zameen par bana hai, jo 1605 se 1607 tak Patna ke governor the; unki mazar compound ke uttar-pashchimi kone me ek unche teele par sthit hai. Is compound me do-manzila ghar tatha uski unchi char-diwari John Bardoe Elliott ne banwayi thi, jo unnisvin sadi ke shuruwat me Patna ki Provincial Court of Appeal ke judge the. Apni seva-nivritti ke baad Elliott Bankipore me prabhavshali sthan rakhte the. 1864 me yah ghar Bank of Bengal ne kharid liya. Exam point: Imperial Bank ka daftar Nawab Jahangir Quli Khan ke kabristan me hai, jo 1605-1607 tak Patna ke governor the tatha jinki mazar compound ke uttar-pashchimi kone ke unche teele par hai; imarat John Bardoe Elliott ne banwayi thi tatha 1864 me Bank of Bengal ne kharidi.

qe: Chajju Bagh house, which served as Government House after the creation of the province of Bihar and Orissa, was made over in 1916 to which officer?
qh: चज्जू बाग हाउस, जो बिहार तथा उड़ीसा प्रांत के गठन के बाद गवर्नमेंट हाउस के रूप में काम आया, 1916 में किस अधिकारी को सौंप दिया गया?
e: Bankipore ka Chajju Bagh house apne naam ke ek vyakti ki mazar se juda hai, jo compound ke pashchimi hisse me hai. 1820 me Mountstuart Elphinstone ke bade bhai yahan rehte the, jo us samay Provincial Court of Appeal ke doosre judge the. 1857 me William Tayler, jila-aayukt, yahan rehte the, jab Mutiny shuru hui. Chajju Bagh ka malik tab Mr John Alexander Boilard tha, jisne apni patni ko compound me ek asadharan tareeke se - bina taboot, ek palang par leta kar - dafnaya tha tatha apni vasiyat me likha tha ki unhe bhi usi tarah usi ke bagal me dafnaya jaaye. Government ne yah imarat Sir Andrew Fraser ke samay Bengal ke Lieutenant-Governor ke Patna-nivas ke liye kharidi; Bihar tatha Orissa prant banne ke baad Sir Charles Bayley ne ise Government House ke roop me istemal kiya. 1916 me yah imarat Chief Justice ko de di gayi tatha compound bant kar High Court ke judges ke liye do naye ghar bane. Exam point: Chajju Bagh house 1916 me Chief Justice ko de di gayi thi; Bihar-Orissa prant banne ke baad Sir Charles Bayley ne ise Government House ke roop me istemal kiya tha tatha 1857 me William Tayler yahan rehte the.

qe: The avenues of noble trees around the great maidan at Bankipore were planted over a hundred years ago by which officer, who was Magistrate of Patna for twenty years from 1792?
qh: बांकीपुर के बड़े मैदान के चारों ओर लगे भव्य वृक्षों की कतार सौ साल से भी पहले किस अधिकारी ने लगवाई थी, जो 1792 से बीस साल तक पटना के मजिस्ट्रेट रहे?
e: Bankipore ke civil station ka roop bade maidan se aur bhi sundar lagta hai. Yah maidan purana sainik camping ground tha, jo Bengal se chalkar aane wale sipahiyon ke liye Jafar Khan ke bagh ke baad agla padav hota tha. Iske chaaron or purana race-course tatha bade-bade pedon ki kataar hai, jo sau saal se bhi pehle Henry Douglas ne lagwayi thi. Henry Douglas 1792 se bees saal tak Patna ke Magistrate rahe tatha 1839 me unka dehant hua; unki qabr Bankipore ke European qabristan me hai. Aaj bhi Bankipore ke raste inhi avenue wale pedon ke liye jaane jaate hain tatha maidan ko ashcharyajanak tareeke se atikraman se bachaya gaya hai. Exam point: Bankipore ke maidan ke chaaron or ke purane pedon ki kataar Henry Douglas ne lagwayi thi, jo 1792 se bees saal tak Patna ke Magistrate rahe tatha jinki qabr European qabristan me hai.

qe: The Srimati Radhika Institute, whose hall is the largest in Patna and was designed to serve as a Town Hall, was built by which leader in memory of his wife?
qh: श्रीमती राधिका इंस्टिट्यूट, जिसका हॉल पटना का सबसे बड़ा है तथा जिसे टाउन हॉल के रूप में काम करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया था, किस नेता ने अपनी पत्नी की स्मृति में बनवाया था?
e: Patna-Gaya road se thoda hata kar purb ki or Srimati Radhika Institute sthit hai. Ise Mr Sachchidananda Sinha ne apni swargiya patni ki smriti me banwaya tha, apne naye ghar ke paas hi. Is institute ka hall Patna ka sabse bada hall hai tatha ise Town Hall yaani nagar-sabha-griha ke roop me kaam karne ke liye design kiya gaya tha. Hall ko chaaron or se ghere hue galleries me Sachchidananda Sinha Public Library rakhi gayi, jise aadhunik sahitya se udar roop se bhara jaata tha; isme yatra, itihas, darshan, samajshastra tatha saahitya se jude granth pramukh the. Exam point: Srimati Radhika Institute Mr Sachchidananda Sinha ne apni patni ki smriti me banwaya tha; iska hall Patna ka sabse bada hall hai tatha use nagar-sabha-griha ke roop me kaam karne ke liye design kiya gaya tha.

qe: Which Maharaja, the greatest landowner of the district a century ago, lived in the house known in the eighteenth century as Gulzar Bagh, where Shitab Rai had his garden house near the English Factory?
qh: सौ साल पहले जिले का सबसे बड़ा ज़मींदार कौन-सा महाराजा था, जो अठारहवीं सदी में गुलजार बाग के नाम से जाने जाने वाले उस घर में रहता था, जहाँ अंग्रेजी फैक्ट्री के पास शिताब राय का बाग-घर था?
e: Purane Opium Factory ki lambi deewar tatha uske saw-mills ke saamne wahi ghar hai, jo 18vin sadi me Gulzar Bagh ke naam se jaana jaata tha tatha aaj Bhup Singh ke ghar ke roop me mashhoor hai. Yahin Bhup Singh ke purvaj Maharaja Kallian Singh rehte the, jo apne samay ke jile ke sabse bade zameendar the tatha Shitab Rai ke putra the. Shitab Rai ka garden house bhi yahin English Factory ke paas suvidha ke liye bana hua tha. Aage Diwan Mahalla me Shitab Rai ka nadi-kinare wala ghar tha, jo poori tarah gayab ho gaya hai; thoda uncha-khaali sthan us ghar ke sthan ka nishan hai. Raja Khiali Ram ka ghar, jo 18vin sadi ke shuru ke upadravon ke saalon me bana tha, aaj bhi unke vanshaj Rai Brijraj Krishna ke paas hai. Exam point: 18vin sadi ke Gulzar Bagh wale ghar me Maharaja Kallian Singh rehte the, jo Shitab Rai ke putra tatha jile ke sabse bade zameendar the; Shitab Rai ka garden house bhi isi kshetra me English Factory ke paas tha.

qe: The Danish Factory at Patna was founded in 1775 by Jorgen Hendrich Berner, who died in 1790 and was buried on the east of his house; that house is now occupied by whom?
qh: पटना की डेनिश फैक्ट्री 1775 में जोर्गन हेंड्रिच बर्नर ने स्थापित की थी, जिनका 1790 में निधन हुआ तथा जिन्हें उनके घर के पूर्व में दफनाया गया; वह घर अब किसके पास है?
oe: The station-master of the Patna Ghat railway station
oh: पटना घाट रेलवे स्टेशन का स्टेशन-मास्टर
e: Nepali Kothi se thoda niche Danmark yaani Danish Factory thi, jise Jorgen Hendrich Berner ne 1775 me sthapit kiya tha. Berner ka 1790 me dehant hua tatha unhe unke ghar ke purb ki or dafnaya gaya. Wahi ghar aaj Patna Ghat railway station ke station-master ke paas hai. Factory se sau gaz aur niche Pir Damaria ki mazar tatha unse juda badi masjid hai, jo purane altamgha grants par chalti thi. Is tarah Patna ke nadi-kinare ki kataar me Dutch, Danish tatha angrezi factoryon tatha unse jude vyaktiyon ki kabron ke nishan milte hain, jo shahar ke vyaparik itihas ki gawahi dete hain. Exam point: Danish Factory ko 1775 me Jorgen Hendrich Berner ne sthapit kiya tha; 1790 me unke dehant ke baad unhe ghar ke purb ki or dafnaya gaya tatha wahi ghar ab Patna Ghat railway station ke station-master ke paas hai.

qe: In the Diwan Mahalla of Patna stood the riverside house of Shitab Rai and the house of Raja Khiali Ram; which part of Raja Khiali Ram's house has been preserved exactly as it was in his day?
qh: पटना के दीवान महल्ला में शिताब राय का नदी-किनारे वाला घर तथा राजा ख्याली राम का घर थे; राजा ख्याली राम के घर का कौन-सा हिस्सा आज भी उनके दिनों जैसा ही सुरक्षित रखा गया है?
e: Diwan Mahalla me Shitab Rai ka nadi-kinare wala ghar tatha Raja Khiali Ram ka ghar sthit the. Shitab Rai ka ghar poori tarah gayab ho chuka hai, lekin Raja Khiali Ram ka ghar, jo 18vin sadi ke shuru ke upadravon ke saalon me bana tha, aaj bhi unke vanshaj Rai Brijraj Krishna ke paas hai. Rai Brijraj Krishna Patna ke ek prasiddh vakil the tatha unka parivar apne purvajon ki smritiyon ka khayal rakhta aaya. Is ghar ka sarvadhik dilchasp hissa ye hai ki Raja Khiali Ram ka darbar hall, jahan woh apne sarvajanik kaam-kaj karte the, aaj bhi bilkul usi roop me surakshit rakha gaya hai, jaise unke dinon me tha; yah Patna me ek bahut hi rochak avshesh hai tatha itihas-premiyon ke liye mahatvapurna hai. Exam point: Raja Khiali Ram ke ghar ke darbar hall ko aaj bhi bilkul usi roop me surakshit rakha gaya hai jaise unke dinon me tha, jabki Shitab Rai ka nadi-kinare wala ghar poori tarah gayab ho chuka hai.

qe: The tomb of Haibat Jang, the Governor of Patna who was murdered by the Afghans of Darbhanga in 1748, stands at Begampur south of the Patna City railway station; whose father was he?
qh: पटना के गवर्नर हैबत जंग की मजार, जिनकी 1748 में दरभंगा के अफगानों ने हत्या कर दी थी, पटना सिटी रेलवे स्टेशन के दक्षिण में बेगमपुर में है; वे किसके पिता थे?
e: Begampur me Haibat Jang ki mazar hai. Haibat Jang ka asli naam Zainuddin tha tatha woh Patna ke Governor the; unki hatya 1748 me Darbhanga ke Afghano ne kar di thi. Woh Siraj-ud-daula ke pita the, jo aage chalkar Bengal ke nawab bane. Unki hatya ke baad unke dushmanon ne unke avshesh ko bhala par chubho diya, lekin unke mitra Saiyid Muhammad Ispahani ne shahar ke purbi darwaze se unka sir utaar kar dhadh ke saath dafna diya. Unke avshesh par kaale patthar tatha safed sangmarmar ki mazar bani, jise khuli jaali wale black hornblende ke roshandaan me rakha gaya. Yah mazar Nawab Shahid-ka-makbara ke naam se mashhoor hai tatha Shia samuday ise bahut aadar deta hai; bagiche me ek imambara tatha masjid bhi hai, jahan Muharram ke dauran tazia ke juloos aate hain. Exam point: Begampur me Haibat Jang (Zainuddin) ki mazar hai, jo Patna ke Governor the, jinhe 1748 me Darbhanga ke Afghano ne mara tatha jo Siraj-ud-daula ke pita the; yah mazar Nawab Shahid-ka-makbara kahlati hai tatha Shia samuday me pujya hai.

qe: In 1748 the Afghans and Marathas marched to Barh after the sack of Patna and were defeated by Alivardi Khan; the next morning their defeat was completed by a battle fought how far from Barh?
qh: 1748 में अफगान तथा मराठा पटना की लूट के बाद बाढ़ तक बढ़े और अलीवर्दी खाँ ने उन्हें हराया; अगली सुबह उनकी पराजय उस युद्ध से पूरी हुई जो बाढ़ से कितनी दूर लड़ा गया?
e: 1748 me Patna ki loot ke baad Afghano tatha Marathao ki sena Barh tak badhi thi. Woh Barh ke paas hi apna shivir bana kar thehre the. Alivardi Khan khud Barh me ruk kar unki surakshit position ke ek kinare yaani flank par hamla karne ki yojana banai, hamla kiya tatha Afghano ko bhaag kar bhaga diya. Agli subah Rabi Sarai me hui ladai, jo Barh se pachchis meel ki doori par thi, us campaign ka ant kar diya tatha unki parajay poori kar di. Is tarah Barh ka sthan Bengal se aane wali sena ke march-marg par hone ke karan mahatvapurna raha; yahan se guzarne wali kai senaon ke itihas ne is chhote shahar ko Mughal-uttar Bharat ke sangharshon se jod diya. Exam point: Barh ke paas 1748 me Afghano tatha Marathao ki sena thehri thi; Alivardi Khan ne unke flank par hamla kiya tatha agli subah Barh se pachchis meel door Rabi Sarai ki ladai me unki parajay poori kar di.

qe: Whom did Nawab Mir Kasim stay at Barh in 1763 and have put to death, exposing their bodies so that they could not be burnt with Hindu rites?
qh: नवाब मीर कासिम ने 1763 में बाढ़ में रुककर किन लोगों को मरवा दिया तथा उनके शरीर ऐसे खुले छोड़ दिए कि हिंदू रीति से उनका दाह-संस्कार न हो सके?
oe: Jagat Seth and his brother Samp Chand Seth
oh: जगत सेठ तथा उनके भाई संपत चंद सेठ
e: Nawab Mir Kasim Ali 1763 me Monghyr se Patna jaate samay Barh me thehra tha, theek us hatyakand se pehle jo Patna me hua. Wahan unke kaidiyon me Jagat Seth tatha unke bhai Sampat Chand Seth the; yah Murshidabad ke bade mahajan yaani bankers the. Mir Kasim ne unhe marwakar unke shareer pakshiyon tatha jaanwaron ke liye khula chhod diya, taaki hindu rieti se unka antim sanskar na ho sake. 1763 ke ant me jab Company ki sena Patna ki or badhi, to usne Barh me ruk kar dekha ki ye shareer wahin ek ghar me dafan kiye gaye the. Exam point: Mir Kasim ne 1763 me Barh me thehr kar Murshidabad ke bade mahajanon Jagat Seth tatha unke bhai Sampat Chand Seth ko marwakar unke shareer khule chhod diye, taaki hindu rieti se unka dah-sanskar na ho sake; aage wah shareer Barh ke ek ghar me dafan mile.

qe: Athmalgola in the Barh subdivision, a station on the main line of the East Indian Railway 304 miles from Calcutta, was one of the original colonies of which type of settlement?
qh: बाढ़ अनुमंडल का अथमलगोला, जो पूर्वी भारत रेलवे की मुख्य लाइन पर कलकत्ता से 304 मील पर स्टेशन है, मूल रूप से किस प्रकार की बस्ती की कॉलोनी थी?
oh: शोरा सफेद करने वालों की कॉलोनियाँ
e: Athmalgola Barh subdivision ka ek gaon hai, jo Patna-Monghyr road par tatha Mail line ke EIR station par sthit hai; Calcutta se iski doori tees sau chaar meel hai. Athmalgola aisi hi nahi thi - woh un colonies me se ek thi jo atharahvin sadi me kamzor ya apang sipahiyon yaani invalided sepoys ke liye banayi gayi thin tatha jinhe thanas kaha jaata tha. in colonies ka uddeshya mukhya margon tatha sanchar ke raaston ki suraksha thi. Exam point: Athmalgola Barh subdivision me EIR Mail line par Calcutta se 304 meel door ek station hai tatha yah mukhya margon ki suraksha ke liye bane apang sipahiyon ke colonies me se ek thi.

qe: Banka Ghat, the railway station three miles east of Patna, was opened in which year?
qh: पटना से तीन मील पूर्व स्थित रेलवे स्टेशन बांका घाट किस वर्ष खोला गया था?
e: Banka Ghat Patna se karib teen meel purb ki or sthit ek railway station hai, jise 1900 me khola gaya. Yah station nagar ke purbi bhaag tatha nadi-kinare ke kshetra ko rail-network se jodta hai. Station se ek meel uttar ki or Jethuli gaon hai, jahan do Muhammadan mazar hain - kachhi dargah tatha pakki dargah. Kachhi dargah Shihab-ud-din Jagjaut ki hai, jo Bihar ke santon ke pita kehlate hain; doosri dargah Shah Adam Sufi ki hai. Yah sthal ziyarat ka kendra hai tatha Zikad mahine ki ikkisvin tareekh ko yahan mela lagta hai. Is tarah Banka Ghat jaise chhote station aas-paas ke dharmik tatha samajik jeevan se bhi judte the. Exam point: Patna se teen meel purb Banka Ghat railway station 1900 me khola gaya; iske ek meel uttar me Jethuli gaon ki do dargah - kachhi dargah tatha pakki dargah - ziyarat ke kendra hain.

qe: The Bihar sarkar of Muhammadan days comprised the present Patna and Gaya districts; in which year were Bihar and Rajgir transferred to Patna district?
qh: मुगल काल के बिहार सरकार में वर्तमान पटना तथा गया जिले सम्मिलित थे; बिहार तथा राजगीर किस वर्ष पटना जिले को हस्तांतरित किए गए?
e: Muhammadan daur ki Bihar sarkar ek bada district thi, jisme aaj ke Patna tatha Gaya jile, Japla tatha Belaunja jaise ilake tatha Kiul nadi ke pashchim ke pargane shamil the. 1787 me Collectorships ke naye bandobast me isi roop me district bana. 1800 se kuch saalon tak Ramgarh bhi isme shamil tha, jise ek joint-magistrate Sherghati me baith kar chalata tha. Unnisvin sadi ke shuru me Barh kshetra me thagi bahut faili hui thi, kyunki wahan Gaya se saal ke bade hisse me pahunchana mushkil tha. Isliye Bihar district ke uttari parganon ko milakar Patna district banaya gaya. 1832 tatha 1836 me sabse purbi pargane Monghyr ko de diye gaye, tatha 1865 me Bihar tatha Rajgir Patna ko hastantarit kiye gaye. Exam point: Bihar sarkar me aaj ke Patna tatha Gaya jile shamil the; 1832 tatha 1836 me purbi pargane Monghyr ko tatha 1865 me Bihar tatha Rajgir Patna district ko hastantarit kiye gaye.

qe: Which village in the south-western suburbs of Patna, whose name means the town of Buddhist monks, contained the burial place of Mir Kasim's father and was Shuja-ud-daula's headquarters in April and May of 1764?
qh: पटना के दक्षिण-पश्चिमी उपनगरों का कौन-सा गाँव, जिसके नाम का अर्थ बौद्ध भिक्षुओं का नगर है, मीर कासिम के पिता का कब्रिस्तान रखता था तथा अप्रैल-मई 1764 में शुजा-उद-दौला का मुख्यालय था?
e: Patna ke dakshin-pashchimi upnagar Pipalpati road se pahunche jaate hain; yah wah purana raasta tha jo Dilli se Sasaram, Naubatpur tatha Phulwari hokar aata tha. Isi marg par Lohanipur gaon hai, jahan Mir Kasim ke pita ko dafnaya gaya tha tatha jahan Shuja-ud-daula ne April tatha May 1764 me apna mukhyaalay banaya tha. Lohanipur naam ka arth bataya jaata hai - Bauddh bhikshuon ka nagar. Is marg par thoda aage Kankar Bagh hai, jahan Tayler ne Patna laut kar vakil ki practice karne ke baad apna prayogatmak khet yaani experimental farm banaya tha. Aage Bulandibagh tatha Kumrahar ke sthal hain, jahan Pataliputra ke abhilekh-mile puraatatvik avshesh nikle. Exam point: Lohanipur naam ka arth Bauddh bhikshuon ka nagar hai; yahin Mir Kasim ke pita dafan the tatha April-May 1764 me Shuja-ud-daula ka mukhyaalay yahin tha; isi marg par Kankar Bagh me Tayler ka experimental farm tha.

qe: In which year did Sher Shah rebuild Patna, after which Bihar town was deserted and Patna became one of the largest cities of the province?
qh: शेरशाह ने किस वर्ष पटना का पुनर्निर्माण कराया, जिसके बाद बिहार नगर उजड़ गया तथा पटना प्रांत के सबसे बड़े नगरों में एक बन गया?
e: Bihar nagar bahut purana hai. Nauvin sadi me yah Pala rajaon ki rajdhani bana tatha Gopala ne yahan ek bahut hi bhavya vihara yaani bauddh math banwaya. Mughal vijay ke samay Bakhtiyar Khilji ne is nagar ko loota, math jalaya tatha bauddh bhikshuon ko maara; phir bhi 1541 tak yah Muhammadan governors ka nivas-sthal bana raha. 1541 me Sher Shah ne Patna ko dobara basa kar uski imarat banwayi, kyunki tab Patna Bihar par nirbhar ek chhota kasba tha tatha asli rajya Bihar me tha. Iske baad Bihar nagar ujad gaya tatha khandaar-ban gaya, jabki Patna prant ke sabse bade shahron me se ek ban gaya. Aage chal kar yah shahar Marathao tatha Mir Jafar Khan ke samay ke utaar-chadhav se guzra; 1763 me badshah Shah Alam ne Bihar ko apna mukhyaalay banaya tatha Siwan (Bara Khurd) ke paas Carnac se buri tarah haraya gaya. Exam point: Sher Shah ne 1541 me Patna ko dobara basa kar imarat banwayi; tab Patna Bihar par nirbhar ek chhota kasba tha tatha rajya Bihar me tha, jiske baad Bihar ujad kar khandaar-ban gaya tatha Patna prant ke sabse bade nagron me ek ban gaya.

qe: The noble habitation at Digha, erected for the General commanding the station, roused the admiration of Lord Valentia in 1808 and is now in the possession of which family?
qh: दीघा में स्टेशन के जनरल के लिए बनाई गई भव्य इमारत ने 1808 में लॉर्ड वैलेंशिया की प्रशंसा अर्जित की थी तथा अब वह किसके अधिकार में है?
e: Digha Bankipore se paanch aur saade paanch meel uttar-uttar-pashchim ki or Ganga ke kinare Dinapore road par ek gaon hai, jahan ki aabaadi do hazaar do sau atthaais thi. Gaon ke pashchim me kai ghar hain, jo atharahvin sadi me Dinapore Brigade ke afsaron ke liye banaye gaye the. Inme woh bhavya imarat bhi shamil hai, jise station ke General ke liye banwaya gaya tha tatha jiski prashansa 1808 me Lord Valentia ne ki thi; yah imarat ab Hatwa ke Maharaja ke adhikar me hai. Iske niche woh ghar hai, jiska zikr Lord Valentia ne bhi kiya - yah Awadh ke Nawab Wazir Saadat Ali Khan ki sampatti thi, jo 1797 me masnad par baithne se pehle Dinapore ke afsaron ki mehman-nawazi yahan kiya karte the. General ke ghar se ek meel aage Dinapore ki or, road ke dakshin me, Digha Farm ki purani imarat hai, jiska varnan Bishop Heber ne kiya tha; yah ab Dinapore ke anaj-vyapari Moghal Mian ki sampatti hai. Exam point: Digha me General ke liye bani bhavya imarat ki prashansa 1808 me Lord Valentia ne ki thi tatha yah ab Hatwa ke Maharaja ke paas hai; iske niche Awadh ke Nawab Wazir Saadat Ali Khan (1797 me masnad par baithne se pehle) ka ghar tha tatha paas hi Heber dwara varnit Digha Farm ki imarat hai.

qe: Fatuha, at the junction of the Ganges and the Punpun, was a centre of the weaving industry; which silk was manufactured there, while table-cloths, towels and handkerchiefs were woven by the Jolahas?
qh: गंगा तथा पुनपुन के संगम पर स्थित फतुहा बुनाई उद्योग का केंद्र था; वहाँ कौन-सा रेशम बनता था, जबकि मेज़पोश, तौलिए तथा रुमाल जुलाहों द्वारा बुने जाते थे?
e: Fatuha, jise Fatwa bhi kaha jaata hai, Ganga tatha Punpun nadi ke sangam par sthit ek gaon hai, jo Patna se saat meel purb me hai. Yahan East Indian Railway ka station, ek police thana tatha ek inspection bungalow tha. Yah sthal bunai yaani weaving udyog ka ek mahatvapurna kendra tha; yahan tusser silk banaya jaata tha. Tusser ek qism ka resham hota hai, jo jungle ke pedon par palne wale ek vishesh keede ke kocoon se nikalta hai. Iske alawa Jolahas naam ke bunne wale samuday dwara table-cloths, towels tatha handkerchiefs bunne ka kaam bhi yahan hota tha. Nadi-sangam par bade snan-mela bhi lagte the, jinme Baruni Dwadasi ka mela pramukh tha; Baruni Dwadasi par Vishnu ke vaaman avatar ki smriti manai jaati hai. Yahan Punpun ka paani aage chal kar tatha unche kadhe ke beech lagbhag sau gaz chaura ho jaata hai. Exam point: Ganga tatha Punpun ke sangam par sthit Fatuha bunai udyog ka kendra tha, jahan tusser silk banaya jaata tha tatha Jolahas table-cloths, towels aur handkerchiefs bunte the; Baruni Dwadasi ka mela bhi yahin lagta tha.

qe: Bihta, a village in the north-west of the Dinapore subdivision, holds a large annual fair in connection with which an agricultural show takes place; the fair is held on which date?
qh: दीनापुर अनुमंडल के उत्तर-पश्चिम में स्थित बिहटा में एक बड़ा वार्षिक मेला लगता है, जिसके साथ कृषि-प्रदर्शनी होती है; यह मेला किस तारीख को लगता है?
e: Bihta Dinapore subdivision ke uttar-pashchim me sthit ek gaon hai, jo Dinapore se nau meel pashchim tatha Maner se paanch meel dakshin me hai. Yahan ek inspection bungalow tatha East Indian Railway ka station hai. Yah gaon apne bade varshik melay ke liye jaana jaata hai, jo Phagun mahine ki terahvin tareekh ko lagta hai; is melay ke saath krishi-pradarshani yaani agricultural show bhi hoti hai. Krishi-pradarshani me khetee ke naye tareeke, auzaar tatha fasal ki kismein dikhai jaati hain, jisse kisano ko nayi jankari milti hai. Dhyan rahe ki isi naam ka ek doosra gaon jile me pachchis meel dakshin me bhi hai, jahan kuch puraatatvik avshesh mile hain. Mela tatha krishi-pradarshani ka jod dikhata hai ki gaon ka vyaparik tatha kheti sambandhi jeevan kaise kendra banta tha. Exam point: Dinapore subdivision ke uttar-pashchim me sthit Bihta me Phagun ki terahvin ko bada varshik mela lagta hai, jiske saath krishi-pradarshani bhi hoti hai; yahan Dinapore se nau meel pashchim me EIR ka station tatha ek inspection bungalow bhi hai.

qe: Gayaspur, the largest pargana in Patna district, was one of the few parganas settled in 1790 with the village maliks; the resumption proceedings later raised its land revenue from Rs 86,115 to how much?
qh: पटना जिले का सबसे बड़ा परगना गयासपुर उन कुछ परगनों में से था जिनका 1790 में गाँव के मालिकों के साथ बंदोबस्त किया गया; जब्ती की कार्यवाही से उसका भू-राजस्व 86,115 रुपये से कितना हो गया?
e: Gayaspur Patna jile ka sabse bada pargana tha, jisme Mokameh thana tatha Barh ka bada hissa shamil tha; iska kshetrafal chaar sau ikattis aur aadha varg meel tha. Yah un thode parganon me se ek tha, jinme 1790 me gaon ke malikon yaani village maliks ke saath settlement kiya gaya. Lekin kharaab mausam tatha chhoti jameendariyon ke karan chhote malik apne bandobast nibha nahi paaye; 1793 tak, jab report taiyar hui, unme se zyadatar logon ne apni jameendari chhod di. Is pargane me badi sankhya me jagir thi, jinme Mokameh tatha Samuaia ke bade altamgha estates bhi shamil the. Jabti yaani resumption ki karyavahi chali to pargane ka bhoo-rajasva chhiyasi hazaar ek sau pandrah rupaye se badh kar ek lakh sadsath hazaar teen sau pandrah rupaye ho gaya. Aise aankde dikhate hain ki bhoomi-bandobast me jagir chhodne tatha rajvse ki vasooli ka seedha jod tha. Exam point: Gayaspur, Patna jile ka sabse bada pargana (431.5 varg meel), 1790 me gaon ke malikon ke saath settle hua tha; 1793 tak bahut se malik apni jameendari chhod baithe tatha jabti se iska bhoo-rajasva Rs 86,115 se badh kar Rs 1,67,315 ho gaya.

qe: Digha owed its importance to being the terminus for the large steamers coming up from Goalundo and the starting place for the smaller feeder service steamers to Barhaj and Buxar; how was the East Indian Railway on the south connected with the Bengal and North-Western Railway on the north of the river?
qh: दीघा का महत्व इस कारण था कि वह गोलुंडो से आने वाले बड़े स्टीमरों का टर्मिनस तथा बड़हज और बक्सर जाने वाले छोटे फीडर स्टीमरों का प्रारंभ-स्थल था; दक्षिण की पूर्वी भारत रेलवे तथा नदी के उत्तर की बंगाल-उत्तर-पश्चिम रेलवे को कैसे जोड़ा गया?
oe: By a steamer plying between Digha and Palileza
oh: दीघा तथा पलिलेज़ा के बीच चलने वाले स्टीमर से
e: Digha ka mahatva is baat se tha ki woh un bade steamers ka antim sthal yaani terminus tha, jo Goalundo se upar Ganga par aate the, tatha Barhaj tatha Buxar jaane wale chhote feeder-service steamers ka shuruwati sthal bhi yahi tha. Nadi ke dakshin me East Indian Railway thi tatha uttar me Bengal and North-Western Railway thi; dono rail-marg ko jodne ka kaam Digha tatha Palileza ke beech chalne wale steamer se hota tha, yaani rail ko rail se jodne ke liye yahan nadi paar steamer ka sahara liya jaata tha. Aage ki samasya yah thi ki Ganga yahan apna marg badalti rehti hai; isliye 1923 ke aas-paas yah connection kuch neeche Mainpura par banane ke liye majboori hui. Is tarah Digha ka sthal dikhata hai ki nadi ke badalte marg se rail-tatha-nadi sanchar ki vyavastha ko kaise badalna padta tha. Exam point: Digha Ganga ke Uttar ki Bengal and North-Western Railway tatha dakshin ki East Indian Railway ko Digha tatha Palileza ke beech chalne wale steamer se joda jaata tha; nadi ka marg badalne ke karan yah connection 1923 me kuch niche Mainpura par le jaaya gaya.

qe: At the bathing festival called the Baruni Dwadasi, held at the junction of the Punpun and the Ganges at Fatuha, how many persons are said to assemble, the festival commemorating an incarnation of Vishnu in the form of a dwarf?
qh: फतुहा में पुनपुन तथा गंगा के संगम पर होने वाले बरुनी द्वादशी नामक स्नान-मेले में कितने लोगों के एकत्र होने की बात कही जाती है, जो विष्णु के वामन रूप में अवतरण की स्मृति है?
e: Fatuha gaon Patna se saat meel purb me Ganga tatha Punpun nadi ke sangam par sthit hai. Yahan nadi-sangam par bade snan-mela lagte the, jinme sabse pramukh Baruni Dwadasi ka mela tha. Baruni Dwadasi is smriti me manai jaati hai ki Vishnu ne vaaman yaani baune brahmin ka roop dharan kiya tha tatha raja Bali se teen pag zameen maang kar unhe patal bheja tha; aise avatar ko bhagwan ka roop badalna maana jaata hai. Is melay me das hazaar tak log ikattha hone ki baat kahi jaati hai. Yah snaan-mela dikhata hai ki nadi-sangam ke sthal dharmik drishti se kitne mahatvapurna maane jaate the. Isi Fatuha kshetr me 1748 me Ali Vardi Khan ne Marathao tatha Afghano ki saajhi sena, jiski sankhya pacchas hazaar se adhik thi, ko Punpun ke pashchim kinare par Rabi Sarai me haraya tha; yah sthal Bengal se aane wale march-marg par hone ke karan bhi mahatvapurna raha. Exam point: Fatuha me Ganga-Punpun sangam par Baruni Dwadasi ka mela lagta hai, jisme das hazaar tak log ikattha hote hain; yah mela Vishnu ke vaaman avatar yaani baune brahmin ke roop me avataran ki smriti me manaya jaata hai.

qe: Biswak pargana in the south of the district formed part of the zamindari of the Mayi family; after 1781 it was settled with the Nawab Manir-ud-daula for how long, and with what area?
qh: जिले के दक्षिण में स्थित बिस्वाक परगना माई परिवार की जमींदारी का हिस्सा था; 1781 के बाद यह नवाब मनीर-उद-दौला के साथ किस अवधि तथा किस क्षेत्रफल के साथ बंदोबस्त किया गया?
oe: For ten years, over 431 square miles
For three years, over 209 square miles
oh: दस वर्ष के लिए, 431 वर्ग मील पर
तीन वर्ष के लिए, 209 वर्ग मील पर
e: Biswak ek pargana tha, jo jile ke dakshin me Islampur tatha Bihar thane ke kshetra me padta tha tatha jiska kshetrafal ek sau chhappan varg meel tha. Yah pargana Mayi parivar ki zamindari ka hissa tha. 1781 ke baad yah pargana Nawab Manir-ud-daula ke saath unke jeevan-kaal yaani aajeevan ke liye settlement kiya gaya. Aajeevan settlement ka matlab hota hai ki rajasva ka theka ya bandobast kisi vyakti ke jiwan-bhar ke liye tay kiya jaata tha, na ki nishchit saalon ke liye. Pargana kshetra me ek bade kshetra ka hissa hota tha, jo kai gaonon ko milakar banaya jaata tha tatha isse rajasva vasooli ka kaam saral hota tha. Is tarah Patna jile ke vibhinn parganon me alag-alag tarah ke settlement kiye gaye the - kuch gaon ke malikon ke saath, kuch bade zameendaron ke saath tatha kuch aajeevan ke liye. Exam point: Biswak pargana 156 varg meel ke kshetra me faila tha tatha Mayi parivar ki zamindari ka hissa tha; 1781 ke baad yah pargana Nawab Manir-ud-daula ke saath unke aajeevan ke liye settlement kiya gaya.

qe: Dinapore, the headquarters of the subdivision, was noted for its excellent cabinetware and furniture; its population at the census of 1921 was how many?
qh: अनुमंडल का मुख्यालय दीनापुर अपने उत्तम कैबिनेट-सामान तथा फर्नीचर के लिए प्रसिद्ध था; 1921 की जनगणना में इसकी जनसंख्या कितनी थी?
e: Dinapore subdivision ka mukhyaalay Dinapore hai, jo Dinapore railway station se saade teen meel ki doori par hai. 1921 ki janaganna me yahan ki aabaadi assi hazaar aath sau sattar saat thi, jisme 21,374 Hindu, 6,201 Muhammadan tatha 1,087 Isai shamil the. Yahan ki sainik chhawni me British infantry ki ek battalion thehri hui thi; shahar tatha subdivision ek subdivisional officer ke adheen the, jabki cantonment kshetra ek vishesh cantonment magistrate ke adheen tha. Kaam-dhandhe ki baat karein to yah shahar apne bahut hi achhe cabinetware yaani lakdi ke almari-almirah tatha furniture ke liye mashhoor tha; yahan ek tel tatha aate ki chakki yaani oil and flour mill tatha ek foundry bhi thi. Purana Ganga road shahar tatha chhawni se hokar nikalta tha tatha ek aur bahut achha rasta ise Nayi Rajdhani se jodta tha; is raste se hi Bankipore tatha Patna se sampark bana rehta tha. Exam point: Dinapore ki janasankhya 1921 me 80,877 thi tatha yah apne uttam cabinetware yaani furniture ke liye prasiddh tha; yahan tel-aate ki chakki tatha ek foundry thi tatha chhawni me British infantry ki ek battalion thehri hui thi.

qe: In 1760 a battle took place at Mohsinpur (Masimpore), a village north-west of Fatwa, between the army of Shah Alam and a force under Ram Narayan and Captain Cochrane; who was the only English officer who escaped?
qh: 1760 में फतुहा के उत्तर-पश्चिम स्थित मोहसिनपुर (मसीमपुर) गाँव में शाह आलम की सेना तथा रामनारायण एवं कैप्टन कॉक्रेन की सेना के बीच लड़ाई हुई; कौन-सा अंग्रेज अधिकारी अकेला बच निकला?
e: Fatuha Bengal se aane wale seedhe march-marg par hone ke karan Muhammadan shasan ke antim dinon me bahut ladaiyan dekhta raha. 1748 me Ali Vardi Khan ne Marathao tatha Afghano ki saajhi sena ko, jiski sankhya pacchas hazaar se adhik thi, Punpun ke pashchim wale Rabi Sarai me haraya tha. Iske baad 1760 me Mohsinpur yaani Masimpore naam ke gaon me, jo Fatwa ke uttar-pashchim me hai, ek aur ladai hui. Yah ladai Shah Alam ki sena tatha Ram Narayan aur Captain Cochrane ke nijam ke beech hui thi tatha isme Shah Alam ki poori vijay hui. Is ladai me Dr. Fullarton ekmatra angrej afsar the, jo bach kar nikal paaye. Aise sangharsh dikhate hain ki 18vin sadi ke Bihar me Company ki sena, desi zamindar tatha Mughal shahzade ke beech ki satta-rajniti kaise mix ho gayi thi tatha Fatuha jaise chhote sthal bhi badi ghatnaon ke kendra ban gaye the. Exam point: 1760 me Fatwa ke uttar-pashchim Mohsinpur me Shah Alam ki sena tatha Ram Narayan aur Captain Cochrane ke nijam ke beech ladai hui, jisme Shah Alam ko poori vijay mili tatha sirf Dr. Fullarton hi ekmatra angrej afsar bach kar nikle.

qe: Which of the churches at Dinapore was built between 1849 and 1854?
qh: दीनापुर के किस गिरजाघर का निर्माण 1849 से 1854 के बीच हुआ था?
e: Dinapore me vibhinn samudayon ke log rehte the, isliye yahan alag-alag church bane. St. Luke ki Church 1887 me banai gayi, jabki Roman Catholic Church, jiska naam St. Stephen hai, 1849 se 1854 ke beech banwaya gaya. Church yaani girja-ghar Isai dharm ke logon ke upasana tatha prarthana ka sthal hota hai. Dinapore me Isai samuday ke logon ki sankhya 1921 me 1,087 thi, jo mukhya roop se sainik tatha railway se jude kaam-kaj me lage the. Iske alawa shahar me dharmik tatha samajik jeevan ke kai anya sthal bhi the; udaharan ke liye Patna kshetra ki nagar-sthal sambandhi imaraton me St. Joseph ki Church 1850 me banai gayi thi tatha Patna City me Padri ki Haveli naam se mashhoor purana girja-ghar bahut prasiddh raha. Exam point: Dinapore me St. Stephen ka Roman Catholic Church 1849 se 1854 ke beech bana tatha St. Luke ki Church 1887 me banai gayi; yah alag-alag samudayon ki upasana-vyavastha dikhata hai.

qe: In the original cantonments at Dinapore, built in 1767, where were the sepoy lines situated?
qh: 1767 में बनी दीनापुर की मूल छावनी में सिपाहियों की लाइनें कहाँ स्थित थीं?
oe: On the northern side of the Grand Parade
On the river bank a mile from the bridge
Two miles away on the Digha road
oh: ग्रैंड परेड के उत्तरी किनारे पर
पुल से एक मील दूर नदी के किनारे
दीघा मार्ग पर दो मील दूर
e: Dinapore ki mool chhawni 1767 me banai gayi thi. Us chhawni me European sipahiyon ki lines us chaukor me thi, jo chhawni ke purb wale nala par bane pul se do sau gaz ki doori par tha. Is chaukor ke uttari tatha pashchimi kinare par afsaron ke quarters the tatha uttari kinare ke madhya me ek bada mess-house tha, jo 1811 tak khandaar ho gaya tha. Is chaukor se pashchim ki or juri ek doosri chhoti chaukor thi, jahan aur afsaron ke quarters the. Iske vipreet sepoy lines, yaani desi sipahiyon ki lines, nadi ke kinare par thi, jo pul se ek meel ki doori par thi. Itna antar dikhata hai ki us daur ki sainik vyavastha me European tatha desi sipahiyon ke rehne ke sthal alag-alag rakhe jaate the. Exam point: 1767 me bani Dinapore ki mool chhawni me European lines pul se 200 gaz door wale chaukor me thin tatha afsaron ke quarters uttari-pashchimi kinare par the; sepoy lines nadi ke kinare par, pul se ek meel door, sthit thin.

qe: Makhdum Daulat, the saint of Maner, died in 1608; his mausoleum was completed in 1616 by which officer, the Governor of Bihar and one of the saint's disciples, whose inscription on it expresses the pious wish that it may remain for ever safe like Heaven?
qh: मनेर के संत मखदूम दौलत का 1608 में निधन हुआ; उनकी मजार 1616 में किस अधिकारी ने पूरी करवाई, जो बिहार के गवर्नर तथा संत के शिष्यों में से एक थे, और जिनके शिलालेख में यह इच्छा व्यक्त है कि यह इमारत स्वर्ग की भाँति सदा सुरक्षित रहे?
e: Maner me do prasiddh Muhammadan mazarein hain. Inme ek Shah Daulat ya Makhdum Daulat ki hai, jine Chott Dargah kaha jaata hai. Makhdum Daulat ka 1608 me Maner me dehant hua tatha unki mazar ka nirman 1616 me Ibrahim Khan ne poora karwaya; Ibrahim Khan us samay Bihar ke Governor the tatha sant ke shishyon me se ek the. Mazar par laga shilalekh yah shubhkamna vyakt karta hai ki yah imarat swarg ki tarah sada surakshit rahe. Imarat bahut hi sundar hai - iski deewaron par bahut barik tatha saaf kaam ki naqashi hai, yah ek unche chabutare par khadi hai, iske har kone par ek patla tatha sundar minar utha hua hai, upar ek bada gumbad hai tatha chhat par Quran ki khudi hui aayatein hain. Iske andar wali masjid bhi Ibrahim Khan ne 1619 me banwayi, jabki ek sundar darwaza, jispar purana shilalekh hai - jiski tareekh 1603-04 se milti hai - uttar ki or se pravesh deta hai. Exam point: Maner me sthit Makhdum Daulat (Shah Daulat) ki mazar ka nirman 1616 me Bihar ke Governor tatha sant ke shishya Ibrahim Khan ne poora karwaya, jo 1608 me huye sant ke dehant ke baad bani; uske andar ki masjid bhi Ibrahim Khan ne 1619 me banwayi.

qe: Mokameh in the Barh subdivision, a station on the East Indian Railway and an important centre of trade, lies how many miles from Calcutta?
qh: बाढ़ अनुमंडल का मोकामा, जो पूर्वी भारत रेलवे पर स्टेशन तथा व्यापार का महत्वपूर्ण केंद्र है, कलकत्ता से कितने मील की दूरी पर है?
e: Mokameh, jise Mukama bhi kaha jaata hai, Barh subdivision ka ek shahar hai, jo Ganga ke kinare par sthit hai tatha jahan East Indian Railway ka mahatvapurna station hai; yah Calcutta se do sau tirasi meel ki doori par hai. 1921 me yahan ki aabaadi pandrah hazaar chhah sau arsath thi, jisme 13,257 Hindu tatha 2,187 Muhammadan the. Yah ek junction bhi tha, jahan se ek chhoti branch line nadi tak jaati thi; is branch ke sahare Calcutta se Tirhut jaane wale yatri nadi ke us paar Bengal and North-Western Railway pakad lete the. Nagar me European tatha Anglo-Indian railway karmchari bhi rehte the tatha yah vyapar ka ek mahatvapurna kendra tha; anaj tatha telahan jaise maal ka yahan se aana-jaana hota tha. Is tarah Mokameh rail tatha nadi - dono margon ka sangam-sthal ban kar jile ke uttari bhaag ka pramukh vyaparik dwar bana. Exam point: Barh subdivision ka Mokameh Ganga ke kinare EIR par sthit hai tatha Calcutta se 283 meel door hai; 1921 me iski aabaadi 15,668 thi tatha yahan se nadi tak jaane wali branch line se yatri Tirhut ke liye Bengal and North-Western Railway pakadte the.

qe: Islampur, in the extreme south-west of the Bihar subdivision, was the centre of which trade in the south of the district, thousands of maunds being brought annually from Tirhut and stored in large godowns?
qh: बिहार अनुमंडल के सुदूर दक्षिण-पश्चिम में स्थित इस्लामपुर जिले के दक्षिणी भाग में किस व्यापार का केंद्र था, जहाँ तिरहुत से हजारों मन माल हर साल लाकर बड़े गोदामों में रखा जाता था?
e: Islampur, jise Atasari bhi kaha jaata hai, Bihar subdivision ke ekdum dakshin-pashchim me sthit ek gaon hai, jo Hilsa se chaudah meel dakshin me hai; 1921 me yahan ki aabaadi paanch hazaar tihhattar thi. Yah Fatuha se ek light railway ke raste juda hua tha tatha isme police-station tatha inspection bungalow bhi the. Yah gaon ek bada mandi-bazar tha, jahan anaj tatha telahan ka vyapar hota tha. Iske alawa yah jile ke dakshin bhaag me tambaku yaani tobacco vyapar ka kendra tha: Tirhut se hazaar maunds tambaku saal bhar yahan laaya jaata tha, bade godamon me bhar kar rakha jaata tha tatha wahan se alag-alag kendron me bheja jaata tha. Railway khulne ke baad is vyapar ka bada hissa anya jagahon ki or mud gaya, isliye yah vyapar ab girta hua tha. Godown woh badi imarat hoti hai, jahan vyapari maal bhar kar rakhte hain; aise vyapar tatha godamon se gaon shahri mandiyon se jude rehte the. Exam point: Islampur (Atasari) Hilsa se chaudah meel dakshin me sthit tha tatha jile ke dakshin bhaag me tambaku vyapar ka kendra tha, jahan Tirhut se hazaar maunds tambaku godamon me rakh kar anya kendron me bheja jaata tha; railway ke aane se yah vyapar anya sthalon ki or mud gaya.

qe: Local tradition derives the name of Hilsa in the Bihar subdivision from Hilsa Deo, a powerful Hindu magician who was killed by which Muhammadan saint, after which the name of the place was changed to Jatinagar?
qh: स्थानीय परंपरा के अनुसार बिहार अनुमंडल के हिलसा नाम की उत्पत्ति उस शक्तिशाली हिंदू जादूगर हिलसा देव से हुई, जिसे किस मुस्लिम संत ने मार डाला, जिसके बाद इस स्थान का नाम जतिनगर कर दिया गया?
e: Hilsa Bihar subdivision me Kattar nadi ke kinare sthit ek gaon hai, jo Fatuha se terah meel dakshin me hai tatha jahan Patna-Islampur Light Railway ke saath-saath ek pakka rasta bhi jaata hai; 1921 me iski aabaadi do hazaar teen sau pandrah thi. Yahan ek police-station tatha inspection bungalow tha tatha anaj tatha telahan ke vyapar wali ek badi mandi thi; yahan ek varshik mela bhi lagta tha. Sthaniya parampara batati hai ki is naam ki utpatti Hilsa Deo naam ke ek shaktishali Hindu jadugar se hui, jise Muhammadan sant Shah Juman Madari, jine Juman Jati bhi kaha jaata tha, ne maar daala. Iske baad sthal ka naam badal kar Jatinagar rakh diya gaya. Kaha jaata hai ki marte samay Hilsa ne apne vijeta se poocha ki use khana kahan milega; uttar mila ki jo bhi Jatinagar aakar Hilsa ka naam lega, use khana milega. Yah katha Muhammadan tatha Hindu samudayon ke beech hue sangharsh ki yaad dikhati hai, kyunki wahan ki masjid khud ek Hindu mandir ke sthal par bani batayi jaati hai. Exam point: Hilsa naam sthal Hilsa Deo naam ke Hindu jadugar se juda hai, jise Muhammadan sant Shah Juman Madari (Juman Jati) ne mara tatha iske baad sthal ka naam Jatinagar hua; wahan ki masjid Hindu mandir ke sthal par bani batayi jaati hai.

qe: Kurji, a suburb of Bankipore on the banks of the Ganges about a mile east of Digha Ghat railway station, contains a Roman Catholic chapel and which institution for Europeans and Eurasians?
qh: गंगा के किनारे बांकीपुर का उपनगर कुरजी, जो दीघा घाट रेलवे स्टेशन से लगभग एक मील पूर्व में है, में एक रोमन कैथोलिक चैपल तथा यूरोपीय तथा यूरेशियन लोगों के लिए कौन-सी संस्था है?
e: Kurji Bankipore ka ek upnagar hai, jo Ganga ke kinare par sthit hai tatha Digha Ghat railway station se karib ek meel purb me padta hai. Yah sthal apni shaikshik tatha samajik sansthaon ke liye jaana jaata hai. Yahan St. Michael naam ka ek bada European boarding school hai, jahan karib do sau vidyarthi padhte the tatha jiske saath ek Volunteer cadet corps bhi juda hua tha. Iske alawa Kurji me ek Roman Catholic Chapel bhi hai tatha Europeans tatha Eurasians ke liye ek orphanage yaani anathalay bhi chalta hai. European yahan un logon ko kaha jaata tha jo Europe se aakar Bharat me bas gaye the tatha Eurasians unhe kaha jaata tha, jo European tatha Bhartiya mata-pita ki santan the. Aise sansthaon se pata chalta hai ki un dino me alag-alag samudayon ke liye alag school, chapel tatha anathalay banaye jaate the tatha unka apna alag samajik jeevan hota tha. Exam point: Bankipore ke upnagar Kurji me Roman Catholic Chapel ke saath-saath Europeans tatha Eurasians ke liye ek orphanage yaani anathalay hai tatha yahan St. Michael ka bada European boarding school bhi sthit hai, jo Digha Ghat station se karib ek meel purb me hai.

qe: At Maner the tomb of Makhdum Yahia is called the Bari Dargah, while the tomb of Shah Daulat is known by which name?
qh: मनेर में मखदूम याहिया की मजार को बड़ी दरगाह कहा जाता है, जबकि शाह दौलत की मजार किस नाम से जानी जाती है?
e: Maner me do bahut prasiddh Muhammadan mazarein hain tatha inhe alag-alag naam se jaana jaata hai. Makhdum Yahia, jine Sheikh Yahia Maneri bhi kaha jaata hai, ki mazar ko Bari Dargah yaani badi dargah kaha jaata hai, kyunki yah zyada purani tatha samman-prad hai. Doosri or Shah Daulat ya Makhdum Daulat ki mazar ko Chott Dargah yaani chhoti dargah kaha jaata hai. Yah do mazarein Maner gaon ke sabse mahatvapurna dharmik sthal hain tatha har saal yahan do mele lagte the - ek Makhdum Yahia ki mrityu ki varshgath par tatha doosra Ghazi Mian ke vivah ki smriti me. Dargah ke aas-paas ek bada bagicha, purane ped tatha kai kabrein bhi hain, jisse yah sthal ziyarat tatha aastha ka kendra bana rehta hai. Aise sthal dikhate hain ki madhyakaleen Bihar me sufi parampara ka samajik jeevan par kaise gehra prabhav tha. Exam point: Maner me Makhdum Yahia (Sheikh Yahia Maneri) ki mazar Bari Dargah kahlati hai tatha Shah Daulat (Makhdum Daulat) ki mazar Chott Dargah kahlati hai; yah do dargah Maner ke sabse mahatvapurna dharmik sthal hain.

qe: Remains of a large Buddhist monastery or temple, some of whose granite columns are still intact, exist at the extreme west of Islampur; about a mile to the south-west is a small village which was also the site of a great Buddhist temple and monastery. Which village is it?
qh: इस्लामपुर के सुदूर पश्चिम में एक बड़े बौद्ध मठ या मंदिर के अवशेष हैं, जिनके कुछ ग्रेनाइट स्तंभ आज भी सुरक्षित हैं; लगभग एक मील दक्षिण-पश्चिम में एक छोटा गाँव है, जो एक महान बौद्ध मंदिर तथा मठ का स्थल भी था। यह गाँव कौन-सा है?
e: Islampur gaon ke ekdum pashchim me ek bade Bauddh vihar ya mandir ke avshesh maujood hain; in avsheshon me lage kuch granite ke stambh aaj bhi theek-thak halat me khade hain. Granite ek bahut hi kathor tatha mazboot patthar hota hai, isliye aise pattharon ke stambh saikdon saal tak bache reh jaate hain. Islampur se lagbhag ek meel dakshin-pashchim me ek chhota gaon hai, jise Ichhos kaha jaata hai; yah sthal bhi ek bade Bauddh mandir tatha vihar ka sthan tha. Is tarah Islampur tatha Ichhos ke kshetra me Bauddh dharm ke smarakon ke avshesh milte hain, jo batate hain ki madhyakaleen daur se pehle yahan bhi Bauddh vihar tatha math ka failav tha. Islampur ek purane zameendari parivar ka sthal bhi hai, jiske purvajon ko 1790 me Shahjalanpur tatha Bhimpur parganon ka bada hissa settlement me mila tha. Exam point: Islampur ke ekdum pashchim me ek bade Bauddh vihar ya mandir ke avshesh hain, jinme granite ke kuch stambh aaj bhi sambhaley hue hain; Islampur se ek meel dakshin-pashchim sthit chhote gaon Ichhos mein bhi ek bade Bauddh mandir tatha vihar ke avshesh hain.

qe: The tomb of Yahia Maneri at Maner lies in a mosque east of a large tank with masonry walls, ghats and pillared porticoes jutting into it; this tank is connected with the old bed of the Son river by a tunnel of what length?
qh: मनेर में याहिया मनेरी की मजार एक बड़े तालाब के पूर्व में स्थित मस्जिद में है, जिस तालाब की पक्की दीवारें, घाट तथा उसमें झाँकते स्तंभ-युक्त पोर्टिको हैं; यह तालाब सोन नदी के पुराने पाट से कितनी लंबी सुरंग से जुड़ा है?
e: Maner me Makhdum Yahia ki mazar ek bade talab ke purb me sthit masjid me hai. Is talab ki deewarein pakki yaani chunai hui hain tatha uspar ghat bane hain; talab me stambhon wale portico bhi jhaankte hain, yaani chhat ke sahare khade stambhon wale chhote-bade chabutare paani ki or badhe hue hain. Yah talab Son nadi ke purane paat yaani old bed se ek lambi surang yaani tunnel se juda hua tha, jiski lambai chaar sau foot thi. Mazar ek aise parade me hai, jiska aadha hissa kabron tatha purane pedon se bhara hua hai; iske uttar tatha pashchim me teengumbad wali ek masjid tatha kuch chhote purane cloisters hain, jine Ibrahim Khan ne 1605-06 me banwaya tha. Cloister aise raste ya baramde hote hain, jo khule aangan ke charon or bane rehte hain tatha jahan se alag-alag kamron me jaaya ja sakta hai. Exam point: Maner me Makhdum Yahia ki mazar ke paas wala talab, jiski pakki deewarein tatha ghat hain, Son nadi ke purane paat se chaar sau foot lambi surang se juda tha; mazar ke uttar-pashchim ki teengumbad wali masjid tatha cloisters Ibrahim Khan ne 1605-06 me banwaye.

qe: An inscription on a mosque near the dargah at Hilsa corresponds to 1604 A.D. and is of historical interest because it refers to which ruler, called Shah Salim, as the reigning king while his father Akbar was still alive?
qh: हिलसा की दरगाह के पास स्थित मस्जिद पर लगा शिलालेख 1604 ईस्वी का है तथा ऐतिहासिक दृष्टि से महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि उसमें किस शासक को शाह सलीम कहकर विराजमान राजा बताया गया है, जबकि उसके पिता अकबर अभी जीवित थे?
e: Hilsa ki dargah ke paas ek masjid bani thi, jise Riza naam ke ek vyakti ne banwaya. Us masjid par laga shilalekh unnis sau mein se ek tareekh batata hai, jiska sambandh 1604 Isvi se hai. Yah shilalekh isliye aitihasik roop se rochak hai ki usme Jahangir, jine Shah Salim kaha gaya hai, ko raja ke roop me dikhaya gaya hai; halanki us samay unke pita Akbar jeevit the. Asliyat me Jahangir apne pita Akbar ke khilaf khul kar bagavat kar chuke the tatha unhone Salim ke naam se sikke bhi chalaye the, jinke kai namune milte hain. Yeh baat dikhati hai ki masjid banwane wale ne tatha shilalekh khodne walon ne us samay ki rajniti ko kaise darj kiya tatha pita-putra ke sangharsh ka prabhav sikkon tatha abhilekhon tak pahuncha. Aaj woh masjid bachi nahi hai tatha uske sthal par ek aadhunik tatha saadharan masjid bani hui hai. Exam point: Hilsa ke paas Riza dwara banwayi gayi masjid ke 1604 Isvi ke shilalekh me Jahangir ko Shah Salim ke naam se virajman raja bataya gaya hai, halanki tab Akbar jeevit the; Jahangir ne bagavat karke Salim ke naam se sikke bhi chalaye the.

qe: Maner pargana, the north-western pargana of Patna district, was assessed to revenue in 1790 at Rs 69,745; the resumption proceedings increased the demand to how much?
qh: पटना जिले का उत्तर-पश्चिमी परगना मनेर 1790 में 69,745 रुपये पर मूल्यांकित किया गया था; जब्ती की कार्यवाही से यह माँग बढ़कर कितनी हो गई?
e: Maner pargana Patna jile ka uttar-pashchimi pargana tha. Iska kshetrafal lagbhag ek sau ninanve varg meel tha. Is par 1790 me rajasva ka mulyankan iksattar hazaar saat sau paintalis rupaye kiya gaya tha. Aage chal kar jabti yaani resumption ki karyavahi hui, jisme chhoote hue ya jagir wale ilakon ka rajasva naye sire se tay kiya gaya; iske karan Maner pargane ki rajasva maang badh kar ek lakh pandrah hazaar chhah sau arsath rupaye ho gayi. Is tarah ke aankde dikhate hain ki 1790 ke mulyankan tatha aage ki jabti karyavahi se jile ke vibhinn parganon ka rajasva kaise badha; udaharan ke liye Gayaspur pargane me yah Rs 86,115 se badh kar Rs 1,67,315 ho gaya tha tatha Masaurha pargane me Rs 42,128 se Rs 58,066. Pargana kshetra me kai gaon shamil hote the tatha rajasva ke ye aankde us daur ki bhoomi-vyavastha samajhne me sahayak hote hain. Exam point: Maner pargana 1790 me Rs 69,745 par mulyankit tha tatha jabti ki karyavahi se yah maang badh kar Rs 1,15,668 ho gayi; isi tarah anya parganon ka rajasva bhi jabti se badha tha.

qe: Masaurha pargana, lying immediately south of Maner pargana, was assessed in 1790 at Rs 42,128 and increased by the resumption proceedings to Rs 58,066; at the time of the Permanent Settlement this pargana was in the zamindari of which raja?
qh: मनेर परगना के ठीक दक्षिण में स्थित मसौढ़ा परगना 1790 में 42,128 रुपये पर मूल्यांकित था तथा जब्ती की कार्यवाही से बढ़कर 58,066 रुपये हो गया; स्थायी बंदोबस्त के समय यह परगना किस राजा की जमींदारी में था?
e: Masaurha pargana Maner pargana ke theek dakshin me padta tha tatha Bikram tatha Masaurhi thane ke kshetra me faila hua tha. Iska kshetrafal ek sau tihhattar aur aadha varg meel tha. Is par 1790 me rajasva ka mulyankan bayalis hazaar ek sau atthaais rupaye kiya gaya, jise aage jabti ki karyavahi ne badha kar athatavann hazaar chhiyasaath rupaye kar diya. Sthayi Bandobast yaani Permanent Settlement ke samay yah pargana Raja Jaswant Singh ki jameendari me tha. Raja Jaswant Singh ka naam is jile ke itihas me isliye bhi mahatvapurna hai ki Kanchand wali bade estate ke woh antim uttaradhikari the, jinka bina putra ke dehant hua; unke baad unki vidhwa ne sampatti ka bahut hissa waste kar diya tatha ant me bacha hua estate alag-alag waaris ke hisson me bat gaya.
