Is tarah pargana tatha estate ke aankde dikhate hain ki bhoomi ka swaroop bade zameendaron, chhote malikon tatha jabti ki karyavahi se milkar banta tha. Exam point: Masaurha pargana 1790 me Rs 42,128 par mulyankit tha, jabti se badh kar Rs 58,066 hua tatha Sthayi Bandobast ke samay yah Raja Jaswant Singh ki jameendari me tha; Bikram tatha Masaurhi thane is pargane ke kshetra me padte the.

qe: Maner, in the extreme north-west of the Dinapore subdivision, contains a camping ground for troops situated in a large mango tope in which direction from the police-station?
qh: दीनापुर अनुमंडल के सुदूर उत्तर-पश्चिम में स्थित मनेर में सैनिकों के लिए एक शिविर-स्थल है, जो पुलिस-थाने से किस दिशा में स्थित बड़े आम के बगीचे में है?
e: Maner Dinapore subdivision ke ekdum uttar-pashchim me sthit ek bada gaon hai, jahan ki aabaadi do hazaar paanch sau atthavan thi. Yah Dinapore se das meel dakshin-pashchim tatha East Indian Railway ke Bihta station se chhah meel uttar me hai; dono sthalon se pakke yaani metalled road yahan aate hain. Gaon me ek police-station, ek dispensary tatha ek dak bungalow hai. Sipahiyon ke thaharne ke liye ek camping ground bhi yahan hai tatha yah police-station se uttar-purb ki or ek bade aam ke tope yaani bagiche me banaya gaya hai. Aam ka tope aise bagiche ko kehte hain, jahan ghane aam ke ped lage hote hain tatha jo chhaon tatha thandak ke liye upyogi hote hain. Maner ka sthal Bari Dargah tatha Chott Dargah ke liye bhi prasiddh hai, isliye yah gaon dharmik tatha prashasanik, dono drishti se mahatvapurna raha. Exam point: Maner Dinapore se das meel dakshin-pashchim tatha Bihta station se chhah meel uttar me hai; yahan ka sainik camping ground police-station se uttar-purb ki or ek bade aam ke tope me banaya gaya tha tatha gaon me police-station, dispensary tatha dak bungalow bhi hain.

qe: Phulwari pargana, lying between the Maner and Azimabad parganas, was assessed in 1790 at Rs 42,174; the resumption proceedings increased the assessment to how much?
qh: मनेर तथा आजमाबाद परगनों के बीच स्थित फुलवारी परगना 1790 में 42,174 रुपये पर मूल्यांकित था; जब्ती की कार्यवाही से यह मूल्यांकन बढ़कर कितना हो गया?
e: Phulwari pargana Maner tatha Azimabad parganon ke beech me sthit tha. Iska kshetrafal bahattar varg meel se thoda adhik tha. Is par 1790 me rajasva ka mulyankan bayalis hazaar ek sau chauhattar rupaye kiya gaya. Aage chal kar jabti yaani resumption ki karyavahi hui, jisme jagiron tatha chhoote ilakon ka rajasva naye sire se tay kiya gaya; iske karan Phulwari pargane ka mulyankan badh kar chhiyasaath hazaar do sau chhappan rupaye ho gaya. Isi tarah jile ke anya parganon ke aankde bhi badhe - maner pargana Rs 69,745 se Rs 1,15,668 tatha masaurha pargana Rs 42,128 se Rs 58,066. Aise aankde batate hain ki 1790 ke mulyankan tatha aage ki jabti karyavahi ke karan jile ke vibhinn parganon me rajasva ki maang kaise badhi tatha bhoomi-vyavastha ka swaroop kaise badalta gaya. Exam point: Maner tatha Azimabad parganon ke beech sthit Phulwari pargana 1790 me Rs 42,174 par mulyankit tha tatha jabti ki karyavahi se yah badh kar Rs 66,256 ho gaya.

qe: Narhat pargana has a total area of 882 square miles and was assessed in 1790 at Rs 64,346; after the resumption proceedings the assessment became how much?
qh: नरहट परगना का कुल क्षेत्रफल 882 वर्ग मील है तथा यह 1790 में 64,346 रुपये पर मूल्यांकित था; जब्ती की कार्यवाही के बाद यह मूल्यांकन कितना हो गया?
e: Narhat pargana Bihar subdivision ke dakshin-pashchim me padta tha. Is pargane ka kuch hissa Patna jile me tha tatha baaki anya jile me. Kul milakar iska kshetrafal aath sau bayasi varg meel tha. Is par 1790 me rajasva ka mulyankan chausath hazaar teen sau chhiyalis rupaye kiya gaya, jise jabti ki karyavahi ke baad badha kar bayasi hazaar chhah sau pachpan rupaye kar diya. Is pargane ka naam Samai kshetra ke saath jud kar Narhat-Samai ki jameendari ki pehchan bana, jo angreji kaal ke shuruwat me dakshin Bihar ki ek prabhavshali jameendari thi tatha jise nakshe me aise dikhaya jaata tha jaise woh ek chhota rajatva ho. Is tarah Narhat tatha Samai ke aankde dikhate hain ki kuch jameendariyan tatha pargane bade kshetron me faile hue the tatha unka rajasva stan-tantra tatha jabti se prabhavit hota tha. Exam point: Narhat pargana ka kul kshetrafal 882 varg meel tha tatha 1790 me yah Rs 64,346 par mulyankit tha; jabti ki karyavahi ke baad yah badh kar Rs 82,655 ho gaya tatha Samai ke saath milkar Narhat-Samai ki prabhavshali jameendari bani.

qe: Okri pargana lies almost wholly in Gaya district, with only a small area in Patna district; the whole pargana was assessed to revenue after the resumption proceedings at how much?
qh: ओकरी परगना लगभग पूरी तरह गया जिले में है, पटना जिले में उसका केवल थोड़ा-सा क्षेत्र है; जब्ती की कार्यवाही के बाद पूरे परगने का भू-राजस्व कितना मूल्यांकित हुआ?
e: Okri pargana Tilhara pargana ke pashchim me padta tha tatha lagbhag poori tarah Gaya jile me faila hua tha. Patna jile me iska keval ek bahut chhota hissa tha, jiska kshetrafal chaudah varg meel tha tatha jo jabti ki karyavahi poori hone ke baad teen hazaar ek sau ektalis rupaye par mulyankit hua. Poore Okri pargane ka kshetrafal ek sau paanch varg meel se thoda adhik tha tatha is par jabti ki karyavahi ke baad kul rajasva bayasi hazaar ek sau saath rupaye mulyankit hua. Is tarah ekii pargana ke kai jilon me bat jaane ke karan uska kuch hissa Patna jile me tatha bada hissa doosre jile me pada; aise kshetra-vibhajan ko samajhna isliye zaruri hai ki pargana koi aadhunik jila-seema nahi tha, balki rajasva vasooli ki ek purani ikai thi. Exam point: Okri pargana lagbhag poori tarah Gaya jile me tha tatha Patna jile me iska keval 14 varg meel ka hissa tha, jo Rs 3,041 par mulyankit hua; poore pargane ka rajasva jabti ke baad Rs 82,160 tay hua.

qe: Pilich pargana, chiefly in Hilsa thana and extending into Fatuha, was one of the parganas in which Thomas Law made his mukarrari settlement with the village maliks in 1788; the estates then settled were held under covenants by which the proprietor undertook to do what?
qh: मुख्यतः हिलसा थाने में तथा फतुहा तक फैला पिलीच परगना उन परगनों में से था जहाँ थॉमस लॉ ने 1788 में गाँव के मालिकों के साथ मुकर्ररी बंदोबस्त किया; तब बसे एस्टेट ऐसी शर्तों के अधीन थे जिनमें मालिक क्या करने का वचन देता था?
oe: To maintain irrigation works, abstain from collecting abwab and pay extra revenue if needed for defence
To pay the whole revenue in a single instalment every year
To keep a fixed number of soldiers for the district
To sell his estate only to the Government
oh: सिंचाई-कार्य बनाए रखना, अबवाब वसूल न करना तथा देश की रक्षा हेतु जरूरत पड़ने पर अतिरिक्त राजस्व देना
हर साल पूरा राजस्व एक ही किस्त में देना
जिले के लिए तय संख्या में सैनिक रखना
अपनी एस्टेट केवल सरकार को बेचना
e: Pilich pargana mukhya roop se Hilsa thane me padta tha tatha Fatuha tak faila hua tha; iska kshetrafal ek sau chalis varg meel tha. Yah pehle Kamgar Khan tatha unke bhaiyon ki jameendari ka hissa tha. Yah un parganon me se ek tha, jahan Thomas Law ne 1788 me gaon ke malikon yaani village maliks ke saath mukarrari settlement kiya; mukarrari ka arth hai lagaan ki rakam sthiri roop se tay kar dena. Us samay unhonne 122 estates banaye, jinme se 85 gaon ke malikon ke saath settle kiye; is tarah ka settlement Gayaspur ke mukable yahan zyada safal raha. Jo estates tab settle hui thin, woh aise covenants yaani shartnama ke adheen thi, jisme malik vachan deta tha ki woh sinchai ke kaam bana kar rakhega, abwab yaani rajvse ke alawa anya vasanooli nahi karega tatha desh ki suraksha ke liye zarurat padne par atirikt rajasva bharega. Aise shartnama dikhate hain ki un dino me jameendar ke kartavya tatha adhikar tay karne ki koshish ki gayi thi. Exam point: Pilich pargana me Thomas Law ne 1788 me 122 estates banaye, jinme se 85 gaon ke malikon ke saath settle kiye; ye estates aise shartnama ke adheen thi jisme malik sinchai ke kaam banaye rakhne, abwab na vasoolne tatha zarurat par raksha ke liye atirikt rajasva dene ka vachan deta tha.

qe: Punpun, a village eight miles south of Bankipore on the Punpun river, is the place at which pilgrims to which town begin the ceremonies incidental to their pilgrimage, being required to bathe and shave their heads?
qh: बांकीपुर से आठ मील दक्षिण में पुनपुन नदी पर स्थित पुनपुन गाँव वह स्थान है जहाँ किस नगर जाने वाले तीर्थयात्री अपनी तीर्थयात्रा से जुड़े संस्कार शुरू करते हैं तथा उन्हें स्नान करके सिर मुंडवाना पड़ता है?
e: Punpun sadr subdivision me sthit ek gaon hai, jo Bankipore se aath meel dakshin me punpun nadi ke kinare par hai; 1921 me iski aabaadi saat sau ikahattar thi. Yahan Patna-Gaya line par ek railway station hai tatha gaon me police-station tatha dispensary bhi hai. Is sthal ka mahatva isliye hai ki jo teerth-yatri Gaya jaate hain, woh apni yatra se jude sanskar yahin se shuru karte hain. Unke liye zaruri hota hai ki woh yahan punpun nadi me snan karein tatha apna sir mundwayein; iske baad hi woh Gaya ja kar apne purvajon ke liye pind-dan tatha shraaddh jaise funeral rites kar sakte hain. Pind-dan woh kriya hoti hai, jisme pind yaani chawal ke gole banakar purvajon ko arpit kiye jaate hain. Is tarah Punpun Gaya-tirth ka pahla padav bana tatha yah sthal dharmik yatra ki ek nishchit vyavastha dikhata hai, jisme pehle snan tatha mundan, phir pind-dan ka kram hota hai. Exam point: Bankipore se aath meel dakshin me punpun nadi ke kinare sthit Punpun gaon woh sthal hai, jahan se Gaya jaane wale teerth-yatri apni yatra ke sanskar shuru karte hain; unhe yahan snan karna tatha sir mundwana padta hai, iske baad hi woh Gaya me purvajon ka pind-dan kar sakte hain.

qe: Punarak, a large village on the Patna-Monghyr road in the Barh subdivision, was one of the camping grounds on the Ganges road from Bengal to Bihar; whose European soldiers mutinied here on the 24th of July 1757 in the course of their march to Patna?
qh: बाढ़ अनुमंडल में पटना-मुंगेर मार्ग पर स्थित बड़ा गाँव पुनारक बंगाल से बिहार आने वाले गंगा-मार्ग के पड़ावों में से एक था; 24 जुलाई 1757 को पटना की ओर चलते समय यहाँ किसके यूरोपीय सैनिकों ने विद्रोह किया था?
e: Punarak Barh subdivision me Patna-Monghyr road par sthit ek bada gaon hai tatha yahan East Indian Railway ka station bhi hai, jo Calcutta se do sau baanve meel ki doori par hai; 1921 me iski aabaadi saat hazaar teen sau untalis thi. Yah Bengal se Bihar aane wale Ganga-road ke un camping grounds me se ek tha, jahan aane-jaane wali senaayein rukti thin. 1757 me Eyre Coote apni sena ke saath Patna ki or badh rahe the; isi march ke dauran 24 July 1757 ko unke European sipahiyon ne yahan vidroh kar diya. Yahi Coote woh adhikari the jinhone kuch samay baad Patna ke Company Bagh me apni sena ke saath dera daala tha tatha sakhti dikha kar anushasan bahal kiya tha. Gaon ka pramukh nivasi Barh ka ek honorary magistrate tha, jiske parivar ke paas ek vichitra shivling bataya jaata hai; gaon me Sri Surya Narayan ka ek mandir bhi hai, jiske sambandh me Sravan mahine ke ek ravivaar ko varshik utsav hota hai. Exam point: Barh subdivision me Patna-Monghyr road par sthit Punarak Bengal se Bihar jaane wale Ganga-road ka ek pramukh camping ground tha, jahan 24 July 1757 ko Patna ki or march karte samay Eyre Coote ke European sipahiyon ne vidroh kiya tatha yahan EIR station bhi hai, jo Calcutta se 292 meel door hai.

qe: Mr. Henry Douglas held which office at Patna from 1792 till 6 September 1810?
qh: मिस्टर हेनरी डगलस ने 1792 से 6 सितंबर 1810 तक पटना में कौन-सा पद संभाला?
e: Mr. Henry Douglas 1792 se 6 September 1810 tak Patna ke Judge aur Magistrate rahe. Yah ek lamba karyakal tha, aur isi dauran unhe patwari records tatha Dutch factory se jude mamlon ka bhi samna karna pada. 1803 me jab Patna ki Dutch factory ke Chief Mr. Sohnlein ka dehant hua, to unki sampatti executors ko bhejne ka kaam bhi Douglas ne hi kiya. 1806 me unki chhutti ke samay pehle Mr. Charles Patton aur phir Mr. Charles F. Sealy ne unka kaam sambhala. Baad me woh Court of Appeal aur Council for the Patna Division ke Judge tatha uske pehle Judge bane. Unka dehant Patna me hi 1839 me hua. Exam point: Mr. Henry Douglas 1792 se 6 September 1810 tak Patna ke Judge aur Magistrate rahe.

qe: During whose temporary absence in 1806 did Mr. Charles Patton, Registrar of the Court of Appeal, officiate as Judge and Magistrate of Patna?
qh: 1806 में किसकी अस्थायी अनुपस्थिति में कोर्ट ऑफ अपील के रजिस्ट्रार मिस्टर चार्ल्स पैटन ने पटना के जज और मजिस्ट्रेट का काम संभाला?
e: Mr. Henry Douglas 1792 se 6 September 1810 tak Patna ke Judge aur Magistrate the, aur is lambi avadhi me kabhi-kabhi unhe chhutti par jaana padta tha. 1806 me unki chhutti ke samay sabse pehle Mr. Charles Patton, jo Court of Appeal ke Registrar the, unka kaam sambhala. Unke baad Mr. Charles F. Sealy, jo Diwani Adalat ke Assistant Judge the, ne yah pad sambhala. Is tarah Patna me adalati kaam kabhi ruka nahi. Aise record is baat ka pramaan hain ki Angrezi raj me judge ke chhutti par jaane par bhi unke sthayi adhikariyon ke through kaam chalta rahta tha, jisme registrar aur assistant judge jaisi technical poston ka khaas mahatva tha. Exam point: 1806 me Mr. Henry Douglas ki anupasthiti me pehle Mr. Charles Patton aur phir Mr. Charles F. Sealy ne Patna ke Judge aur Magistrate ka kaam sambhala.

qe: The tomb of Mr. Henry Douglas, who died at Patna in 1839, lies in the European cemetery opposite which police station?
qh: 1839 में पटना में देहांत हुए मिस्टर हेनरी डगलस का मकबरा किस थाने के सामने यूरोपीय कब्रिस्तान में है?
e: Mr. Henry Douglas ne Patna me lambi avadhi tak adalati seva ki aur aakhir me Court of Appeal ke pehle Judge bane. Unka dehant Patna me hi 1839 me hua. Unka makbara unneesvin sadi ke madhy ka Europei qabristan me hai, jo Pirbahore police station ke saamne mukhya sadak ke dakshin kinare par tha. Patna me aise qabristan is baat ke pramaan hain ki Company ke zamane me yahan ek badi Europei aabadi thi, jisme judge, doctor, engineer aur vyapari rahte the; yah varg apne alag church, club aur qabristan banata tha. Douglas ka naam Patna ke itihas me isliye bhi juda hai ki unke karyakal me Patna me Dutch factory, patwari records aur adalati sudhar ke kai mahatvapurna kaam hue. Exam point: Mr. Henry Douglas ka makbara Patna ke Pirbahore police station ke saamne sthith Europei qabristan me hai.

qe: Which pargana was permanently settled at Thomas Law's mukarrari settlement, though almost the whole of it had to be settled with farmers because the village maliks would not take settlement?
qh: किस परगना का स्थायी बंदोबस्त थॉमस लॉ के मुकरररी बंदोबस्त पर हुआ, पर उसका लगभग पूरा हिस्सा काश्तकारों के साथ बंदोबस्त करना पड़ा क्योंकि गाँव के मालिकों ने बंदोबस्त लेना स्वीकार नहीं किया?
e: Thomas Law ne 1788 me Patna jile me gaon-gaon kar ke mukarrari bandobast kiya, yaani malikon ke saath ek nishchit tay lagan par sthayi samjhauta kiya. Samai pargana isi mukarrari bandobast ke tehat sthayi roop se bandobast hua, lekin iski ek badi dikkat yah thi ki yahan ke gaon ke malikon ne bandobast lena hi sweekar nahi kiya. Isliye Samai pargana ka lagbhag poora hissa kashitkaron yaani thikadaron ke saath bandobast karna pada, jo sarkar ko tay lagan dete the aur khud gaon se vasooli karte the. Samai pargana ka kshetra 252 square mile tha, jisme se 14 square mile Patna jile me Rajgir pargana ke purb me padta tha, aur resumption ki karwai ke baad iski lagan 4,773 rupaye bani. Exam point: Samai pargana Law ke mukarrari bandobast ke tehat sthayi hua, par malikon ke mankar nahi karne ke kaaran use kashitkaron ke saath bandobast karna pada.

qe: Which pargana in Masaurhi thana, first settled with a farmer in 1790, was settled with the village maliks in 1792 after the farmer defaulted, at a revenue of Rs 47,818?
qh: मसौढ़ी थाने का कौन-सा परगना 1790 में पहले एक काश्तकार के साथ बंदोबस्त हुआ और काश्तकार के चूक करने पर 1792 में गाँव के मालिकों के साथ 47,818 रुपये की लगान पर बंदोबस्त हुआ?
e: Sanda pargana Masaurhi thana me sthit tha aur iska kshetra 124 square mile tha. 1790 me ise ek kashitkar yaani thikadar ke saath bandobast kiya gaya, jiska kaam tha gaon se lagan vasool kar sarkar ko dena. Lekin jab us kashitkar ne lagan dene me chook ki, to 1792 me yah pargana gaon ke malikon ke saath seedhe bandobast kar diya gaya, aur uski lagan 47,818 rupaye tay hui. Yah ghatna dikhati hai ki Company sarkar ke liye lagan ki vasooli sabse badi chinta thi, aur jab thikadar chookta tha to woh malikon ke saath seedha samjhauta kar leti thi. Isi tarah ke badlav dekh kar hi gaon ke malik bhi apne adhikar surakshit karne ke liye bandobast lene me hichakate the. Exam point: Sanda pargana 1790 me kashitkar ke saath bandobast hua tha, aur uska 1792 me chook hone par malikon ke saath 47,818 rupaye ki lagan par bandobast hua.

qe: The greater part of Shahjahanpur pargana, lying in Fatuha and Hilsa thanas, was settled in 1790 with which family, together with their estates in Bhimpur, at a nominal revenue?
qh: फतुहा और हिलसा थानों में पड़ने वाले शाहजहाँपुर परगने का बड़ा हिस्सा 1790 में किस परिवार के साथ, तथा भीमपुर की उनकी जागीरों के साथ, नाममात्र की लगान पर बंदोबस्त हुआ?
e: Shahjahanpur pargana Fatuha tatha Hilsa thanas me phaila hua tha aur iska kshetra 614 square mile tha, yaani jile ke sabse bade parganon me se ek. 1790 me iska bada hissa Islampur ke Chaudhri parivar ke saath bandobast kiya gaya, aur is bandobast me unke Bhimpur ki jageerein bhi shamil thi. Yah bandobast naam-matra ki lagan par hua, kyunki Chaudhri log ilaake ke purane tatha prabhavshali zamindar the aur sarkar unse samjhauta karna chahti thi. Baad me resumption ki karwai ke baad is pargana ki lagan 65,930 rupaye ho gayi. Islampur Atasari ke Chaudhri parivar ka zikr is ilaake ke purane zamindari itihas ka mahatvapurna hissa hai. Exam point: Shahjahanpur pargana ka bada hissa 1790 me Islampur ke Chaudhri parivar tatha unki Bhimpur ki jageeron ke saath nammatra lagan par bandobast hua, jo resumption ke baad 65,930 rupaye ho gayi.

qe: Telarha (Tilhara) pargana formed a single estate at the permanent settlement, settled with Muhammad Baqir Khan, who was related to Siraj-ud-daula in what way?
qh: तेलाढ़ा (तिलहरा) परगना स्थायी बंदोबस्त के समय एक ही जागीर था, जो मुहम्मद बाकिर खान के साथ बंदोबस्त हुआ; वह सिराजुद्दौला से किस प्रकार संबंधित था?
oe: He was the son of a sister of Siraj-ud-daula
He was the son of Siraj-ud-daula
He was the brother of Siraj-ud-daula
He was the son-in-law of Siraj-ud-daula
oh: वह सिराजुद्दौला की बहन का पुत्र था
e: Telarha yaani Tilhara pargana Bihar subdivision me sthit tha aur iska kshetra 159 square mile tha. Sthayi bandobast ke samay yah ek hi badi jageer ke roop me maujood tha, aur ise Muhammad Baqir Khan ke saath bandobast kiya gaya, jo Siraj-ud-daula ki bahn ka putra tha. Buchanan jab is ilaake me aaya, tab bhi Baqir Khan Telarha me kaafi shan-o-shaukat ke saath rah raha tha. Us parivar ke vanshaj aaj bhi Telarha me rahte hain, lekin yah badi jageer bahut pehle hi tukdon me bat kar kai chhote-chhote malikon ke haath me chali gayi. Aisi ghatna dikhati hai ki sthayi bandobast ke baad badi jageerein samay ke saath toot kar chhoti milkiyat me badal gayin. Exam point: Telarha pargana ka ek jageer Siraj-ud-daula ki bahn ke putra Muhammad Baqir Khan ke saath bandobast hua tha, jo us samay Telarha me shan se rahta tha.

qe: Which pargana, with an area of 933 square miles, lay mostly in Monghyr district, only a small detached area of about 140 square miles remaining in the south-eastern corner of Patna district?
qh: किस परगने का क्षेत्रफल 933 वर्ग मील था, जिसका अधिकांश हिस्सा मुंगेर जिले में चला गया और पटना जिले के दक्षिण-पूर्वी कोने में लगभग 140 वर्ग मील का अलग टुकड़ा ही बचा?
e: Maida pargana zila Bihar ka ek pargana tha, jiska kshetra 933 square mile tha. Pargana yaani purani rajasva-vyavastha ki ek bhumi-ikayi, jisme kai gaon shamil hote the tatha jiske rajasva ka alag hisab rakha jata tha. Samay ke saath is pargane ka bada hissa Monghyr jile me chala gaya, aur Patna jile me sirf ek chhota alag bhag bacha, jo dakshin-poorv kone me tha; is bache hue hisse ka kshetra lagbhag 140 square mile tha tatha rajasva 567 rupaye. Isi tarah parganon ke kshetra tatha rajasva ke aankde batate hain ki jilon ki seemayein badalne tatha bundobast badalne se bhoomi-vyavastha kaise badalti rahi. Aaj bhi Patna kshetra ke kai purane pargana-naam isi vyavastha ki yaad dilate hain. Exam point: Maida pargana ka kshetra 933 square mile tha; iska bada hissa Monghyr jile me chala gaya tatha Patna jile me lagbhag 140 square mile tatha 567 rupaye rajasva wala alag hissa bacha.

qe: A detached portion of which pargana, with an area of 62 acres and a revenue of Rs 83, lay on the north-west of Rajgir pargana in Patna district?
qh: पटना जिले में राजगीर परगने के उत्तर-पश्चिम में किस परगने का अलग टुकड़ा पड़ता था, जिसका क्षेत्रफल 62 एकड़ तथा लगान 83 रुपये था?
e: Sanaut pargana Gaya jile ka ek pargana tha, jiska ek chhota alag hissa Patna jile ke Rajgir pargana ke uttar-pashchim me pada tha. Is chhote hisse ka kshetra sirf 62 acre tatha rajasva 83 rupaye tha. Acre yaani zameen naapne ki ek ikayi, jisme ek acre lagbhag 4,046 square meter ke barabar hota hai. Kisi pargane ka chhota tukda doosre jile me pade hona purani rajasva-vyavastha ki ek khaas baat thi, kyunki pargane gaonon ke samoohon se bante the, jilon ki seemaon se nahi. Isi kaaran ek hi pargana do jilon me baitha hua milta tha tatha uske rajasva ka hissa har jile me alag likha jata tha. Exam point: Sanaut pargana Gaya jile ka tha, jiska 62 acre tatha 83 rupaye rajasva wala chhota hissa Patna jile me Rajgir pargana ke uttar-pashchim me pada tha.

qe: Islampur, a large village in the south of the Bihar subdivision, stood on which great road?
qh: बिहार अनुमंडल के दक्षिण में स्थित बड़ा गाँव इस्लामपुर किस बड़े मार्ग पर बसा था?
e: Islampur Bihar subdivision ke dakshin me sthit ek bada gaon hai, jise Atasari bhi kaha jata hai. Yah gaon Patna se Gaya jaane wale bade marg par pada tha, isliye yahan aane-jaane wale yatri tatha vyapari rukte the. Us samay yah marg itna accha nahi tha ki us par bail-gadi aasani se chal sake; likha gaya hai ki is marg par bail-gadi sirf bahut mushkil se chal pati thi. Islampur ke pashchim me ek bade Bauddh vihar ya mandir ke avshesh bhi hain, jinke kuch granite ke stambh aaj bhi khade hain tatha gaon ek purane zamindari parivar ka mukhya sthal bhi raha. Sadak, bazaar tatha dharmik sthal, teenon ka ek jagah hona is gaon ko kshetra ka mahatvapurna kendra banata tha. Exam point: Islampur, jise Atasari bhi kehte hain, Patna se Gaya jaane wale bade marg par sthit tha; us samay is marg par bail-gadi bahut mushkil se chal pati thi.

qe: After the treaty of 21 January 1798 with Saadat Ali of Oudh, Wazir Ali planned an all-India conspiracy against the British and had as a confederate in Bihar which Raja of Tikari?
qh: अवध के सआदत अली के साथ 21 जनवरी 1798 की संधि के बाद वज़ीर अली ने अंग्रेजों के विरुद्ध अखिल भारतीय साजिश रची, जिसमें बिहार में टेकारी के किस राजा उसका साथी था?
e: 21 January 1798 ko East India Company tatha Oudh ke Saadat Ali ke beech ek sandhi hui, jisme Saadat Ali ko Oudh ka nawab maan liya gaya. Is sandhi ke baad Wazir Ali, jo Oudh ke masnad yaani takht ka doosra davedaar tha, pension par Benaras me rahne ke liye bhej diya gaya. Apni is halat se asantusht Wazir Ali ne angrejon ke khilaf ek akhil-bharatiya sazish ki yojana banayi, aur is sazish me Bihar me uske kuch saathi the, jinme Tikari ke Raja Mitrajit Singh bhi shamil the. Tikari kshetra Gaya ke nikat ek purani tatha prabhavshali riyasat thi, isliye uske raja ka saath milna sazish ke liye mahatvapurna tha. Aise prayason se pata chalta hai ki Company ke vistar ke khilaf Bihari rajaon tatha anya prabhavshali logon me samay-samay par sazishen hoti rahi. Exam point: Wazir Ali ki 1798 ke baad ki sazish me Tikari ke Raja Mitrajit Singh Bihar me uske saathi the.

qe: William Tayler was Commissioner of the Patna Division, which comprised what area and population, till August 1857?
qh: विलियम टेलर अगस्त 1857 तक पटना प्रमंडल के कमिश्नर थे, जिसका क्षेत्रफल तथा जनसंख्या कितनी थी?
oe: 24,000 square miles and five million people
14,000 square miles and two million people
40,000 square miles and eight million people
24,000 square miles and two million people
oh: 24,000 वर्ग मील तथा पचास लाख लोग
14,000 वर्ग मील तथा बीस लाख लोग
40,000 वर्ग मील तथा अस्सी लाख लोग
24,000 वर्ग मील तथा बीस लाख लोग
e: British kaal me prashasanik vyavastha me Commissioner kshetra ka sabse bada adhikari hota tha, jiske adheen kai zile tatha unke Magistrate aate the. William Tayler August 1857 tak Patna Division ke Commissioner the; is division ka kshetra chaubis hazaar square mile tha tatha yahan ki aabadi lagbhag paanch million yaani pachas lakh logon ki thi. Itne bade kshetra tatha aabadi ko ek hi adhikari sambhalta tha, isliye 1857 ke vidroh ke samay Tayler par bahut zyada zimedari thi. Unhe Patna, Shahabad, Tirhut tatha Santhal Parganas jaise vibhinn hisson me ek saath uthne wale vidroh ko dabaana tha. Patna me July 1857 ke vidroh ko bahut sakhti se dabaane ke liye unhe jaana jata hai, tatha baad me unhe is pad se hata diya gaya. Exam point: Patna Division, jiske Commissioner August 1857 tak William Tayler the, chaubis hazaar square mile me phaila hua tha tatha yahan pachas lakh ke aas-paas log rahte the.

qe: In his letter of 27 June 1855, what did William Tayler say the minds of the people of these districts had generally conceived?
qh: 27 जून 1855 के अपने पत्र में विलियम टेलर ने लिखा कि इन जिलों के लोगों के मन में सामान्यतः क्या बात घर कर गई थी?

e: 1855 me William Tayler, jo us samay Patna ke officiating Commissioner the, ne Bengal sarkar ko ek patra likha. Is patra me unhonne bataya ki in zilon ke logon ka mann bahut bechain tatha sarkar se asantusht ho gaya hai; logon me yah baat ghar kar gayi thi ki sarkar unke dharm, jati tatha samajik reeti-riwajon me vyavasthit yaani plan ke saath dakhal dene wali hai. Isi tarah ki asantushti 1857 ke vidroh se pehle poore Bharat me dikhai deti hai, aur anaaj, kar tatha riwajon me dakhal ko log apni parampara par hamla maante the. Tayler ke is patra ke do saal baad hi Santhal vidroh tatha uske kuchh saal baad 1857 ka bada vidroh hua, jisne angreji hukumat ko hil kar rakh diya. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki vidroh keval sainikon ki bagawat nahi thi, balki uske peeche aam logon ki gehri asantushti thi. Exam point: 27 June 1855 ke apne patra me Tayler ne likha tha ki logon ke mann me yah baat ghar kar gayi thi ki sarkar unke dharm, jati tatha samajik riwajon me dakhal degi.
